findings.t: Deep-view room gallery leaks ALL memories, ignoring the owner's 'displayed' visibility flag
findings.r: Add `.neq("displayed", false)` (or `.not("displayed","is",false)`) to the getPublishedMemories query, mirroring the displayed handling used by getVisitorWingData/getVisitorPalaceData, so hidden memories don't leak into the deep view.

findings.t: GOLD spent as generic card/divider accent across the whole surface (canon violation)
findings.r: Per canon, drop the gold card top-border and gold section-underline on this ordinary content surface. Use a wing-accent rule (accentRule(wingAccent(wing.slug))) or a neutral HAIRLINE #E3D6BC seam for section headers, and reserve gold for a genuine palace seal/focus ring only.

findings.t: Off-canon page background and card glass instead of CREAM canvas
findings.r: Move the surface toward canon: CREAM #FCFAF5 page background, opaque cards on HAIRLINE #E3D6BC borders with SHADOW ramp, and retire backdrop-blur glass here so Visit matches the reskinned Library/Atrium.

findings.t: Room deep view never verifies the room itself is visible/published — only the wing
findings.r: Decide the visibility model. If rooms are independently published, add `.not("published_at","is",null)` to the room query; if all rooms of a published wing are public by design, add a code comment stating that so the omission is clearly intentional (keep consistent with getPublishedRooms comment).

findings.t: Video memories render as a static , so playback is impossible
findings.r: Split 'video' out of isImage and render a `

findings.t: Card shadows use cold black rgba(0,0,0,x) instead of warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
findings.r: Replace all rgba(0,0,0,x) card shadows with the canon warm-ink ramp (SHADOW[1]/SHADOW[2] = rgba(64,59,54,0.07 / 0.14) and HOVER_SHADOW rgba(64,59,54,0.16)).

findings.t: Off-canon MUTED secondary text color (#857B70 vs canon #716A5E)
findings.r: Align secondary text to canon MUTED #716A5E (theme has land.inkMutedLight: '#716A5E') for the breadcrumb, room subtitle and empty-state copy.

findings.t: Breadcrumb link hover spends GOLD (goldDark) on ordinary navigation
findings.r: Use EMBER #B85C38 for the breadcrumb hover color instead of goldDark, matching canon interactive state.

findings.t: Loading skeleton is off-canon and inconsistent with the room surface it fronts
findings.r: Rebuild the skeleton on CREAM #FCFAF5 at maxWidth 56rem mirroring the real room layout (banner block, title bar, memory-card grid of placeholders) so the loading→loaded transition is seamless and canon-colored.

findings.t: Breadcrumb wing/owner links build /visit/undefined/... when owner profile is null
findings.r: Use the route's userId (always defined) instead of owner?.id for the wing crumb href; thread a userId prop through and build `/visit/${userId}/${wing.slug}`.

findings.t: recordVisit is fire-and-forget from a server component and may be dropped
findings.r: Either await recordVisit(...) (it already dedups and self-suppresses errors) or move it into the client via a useEffect that POSTs to a route handler after mount, so its lifetime isn't tied to the render response.

findings.t: No prefers-reduced-motion guard on the surface's entrance animations
findings.r: Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block to TuscanStyles disabling animation/transition, or gate animation props via a useReducedMotion() hook.

findings.t: Reaction picker only dismisses on mousedown; no touch or Escape close
findings.r: Listen on 'pointerdown' (covers mouse+touch) and add a keydown handler closing on Escape; consider aria-expanded on the trigger and role='menu' on the popup.

findings.t: Room-visit surface relies solely on useIsMobile (no compact/portrait/landscape branch)
findings.r: Consider useIsCompact for landscape-phone/iPad-split tuning of maxWidth and header banner heights; low priority given the fluid grid.

findings.t: Text-only and audio memory cards lean on saturated HSL banners that clash with the warm palette
findings.r: Constrain memory-hue banners toward warm/desaturated values (or overlay a cream veil) so they harmonize with canon, and consider a lightweight custom audio affordance rather than the raw native control.

findings.t: Wing deep-view page silently collapses all wing links to the palace overview
findings.r: If wing pages are gone, point the wing breadcrumb at /visit/${userId} directly (matching the redirect target) to avoid an extra hop; or restore a lightweight wing view so the crumb is meaningful.

findings.t: Guests (logged-out visitors) get reaction/comment controls that will fail server-side
findings.r: Gate interactive reaction/comment affordances on currentUserId (show a 'sign in to react' prompt for guests), or have handleToggle reconcile with the server result and revert the optimistic update when {ok:false}.

findings.t: Reaction picker popup lacks aria roles / labelling
findings.r: Add aria-haspopup='true' and aria-expanded={showPicker} to the trigger, role='menu' to the popup, and aria-label={t('reaction_x')} on each option button (not just title).

findings.t: Sibling panels use an off-canon backdrop scrim (colder brown) while ImportHub uses the correct warm-ink
findings.r: Replace rgba(42,34,24,.4/.5) with the canon warm-ink scrim rgba(64,59,54,0.55) in all three panels so every layer of the Import surface shares one scrim.

findings.t: Heavy emoji usage breaks the Tuscan line-art icon language ImportHub established
findings.r: Swap the emoji for the same terracotta-stroke SVG line-art vocabulary used in ImportHub (or the TypeIcon set) so the whole Import surface speaks one glyph language.

findings.t: Manual-mode mass import lands on an empty Review tab (items hidden by default)
findings.r: Either set needsReview:true in the manual branch, or default tab to 'all' when store.mode==='manual', or make the review filter fall back to all ready items when the review subset is empty.

findings.t: Target-room select inputs use 0.8125rem font — triggers iOS auto-zoom
findings.r: Raise select fontSize to isMobile?'1rem':'0.8125rem' in the MassImportPanel target/ReviewCard selects and the CloudImportPanel target selects; the sibling text inputs already use 1rem — mirror that.

findings.t: ImportHub queue remove button is 1.25rem — far below 2.75rem touch minimum
findings.r: On mobile give the remove button a >=2.75rem hit area (enlarge or wrap with padding / an invisible expanded tap zone) and bump the header close button to minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem as UploadPanel does.

findings.t: Close controls use a raw text '✕' character instead of the shared SVG CloseIcon
findings.r: Extract ImportHub's CloseIcon into a shared component and use it for every close button; standardize the ghost-button treatment (transparent bg, muted->ink on hover).

findings.t: UploadPanel accent falls back to off-canon T.color.terracotta (#C66B3D)
findings.r: Change the fallback to canon EMBER #B85C38 (or EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A) so the panel never renders the off-canon #C66B3D.

findings.t: CloudImportPanel 'loading accounts' state is bare text with no spinner, unlike its other loading states
findings.r: Reuse the existing cloudSpin spinner (defined L678) in the loadingAccounts state for a consistent, animated first impression.

findings.t: Processing progress bar can stall below 100% because errored files are never counted as processed
findings.r: Increment processed in the catch branch too, or compute completion as (processed + errors)/total for the bar and aria-valuenow.

findings.t: handleImportAll swallows import errors and closes the modal, losing the user's queue on failure
findings.r: On catch, keep the modal open, retain the queue, and show an inline error surfacing the caught error; only clearQueue()/onClose() on success.

findings.t: CloudImportPanel user plan fetched via .single() errors (stays 'free') for users with zero subscription rows
findings.r: Use .maybeSingle() so a missing row returns null without error; surface genuine query errors instead of silently defaulting to free (which gates paid users out of Keeper providers).

findings.t: UploadPanel drawer width uses raw px (min(380px,92vw)) instead of rem
findings.r: Convert to rem: width isMobile?'100%':'min(23.75rem, 92vw)' so it respects root-font scaling and matches canon.

findings.t: UploadPanel URL 'Load' button and demo-image buttons are below 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' (and slightly larger padding on mobile) to the URL Load button and demo buttons to meet the touch-target minimum.

findings.t: Two different terracotta oranges used interchangeably for the same at-rest accent role
findings.r: Keep the values but add a comment (or use the named EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH tokens) so the rest-vs-interactive split is legible and cannot drift.

findings.t: ImportHub cloud provider brand-color SVGs sit against the muted Tuscan palette
findings.r: Acceptable for recognizability, but consider a consistent chip framing (brand mark in a hairline pill) so loud brand colors read as intentional badges; align CloudImportPanel to the same treatment.

findings.t: ImportHub per-file status UI (uploading spinner / done check) is dead — status never advances
findings.r: Either drive real per-item status from the import callback or remove the dead uploading/done/progress UI to avoid maintenance confusion.

findings.t: Drag-enter file size is hard-coded to 0, so the drop-count line never shows size and totals are meaningless
findings.r: Drop the size field from dragFileInfo (only count is knowable at dragenter), or compute size on drop where dataTransfer.files is available.

findings.t: Cloud import EXIF geolocation/date pulled from AI but manual review has no editable date field
findings.r: Optionally add an editable date field to the ReviewCard, or surface the resolved createdAt so users can correct it before commit.

findings.t: Cloud import progress is faked: single batch POST reports totals but no per-item progress and no timeout
findings.r: Add an AbortController with a reasonable timeout and a Cancel button that resets importing/importProgress so a stalled cloud import is recoverable.

findings.t: ImportHub cloud-provider tab strip and MassImport source toggle can overflow without horizontal scroll on mobile
findings.r: On small phones let these strips scroll (overflowX:'auto', flex-wrap, or a scrollable row) as CloudImportPanel's provider tabs already do, to avoid label truncation.

findings.t: Card background + border use off-canon hex not in libraryTokens
findings.r: Promote these to libraryTokens (a shared CARD_BG/CARD_BORDER exported from the file the Atrium cards use) or replace CARD_BORDER with HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC). If the warm gradient is intentional, name it in libraryTokens so sibling surfaces reuse the identical value.

findings.t: Three different border grays on one surface (warmStone vs HAIRLINE vs CARD_BORDER)
findings.r: Standardise resting borders on HAIRLINE across pills, quiet buttons and cards so the whole surface shares one hairline value; reserve warmStone (if kept) for a deliberately heavier control.

findings.t: Search input has no visible GOLD focus ring — inconsistent with rest of surface
findings.r: Add the input to the .explore-*:focus-visible GOLD outline rule (or wrap the field so the container shows the gold ring on focus-within) so the search field matches the surface's focus canon.

findings.t: Empty single rail shows generic 'nothing here' even when other rails are full
findings.r: Add a rail-specific empty message (t('exploreFeaturedEmpty') / t('exploreNewEmpty')) for the featured/new branches, mirroring the following branch, so an empty curated rail reads as 'nothing featured yet' rather than the whole-directory-empty copy.

findings.t: Hardcoded English aria-label on logo link
findings.r: Replace with a translated key (aria-label={t('exploreHomeLink')}) or reuse an existing brand/home key present in all five locale files (en/nl/de/es/fr).

findings.t: Category label renders untranslated raw DB slug
findings.r: Add category_* keys for every known category to the social namespace in all five locale files, or map slugs to human labels via a translated lookup. Until then, format the slug (title-case, replace underscores) rather than showing the raw DB value.

findings.t: GOLD hairline spent on the generic register/keystone CTA
findings.r: Drop the gold hairline (use HAIRLINE or no border) or, if a ceremonial edge is wanted, treat it as an intentional landing-keystone exception documented as such. Token-ise the #2E2A26 dark stop.

findings.t: Icon dimensions hardcoded in px instead of rem
findings.r: Express icon size in rem (width='1.125rem') or set font-size on the SVG and size via em so glyphs track the rem/type scale like the rest of the board.

findings.t: Bespoke focus/search shadow values sit outside the SHADOW ramp
findings.r: Reuse SHADOW[0]/SHADOW[1] (or add a named 'input' step to the ramp) so all elevation on the surface flows from one source.

findings.t: showAll not reset when clearing search or toggling search view
findings.r: Add setShowAll(false) inside clearSearch (and optionally when entering the search-results view) to keep the mobile cap consistent.

findings.t: Debounced search timeout / in-flight transition not cancelled on unmount
findings.r: Add a useEffect cleanup that clears debounceRef.current and increments searchSeq.current on unmount to cancel pending debounce/response.

findings.t: first_wing_slug fetched and enriched but never used by the card destination
findings.r: Either wire first_wing_slug into a 'walk this palace' affordance on the card, or drop it from the DirectoryPalace payload used by Explore to avoid shipping unused per-row data.

findings.t: Pill rail uses group semantics without a shared active-state contract
findings.r: If the pills are truly mutually exclusive, consider role='radiogroup' with role='radio'/aria-checked; otherwise keep aria-pressed but this is acceptable as-is.

findings.t: Search results count badge may double-announce with aria-live region
findings.r: Optionally add aria-hidden to the decorative count badge since the aria-live region already announces the count, avoiding double-announcement.

findings.t: PublicGallery has ZERO responsive hooks and hardcoded px sizing everywhere
findings.r: Import useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() and drive header font size, section padding, and grid density off them; convert px literals to rem (fontSize 2rem->~1.5rem on mobile, scale down padding). Match the hook-driven pattern already used correctly in ProfilePageClient.tsx.

findings.t: Follow button silently no-ops for anonymous visitors (phantom UI + misleading analytics, no login prompt)
findings.r: Gate on auth: pass isAuthenticated into ProfileCard (ProfilePageClient already has it) and, when false, redirect to /login?next=... on click instead of calling toggleFollow. At minimum, have toggleFollow return { authRequired: true } and short-circuit the optimistic UI + track() when unauthenticated.

findings.t: PublicGallery is built entirely in px, violating the rem canon
findings.r: Convert all px sizing/spacing/radius/type in PublicGallery, MemoryCard and MemoryLightbox to rem (32px->2rem, 16px->1rem, '40px 24px 32px'->'2.5rem 1.5rem 2rem'), keeping px only for 1px hairlines. Pull sizes from T.fontSize / T.space / T.radius to match the rem-based ProfilePageClient.

findings.t: Lightbox and full-viewport containers use 100vh instead of 100dvh (iOS toolbar clipping)
findings.r: Replace 100vh with 100dvh on the loading, error, and root containers; use maxHeight:'90dvh' for the lightbox shell so the Close button stays reachable on iOS.

findings.t: CTAs and dividers use terracotta #C66B3D instead of canon EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Use a fixed EMBER #B85C38 fill for the primary register/create CTAs and reserve wing.accent for the header icon/divider identity accent only, not the primary button.

findings.t: GOLD is spent as a generic navigation/CTA gradient, breaking the palace-only rule
findings.r: Reserve gold for the ceremonial Enter-Palace CTA only, and switch the Follow button and 'Visit wing ->' link accent to EMBER #B85C38 / EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A so interactive elements read consistently as ember.

findings.t: Cold black shadows and non-warm overlay instead of warm-ink shadow grammar
findings.r: Use the warm-ink ramp rgba(64,59,54,x) (SHADOW.1/SHADOW.2) for card/overlay shadows and a warm-ink lightbox scrim rgba(64,59,54,0.7).

findings.t: Two share surfaces don't read as siblings (Tuscan-glass vs flat card)
findings.r: Reuse TuscanCard and TuscanSectionHeader's gilt underline so the public gallery inherits the profile page's card grammar, gold seam and background ramp.

findings.t: Headings use charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36; muted is off-canon
findings.r: Map heading/body ink to INK #403B36 and secondary text to MUTED #716A5E; reserve near-black charcoal for the intentional 'dark' card variant only.

findings.t: Wing-count stats may double-count shared visits
findings.r: Label as total wing visits, or compute a distinct owner-level visit count (COUNT of palace_visits by owner_id, or DISTINCT visitor_id).

findings.t: PublicGallery error path cannot distinguish 404 / 410-expired / 429
findings.r: Branch on res.status: expired-specific for 410, retryable for 429/5xx, permanent only for 404; surface linkDeactivated vs linkNoLongerAvailable.

findings.t: Video thumbnails on public gallery cards autoload full video source with no poster fallback
findings.r: Include thumbnail_url in the /api/public-share select and PublicMemory type, render an <Image> poster for video cards, and only mount <video> in the lightbox.

findings.t: Memory 'type' rendered as raw untranslated string
findings.r: Add publicGallery keys type_photo/type_video/type_orb/type_case/type_album across all 5 locales and render t(`type_${mem.type}`) with a fallback.

findings.t: No reduced-motion guards on entry animations (profile)
findings.r: Gate entrance animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check (keyframe media query or useReducedMotion hook swapping animation to 'none').

findings.t: Loading skeleton uses cool grey shimmer, not warm CREAM/EMBER placeholder tone
findings.r: Match the skeleton to TuscanCard (glass bg, 2px gold top-border, warm-ink shadow) and give wing skeletons the arch-header block.

findings.t: Memory type label rendered as raw lowercase key, unstyled
findings.r: Add textTransform:'capitalize' and treat as a small-caps meta token consistent with the profile stats' overline style.

findings.t: Enter-Palace button assumes publishedWings[0] ordered by published_at, not curated
findings.r: Route the primary CTA to a palace-level entry (/visit/{profile.id}) or let the owner mark a default landing wing; fall back to publishedWings[0] only if none is set.

findings.t: ActivityFeed loadMore useCallback omits userId from deps
findings.r: Add userId to the dependency array of the loadMore useCallback.

findings.t: Public gallery card exposes raw memory type slug as user-facing text (untranslated)
findings.r: Map mem.type through a translated label lookup t(`memoryType_${mem.type}`) with a fallback.

findings.t: Self-view Edit button uses a runtime t()-echo guard instead of a real fallback
findings.r: Replace with plain {t('editProfile')} and rely on the messages files; drop the hardcoded fallback.

findings.t: Report reason radios lack radiogroup semantics
findings.r: Wrap the radio list in role='radiogroup' with aria-label={t('safetyReportTitle')}.

findings.t: Dark bronze-glass tutorial cards are entirely off-canon (should be CREAM/INK)
findings.r: Reskin the card to a light canon surface: background CREAM #FCFAF5 (or TRAY #F6EBE3), body text INK #403B36 / secondary MUTED #716A5E, border 1px solid HAIRLINE #E3D6BC. Apply identically to all four files so they match the Library/Atrium reskin.

findings.t: GOLD spent on ordinary titles, step dots and bullets (violates palace-only rule)
findings.r: Recolor titles to INK #403B36 in Fraunces, step dots/progress to EMBER (#B85C38 active, HAIRLINE inactive), and bullets to EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A. Reserve gold only for the pulsing highlight ring if a ceremonial focus cue is desired.

findings.t: Highlight ring & pulse hardcode gold rgba, not canon focus token
findings.r: Drive the ring from canon GOLD #D4AF37 (a legitimate ceremonial focus use) and switch the card scrim/shadow to warm-ink: scrim rgba(64,59,54,0.45), shadow SHADOW[2] = 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14).

findings.t: Cold-black shadows and scrims instead of warm-ink grammar
findings.r: Replace card shadows with SHADOW[2] (rgba(64,59,54,0.14)) and tint scrims to warm ink, e.g. rgba(36,28,21,0.5), to match the umber/ink shadow language.

findings.t: Highlight cutout radius uses raw px and inline literals, breaking rem discipline
findings.r: Express corner radii and paddings in rem (via remToPx) so the highlight and tooltip scale consistently with the token system.

findings.t: Title uses ad-hoc font sizes/weight instead of the RT type ramp
findings.r: Reference the RT ramp (title = RT.titleS, body = RT.meta, footer = RT.overline) for a consistent typographic voice with Library/Atrium.

findings.t: Corridor mobile step-0 joystick fallback points at an exterior-only element
findings.r: Drop the dead [data-mp-palace-bars] fallback in corridor context (it belongs to the exterior tour), or replace it with an anchor that actually renders in the corridor.

findings.t: Joystick visibility not forced for entrance/corridor tours (only room tour)
findings.r: Include entranceTourOpen and corridorTourOpen in the force-visible clause: visible={roomTourOpen || entranceTourOpen || corridorTourOpen || (!selMem && ...)} so the highlighted joystick is present during those tours.

findings.t: Four exported auto-open hooks are dead code that duplicate (and diverge from) the live path
findings.r: Delete the four unused hooks, or wire the URL-replay logic (the ?xTour=1 reset) into the MemoryPalace.tsx effects so the query-param replay actually works. Do not leave two divergent auto-open implementations.

findings.t: No Escape-key handler to dismiss the modal
findings.r: Add a useEffect keydown listener while open that calls onClose() on 'Escape'. Add to all four files.

findings.t: Step-progress dots are non-semantic divs with no screen-reader state
findings.r: Wrap the pips in a container with role='group' aria-label={t('stepXofY', {current, total})} or add an sr-only live text like 'Step 2 of 3'. Applies to Palace/Entrance/Corridor tutorials.

findings.t: tipTop/tipLeft positioning uses hard-coded pixel offsets, ignoring rem/font scale and landscape height
findings.r: Derive vertical offsets from remToPx() like tipWidth (e.g. remToPx(11) instead of 180) or measure rendered card height, so placement respects text scaling and short landscape viewports.

findings.t: Skip button falls below the 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Increase vertical padding (or add minHeight: T.touch = 2.75rem) on Skip and Next/Done so both meet the 44pt minimum touch target.

findings.t: Dialogs declare aria-modal but have no Escape handler or focus management
findings.r: Add a keydown listener for Escape that calls onClose, move focus to the primary button (Done/Next) on open, and restore focus on close. Apply to all four tutorials.

findings.t: Corridor/entrance/room highlight cutout intercepts clicks meant for the highlighted control
findings.r: Consider punching pointer-events through the cutout (or advancing the step) when the user taps inside the highlighted rect, so the tour feels interactive rather than dismissive.

findings.t: Room tutorial fixed 22rem card can overflow narrow/scaled viewports
findings.r: Use width: min(22rem, calc(100vw - 2.5rem)) and add maxHeight: calc(100dvh - 3rem) with overflowY:'auto' so long/scaled content and small viewports never clip.

findings.t: Highlight cutout mask uses px radius while rest of surface is rem — minor unit inconsistency
findings.r: Express the corner radius in rem (convert via remToPx for the SVG rx, keep borderRadius as a rem string) for consistency; low priority.

findings.t: PNG export bakes off-canon 'Manrope' font into shared artifacts
findings.r: Replace 'Manrope' with the canon body stack (T.font.body / 'Source Sans 3') and Fraunces for the title text, so exported PNGs match on-screen typography. Fix the identical hardcode in shared/[token]/page.tsx too.

findings.t: Two different 'muted' greys used for secondary text on the same surface
findings.r: Standardize card secondary text on canon MUTED #716A5E (or realign T.color.muted to #716A5E globally if safe). Pick one muted value across chrome and cards.

findings.t: Node/link palette relies on legacy T.color tokens off the canon ladder
findings.r: Align the tree body with the chrome: use EMBER #B85C38 (not terracotta #C66B3D) for the accent red in hearts/badges/focus ring, INK #403B36 for the primary name instead of charcoal #1F1B1A, and canon walnut/sandstone equivalents for link strokes, so the SVG visually matches the Atrium-canon toolbar.

findings.t: Manual Add Person silently drops birth_place and death_place
findings.r: Add birth_place: data.birth_place and death_place: data.death_place (and notes if the form later collects it) to the addPerson call in handleAdd so manually entered places are persisted.

findings.t: AddPersonForm text inputs use 0.875rem font — triggers iOS focus-zoom
findings.r: Set fontSize to isMobile ? '1rem' : '0.875rem' (or just '1rem') on inputStyle, matching DateInputAssisted, so focusing any add-person field never triggers iOS zoom.

findings.t: TreeSearch input uses 0.875rem font — iOS zoom on mobile search
findings.r: Use fontSize: isMobile ? '1rem' : '0.875rem' on the search input so the mobile-expanded search does not trigger iOS zoom.

findings.t: Page base gradient uses linen (#F2EDE4), not canon CREAM (#FCFAF5)
findings.r: Anchor the gradient endpoints on canon CREAM #FCFAF5 (T.color.cream) with a very light warm-stone mid-stop, matching the lighter base used on sibling surfaces.

findings.t: Loading and share-loading states are unstyled bare text / ellipsis
findings.r: Replace the '...' with a proper localized loading label and a small canon spinner/skeleton; give the tree loading state a subtle branded loader (e.g. the TreeBranchIcon with a reduced-motion-safe pulse) to match the polish of the empty state.

findings.t: GEDCOM import never recreates sibling / half-sibling / step relationships
findings.r: Either encode sibling/half-sibling/step relationships in the GEDCOM (e.g. via FAM structures or custom tags) and recreate them on import, or surface a warning that these relationship types are not preserved by GEDCOM export/import.

findings.t: Focus mode and Descendancy view can be active simultaneously with conflicting data
findings.r: Make the two modes mutually exclusive: clear descendancyRootId when entering focus and clear focusPersonId/focusedNodeId when entering descendancy (and vice-versa on exit).

findings.t: Share button can create a duplicate/second share link due to load race
findings.r: Fetch the active share fresh when the dialog opens (or gate the button until loadData completes) and have createShareLink be idempotent / return the existing active share instead of minting a new token when one already exists.

findings.t: Mobile zoom-control buttons are 2rem — below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum
findings.r: Raise the mobile zoom button size to at least 2.75rem (keep the circular shape), or add invisible hit-padding so the tappable area reaches 2.75rem.

findings.t: Toolbar action pills and view-switcher below 2.75rem touch height
findings.r: Bump the action pills to minHeight 2.75rem and the view-switcher buttons to 2.75rem on touch (isMobile), or add hit-area padding to reach the minimum.

findings.t: View-mode switcher lacks radiogroup/radio semantics
findings.r: Wrap the three buttons in role="radiogroup" with an aria-label, give each role="radio" and aria-checked={isActive} (or use aria-pressed on toggle buttons) so the active view is announced.

findings.t: Share-link readonly URL input uses 0.8125rem — iOS zoom + tiny target
findings.r: Set the share URL input fontSize to 1rem on mobile and give it minHeight 2.75rem to avoid iOS zoom and give a comfortable tap target.

findings.t: Gender tint colors are off-canon ad-hoc pastels
findings.r: Derive gender tints from warm canon tones (e.g. a rose from the terracotta/ember family and a muted warm-blue/sage rather than cool #A0B8D4) so the coding stays legible without breaking the warm palette.

findings.t: CompletionRing 'partial' color #D4A840 is a bespoke amber, not GOLD
findings.r: Use a defined warning/amber token (or canon goldDark #B8922E) for the mid state, or restyle the ring so the ceremonial GOLD is not visually echoed on non-self nodes.

findings.t: Keyboard 'f' focus and Enter open handlers read from focus-filtered persons, so they no-op once focus mode is active
findings.r: Look up the focused person in the full persons array (not effectiveData.persons) for Enter/F handlers, or ensure layoutOrderIds and effectiveData.persons are always derived from the same set.

findings.t: AddPersonForm text inputs use fontSize 0.875rem, below the 1rem iOS no-zoom threshold (duplicate/detail of P1)
findings.r: Raise the input fontSize to 1rem (16px) for the text inputs to disable iOS focus-zoom, keeping labels at the smaller size.

findings.t: FocusBanner imports FamilyTreeRelationship but never uses it (dead import)
findings.r: Drop FamilyTreeRelationship from the type import if it isn't referenced by the component, or confirm the build's TS config tolerates unused imports.

findings.t: Keyboard-nav hint and arrow-key controls are desktop-only, with no touch equivalent surfaced
findings.r: Consider a lightweight touch hint or a visible focus/step control for touch users so the focus-mode multimodal feature is reachable without a keyboard.

findings.t: Auth layout base font is Manrope, not canon Fraunces/Source Sans
findings.r: Replace the Manrope base with the canon stack "'Source Sans 3', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif" (i.e. T.font.body) so unstyled nodes inherit the canon body face.

findings.t: Layout background gradient uses off-canon hexes ending in a muddy taupe
findings.r: Rebuild the gradient from canon tokens, e.g. CREAM #FCFAF5 -> linen T.color.linen (#F2EDE4) -> warmStone (#E5DDD0), keeping it warm; drop #D4C5B2.

findings.t: Interactive color is terracotta #C66B3D, not canon EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Point the interactive color at canon EMBER #B85C38 (links, CTA gradient start, active input border, icons). Simplest durable fix: correct T.color.terracotta to #B85C38, or import EMBER from libraryTokens for these surfaces.

findings.t: Inputs have no visible focus ring; GOLD focus token unused
findings.r: Add onFocus/onBlur handlers (or a small styled wrapper) applying the canon gold focusRing / EMBER border on focus, so keyboard users get a visible canon-gold ring and GOLD earns its ceremonial role.

findings.t: MFA success path drops /kep/ redirects (and any non-invite redirect)
findings.r: Honor the stored redirect the same way the password path does: navigate to mfaRedirect when it starts with /invite/ OR /kep/ (mirror the actions.ts allowlist), else /atrium. Ideally extract one shared safe-redirect helper so the two paths cannot drift again.

findings.t: MFA input aria-label key `mfaDigit` is missing in ALL 5 locales — screen readers announce the raw key
findings.r: Add a `mfaDigit` key with interpolation to the `common` section of en/nl/de/es/fr, e.g. en: "Digit {n} of {total}". Add a build-time i18n key-presence test so aria-label keys can't silently fall through to the raw key.

findings.t: Secondary text and input borders use off-canon MUTED and non-HAIRLINE tokens
findings.r: Map muted->#716A5E, input/divider borders->HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, and body text->INK #403B36 (T.color.inkSoft already equals #403B36) for canon-accurate contrast and warmth.

findings.t: Container uses raw px and cool-grey shadow instead of rem + warm-ink shadow
findings.r: Convert px to rem (maxWidth 27.5rem, padding 2.5rem 2.25rem, radius 1.25rem), use HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for the border, and adopt the canon warm-ink shadow (e.g. SHADOW[2] = 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)).

findings.t: handleMfaVerify leaves mfaLoading stuck true if the post-verify navigation is slow or the WKWebView wedges
findings.r: Wrap the post-verify navigation in a try/finally or add a safety setTimeout(() => setMfaLoading(false), 8000) before calling nativeHardNav, so a dropped navigation re-enables the button and lets the user retry rather than stranding the screen.

findings.t: signIn returns a raw Supabase error message straight to the UI (unlocalized, provider-worded)
findings.r: Map common Supabase auth error codes (invalid credentials, email not confirmed, rate-limited) to localized serverError() keys and return t(...) instead of the raw error.message; fall back to a generic localized message for unmapped codes.

findings.t: Register 'success' screen is terminal on email-confirmation flow but shows no resend / stuck-user recovery
findings.r: Add a 'resend confirmation email' action on the success screen (calling a resend server action), and/or surface guidance for the already-registered case. At minimum keep the email around so resend can target it without re-entry.

findings.t: Register age-gate is client-only; server signUp does not enforce ageConfirmed
findings.r: Include the age-confirmation in the submitted FormData and validate it server-side in signUp (reject when absent), so the attestation is enforced rather than merely gating a button.

findings.t: OAuth sign-in ignores the ?redirect= param entirely (deep-link destination lost for social login)
findings.r: Accept an optional redirect in the OAuth opts, append it as ?redirect= to the web callbackRedirect (and thread it through the native custom-scheme handler) so social login honors invite/kep deep links like the password path does.

findings.t: Age-confirmation checkbox is a 1rem x 1rem (16px) tap target — far below the 2.75rem minimum
findings.r: Give the label a min-height of 2.75rem with vertical padding (padding: "0.5rem 0") so the whole row is a comfortable hit target, and/or scale the checkbox to ~1.25rem. Inline styles only, per canon.

findings.t: `register.unexpectedError` missing in all 5 locales — error falls back to a hardcoded English string
findings.r: Reuse the existing, fully-translated common key: setError(tc("somethingWentWrong")). Remove the hardcoded English fallback literal.

findings.t: Secondary text links (forgot-password, footer Privacy/Terms, register/login switch) are sub-2.75rem tap targets
findings.r: Give tappable links display:inline-block with vertical padding (e.g. padding:"0.5rem 0.25rem") to reach ~2.75rem effective height, and add horizontal spacing between the Privacy/Terms links. Applies to both login and register footers.

findings.t: MFA back-to-login button border uses cream token, rendering an invisible/near-white outline
findings.r: Use HAIRLINE #E3D6BC (or T.color.sandstone to match the other buttons) for the MFA secondary button border so it is visible and consistent.

findings.t: MFA active-digit border uses terracotta while the surrounding surface lacks any gold ceremony
findings.r: Once the interactive color is corrected to EMBER #B85C38, these MFA states inherit the fix; keep ember (not gold) for the filled-digit state, which is semantically correct.

findings.t: Register password null-deref possible before try/catch if required attribute is bypassed
findings.r: Guard with if (!password) { setError(t(...)); setLoading(false); return; } before the length check, or move the length/mismatch checks inside the try so a thrown value is surfaced and loading is reset.

findings.t: No portrait/landscape or iPad adaptation via useIsMobile/useIsCompact/useIsPortrait
findings.r: Acceptable as-is, but consider useIsPortrait()/useIsCompact() to tighten vertical rhythm in landscape/short viewports so the CTA stays reachable without scrolling on small phones.

findings.t: MFA 'back to login' button and OAuth buttons rely on padding for height; back button is marginally under 2.75rem
findings.r: Add minHeight:"2.75rem" to the MFA back-to-login button to match the social-button baseline.

findings.t: data-deletion page is 100% hardcoded English — no i18n, no locale switcher
findings.r: Convert to a client i18n page like privacy/terms: add const { t, locale, setLocale } = useTranslation("dataDeletion") plus the language <select>, and move every literal into a new dataDeletion section in en/nl/de/es/fr.json.

findings.t: data-deletion tells users to send "STOP KEP" but the WhatsApp webhook only matches exactly "STOP"
findings.r: Change the instruction to send exactly 'STOP' (the canonical command shown in HELP), OR broaden the handler to `if (upper === "STOP" || upper === "STOP KEP")` in src/lib/kep/whatsapp-processor.ts. Prefer fixing the docs to match the canonical HELP command.

findings.t: data-deletion page is a design orphan: no nav/header, hardcoded English, bare margin-auto layout
findings.r: Reuse the shared nav/header + LEGAL-overline/H1/lastUpdated scaffold from privacy/terms (ideally extract a <LegalShell> wrapper), route copy through useTranslation, and move safe-area padding onto a full-width outer wrapper so the header spans edge-to-edge like its siblings.

findings.t: Delete-Account instructions point to Settings → Profile, but the control lives in Settings → Security
findings.r: Update the step to 'Settings → Security' (or wherever the button is canonically placed) so it matches the real UI location.

findings.t: Off-canon background, ink and interactive colors throughout the legal surface
findings.r: Align to canon tokens: bg CREAM #FCFAF5, body/headings INK #403B36, interactive EMBER #B85C38, secondary MUTED #716A5E. If T.color must stay, add canon-aligned aliases (cream/inkSoft already exist in theme.ts) and switch these pages to them.

findings.t: Pervasive raw-px sizing violates rem canon (px reserved for hairlines only)
findings.r: Convert type/spacing/radii to rem (24px→1.5rem, 40px→2.5rem, radius 16px→1rem), keep only 1px hairline borders in px, and lean on RT/space scales for consistency.

findings.t: Language <select> triggers a full window.location.reload() on change
findings.r: For the legal pages, use setLocaleNoReload from the hook (already returned) so language changes preserve scroll position without a reload.

findings.t: Terms links to the EU ODR platform, which the European Commission shut down on 20 July 2025
findings.r: Remove the ODR link/paragraph or replace with current guidance; verify the target resolves before shipping legal copy that cites it as a live remedy.

findings.t: Responsive layout uses clamp()/vw instead of the mandated useIsMobile/useIsCompact hooks
findings.r: Adopt the same useIsMobile/useIsSmall pattern security.tsx uses for the shared nav and content padding so all four legal pages branch responsively the canon way.

findings.t: Native language <select> font 0.75rem can trigger iOS focus zoom
findings.r: Raise the select fontSize to 1rem (≥16px) to prevent focus-zoom on iOS, or scale it visually with transform while keeping the intrinsic font at 1rem. Apply on privacy/terms/security.

findings.t: Language <select> chevron hardcodes a gray #666 arrow off the warm palette
findings.r: Recolor the chevron to a warm ink/muted token (e.g. url-encoded %23716A5E MUTED or C.walnut) so the control matches the surrounding warm palette.

findings.t: CTA glow shadow uses a raw non-token orange rgba, not the warm-ink shadow grammar
findings.r: Replace with the canon warm-ink shadow (SHADOW[2] = 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)) in rem, dropping the orange glow, or if a colored lift is desired keep it subtle and tokenized.

findings.t: Privacy/terms rely on fixed px sizing with no responsive hooks; only clamp() saves them at small widths
findings.r: Optionally adopt useIsMobile to bump body copy to ~1rem and tighten list padding on phones; at minimum verify the 12px uppercase eyebrow remains legible at 320px width. Not blocking.

findings.t: Commitment panel gradient uses an untokenized #3D3D3A stop
findings.r: Either use a solid C.charcoal like the footer/CTA, or make the two stops a tokenized pair (e.g. inkSoft #403B36 → charcoal) so dark surfaces stay consistent and on-palette.

findings.t: Inconsistent content max-width and back-affordance across the four legal pages
findings.r: Standardize a prose measure (~760/42rem for text pages) and reuse the same nav back-chip on all text-heavy legal pages; keep the wider measure only for security's card grid intentionally.

findings.t: Legal pages ignore useIsMobile/useIsCompact and rely on clamp()/vw for responsiveness
findings.r: Align privacy/terms/data-deletion with security/page.tsx: import useIsMobile/useIsCompact, convert to rem, and bump nav icon targets to ≥2.75rem.

findings.t: data-deletion container has no full-width outer wrapper; safe-area padding sits on the 720px centered box
findings.r: Prioritize the i18n/nav conversion; optionally reduce side padding on very small phones via useIsSmall if 2rem feels tight at 320px.

findings.t: Security auto-fit minmax(250px) grid can overflow at 320px causing horizontal scroll
findings.r: Keep aria-hidden on decorative SVGs and the visible <h3> labels (no a11y action needed); consider minmax(0,1fr) fallback on the smallest phones to avoid 250px + 2× padding exceeding 320px.

findings.t: Relay tile content is hardcoded English — no i18n across nl/de/es/fr
findings.r: Route every title/desc/label/reason and the interview 'recorded'/'steps' datum suffixes through t() with relay.* keys added to all five messages files (en/nl/de/es/fr). This is the single biggest multimodality gap on the surface.

findings.t: Legacy LibraryIllustration paints in off-canon walnut + charcoal, not palace ink
findings.r: Rebase the Library line-art onto the anchor palette: swap walnut ink for gold/ink used on the dark keystone (#D4AF37 rimming, #403B36 or the anchor descColor for structure) and drop #1F1B1A for a warm ink, so the Library anchor matches the Palace anchor's gilt-on-ink register.

findings.t: Keeper's Ledger is dead in production — ledger prop hardcoded to null
findings.r: Pass ledger={relayLedger} to the AtriumRelay instance (matching AtriumVilla at line 842). If the ledger was intentionally cut, drop the now-unreachable weekHistory prop and the ledger/ledgerOpen code.

findings.t: datumLine (stats line) never wired to AtriumRelay — silently absent
findings.r: Add datumLine={relayDatum} to the AtriumRelay props, or remove relayDatum if the stats line is intentionally dropped from the relay layout.

findings.t: Count datums built by number+word concatenation — ungrammatical / unpluralized in de/fr/es
findings.r: Use the interpolated t('memories', { count }) / plural-aware keys already present, add a relay.recordedCount key; never hand-concatenate a number with a translated noun.

findings.t: Anchor keystone pair is locked to two columns even in mobile portrait
findings.r: Stack the anchors to a single column on portrait/mobile: gridTemplateColumns: isMobile ? '1fr' : '1fr 1fr' (ideally gate on useIsPortrait so landscape phones keep two).

findings.t: relay-suggest hover shadow breaks the 'one warm ink' shadow grammar
findings.r: Use the shared HOVER_SHADOW (rgba(64,59,54,0.16)) — or a warm-ink value at slightly higher elevation — so the suggestion card obeys the same three-step ink shadow ramp as the tiles.

findings.t: AtriumRelay re-declares RT / SHADOW / HAIRLINE locally instead of importing libraryTokens
findings.r: Import RT, SHADOW, HOVER_SHADOW, TOP_HIGHLIGHT, HAIRLINE, GOLD, EMBER, SAGE, GOLD_SOFT from src/lib/libraryTokens and delete the local copies, keeping the ACCENT/TRAY board-specific maps as the only local additions.

findings.t: Ledger warmth-strip dots + ledger accent use ochre #8A6410, an off-token gold
findings.r: Consolidate the gold ink family: use GOLD (#D4AF37) for ceremonial and GOLD_SOFT/#C99A2E for softer graphic gold, and promote #8A6410 / #E8C255 to named tokens if a darker ledger-ochre and lighter flame-gold are genuinely wanted.

findings.t: Hero selection can pick a hidden/soon tile as the lane lead via the suggestion key
findings.r: Base heroFor's share-lane choice on the same predicate as the tile's visibility (sharedWithMe.length>0 only, not sharedLoading), or have markHero re-verify the chosen hero key is in the non-hidden, loaded set.

findings.t: Several relay tile titles/reasons are hardcoded English, bypassing i18n
findings.r: Route all tile titles/descs and suggestion strings through t()/tWings as the ledger/labels already are, adding keys to messages/{en,nl,de,es,fr}.json.

findings.t: EmbersRow avatars are undersized for a comfortable touch target
findings.r: Add vertical padding so the whole cameo+name is a >=2.75rem tall tap zone, and add an edge fade / aria-describedby hint that the strip scrolls.

findings.t: Anchor illustrations are passed hover={false} — no touch/press visual feedback
findings.r: Wire the illustration's hover to the tile's hover/active state (and an :active brighten for touch) so press feedback and the lit state are reachable across input modes.

findings.t: SOON tile glyph well and label use a hard-coded grey #A9A090 outside the token set
findings.r: Use MUTED #716A5E (or a warm-stone tint) for the Soon glyph and label so the disabled state stays in the warm-ink family.

findings.t: WingFan seal count badge and dark-shadow use raw black, off the warm-ink shadow rule
findings.r: Swap rgba(0,0,0,0.35) for a warm-ink shadow such as rgba(46,42,38,0.4) so the seal fan obeys the single-ink shadow language.

findings.t: Anchor arrow and back-card arrow use different golds than the tile they sit on
findings.r: Make the arrow colour consistent per lane: drive both hero and secondary arrows from a.tileTop, or standardise all invite arrows on GOLD_SOFT.

findings.t: RelayVignettes hard-code CREAM #FCFAF5 and HAIR #E3D6BC as literals instead of tokens
findings.r: Import CREAM and HAIRLINE from libraryTokens (or T.color) and reference them so a future palette change propagates automatically.

findings.t: Retired chips path is fully dead code (relayChips always empty)
findings.r: Either remove the chips prop and its render/grid branch from AtriumRelay, or restore a real use.

findings.t: memoriesStrip mixed-count footer uses hardcoded English + non-tabular units
findings.r: Replace with an i18n string using count-aware keys (relay.stripSummary with {photos},{videos},{stories},{wings}).

findings.t: Suggestion 'letter'/'shared' can duplicate a lane tile action without dedup guard
findings.r: When a suggestion key is promoted to a lane hero, suppress the redundant top suggestion card or exclude that key from hero promotion so each action appears once.

findings.t: Back-card slide-up motion and invite arrows are entirely (hover: hover)-gated
findings.r: Provide a lightweight always-on affordance for touch (e.g. a persistent low-opacity open arrow on secondary tiles).

findings.t: PalaceSubNav spends GOLD on every generic pill border, chevron, section label and bar border — violates palace-only rule
findings.r: Reserve gold only for ceremonial cases (Palace-level pill/seal). Default breadcrumb chevrons, section labels and non-wing pill borders to MUTED #716A5E / HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, use EMBER #B85C38 (or wing accent) for the active/current pill, mirroring NavigationBar.

findings.t: Nav surfaces use warmStone→sandstone gradient glass and off-canon shadows instead of NavigationBar's linen-glass + warm-ink grammar
findings.r: Adopt NavigationBar's surface grammar: on the desktop sub-nav capsule (linen C7 glass + convert rgba(44,44,42) to rgba(64,59,54)) and on mobile bars/dropdowns swap gradient fills for flat linen glass and replace all rgba(44,44,42,x)/rgba(0,0,0,x) shadows with the warm-ink SHADOW ladder rgba(64,59,54,x).

findings.t: MobileBottomBar and PalaceSubNav run infinite/entrance animations with no prefers-reduced-motion guard
findings.r: Wrap the injected <style> keyframes in both components with a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ [data-mp-palace-bars] *, ...more-menu... { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } } block mirroring NavigationBar's KEYFRAMES.

findings.t: MobileBottomBar action/label text is 9px (0.5625rem) — below legible minimum and ignores a11y scale
findings.r: Raise the label size to at least 0.625-0.6875rem (matching NavigationBar mobile tab labels at 0.6875rem) and/or multiply by var(--a11y-scale, 1) so it grows in comfortable/large accessibility modes.

findings.t: Dark scrim/overlay colors are off-canon umber-black, not warm ink
findings.r: Standardize scrims on a warm-ink wash, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.35).

findings.t: Sub-nav and bottom bar mix px borders instead of the canon rem hairlines
findings.r: Replace 1px/1.5px/2px border literals with 0.0625rem/0.09375rem/0.125rem to match NavigationBar and let borders scale with a11y-scale.

findings.t: MobileBottomBar and TopBar mobile menu rely entirely on emoji glyphs for iconography, breaking consistency with the crafted SVG icon system
findings.r: Replace emoji with the app's stroke SVG icon components tinted MUTED/accent, matching the NavigationBar/PalaceSubNav icon language.

findings.t: Mobile 'Enter' portico uses a saturated gold→terracotta→walnut radial gradient — heavy ceremonial gold on an ordinary nav commit control
findings.r: Reground the active Enter state on EMBER (interactive) with at most a subtle gold seam, dropping the full gold radial + glow.

findings.t: WingsDropdown trigger shows untranslated raw wing name
findings.r: Wrap with translateWingName: {activeWingData ? translateWingName(activeWingData, tWings) : tc('palaceMap')}.

findings.t: Shared-wing display name is fabricated from the slug instead of the real name
findings.r: Pass the shared wing's real display name through SharedWingItem (add a name field populated when shares are fetched) and render translateWingName/that name; fall back to slug only if missing.

findings.t: Bottom-bar and palace-subnav actions use emoji glyphs as the sole icon layer — cross-platform multimodal risk
findings.r: Migrate action glyphs to the inline-SVG icon set used by NavigationBar/WingRoomIcons so rendering is deterministic across devices and themeable to canon colors.

findings.t: Shared-wing names shown untranslated/raw-cased instead of via translateWingName
findings.r: Resolve shared wings to a WingItem (or map slug to nameKey) and render with translateWingName/tWings; if user-custom-named, pass its real name.

findings.t: PalaceSubNav room breadcrumb pill renders roomName prop raw (not translated) while other room labels use translateRoomName
findings.r: Have callers pass a nameKey (or the RoomItem) into PalaceSubNav so the breadcrumb runs through translateRoomName like the dropdown entries.

findings.t: PalaceSubNav wing dropdowns use pure-white glass instead of NavigationBar's linen glass
findings.r: Match NavigationBar menus: linen glass background and warm-ink shadow (rgba(64,59,54,x)), drop the gold 1px inset ring.

findings.t: TopBar section-header letter-spacing is in rem, producing inconsistent small-caps tracking vs the em-based canon overline
findings.r: Express small-caps tracking in em (e.g. 0.06em) to match the RT overline voice.

findings.t: getProgress() is invoked unconditionally on every MobileBottomBar render
findings.r: Move the getProgress() call inside the exploreItems/awards build block (or memoize gated on moreMenuOpen) so it only runs when the More menu is rendered.

findings.t: Room pill uses non-null assertion on a wingId that can be null
findings.r: Only map focusRooms when focusWingId is truthy, and drop the ! in favor of an explicit if (!focusWingId) return; early-out.

findings.t: Unused useMemo import in TopBar (dead import)
findings.r: Remove useMemo from the import.

findings.t: Desktop scroll-shrink and pulse animations lack an in-JS reduced-motion consideration for transform-based movement
findings.r: When adding reduced-motion guards to PalaceSubNav/MobileBottomBar, include transition: none !important as well as animation: none, matching NavigationBar, so inline-style transitions are also stilled.

findings.t: No multimodal capture entry point (voice/photo/camera) surfaced in the primary nav despite app being capture-centric
findings.r: Consider a split/long-press on the accent Add button offering photo / camera / voice-note capture directly, so common multimodal inputs are one tap from the nav.

findings.t: GOLD is misused as the primary text/accent voice throughout the tutorial
findings.r: Set titles to INK #403B36 (or EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A for accent), make the highlight ring/pulse EMBER #B85C38 (interactive), and reserve GOLD only if you truly want a ceremonial focus ring — not for body headings.

findings.t: SettingsTutorial is entirely off-canon dark bronze-glass, clashing with the CREAM app
findings.r: Re-skin the tutorial cards to canon: cardBg = CREAM/TRAY (#FCFAF5 or #F6EBE3), border 1px HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, warm-ink shadow from the SHADOW ramp, INK text. Mirror the /help C.* remap so the two Help surfaces read as one system.

findings.t: Raw black shadows and black scrim instead of warm-ink canon values (Settings tutorial)
findings.r: Swap shadows to the SHADOW ramp (e.g. 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)) and the modal scrim to a warm-ink veil (e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.45)) for consistency with sibling overlays.

findings.t: Tutorial Subscription bullet uses stale iOS-only gate, contradicting the IAP_ENABLED tab filter
findings.r: Import IAP_ENABLED and match the layout filter: !(isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED && f.titleKey === 'feat_subscription_title') so the tutorial bullet list stays consistent with which tabs are actually visible.

findings.t: SettingsInline hides the Subscription tab on iOS even when IAP is live — inconsistent with settings/layout
findings.r: Align SettingsInline with settings/layout: !(item.hideInNative && isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED). Then also fix the tutorial gate (previous finding) so all three surfaces agree.

findings.t: Tutorial mixes px and rem for the highlight cutout geometry
findings.r: Express pad/radius in rem (e.g. 0.375rem / 0.75rem) or derive from tokens so the cutout scales with the type ramp.

findings.t: Tutorial 'Skip' control is very low-contrast and small for a canon touch target
findings.r: After the canon re-skin, use MUTED #716A5E on cream for Skip and ensure both controls reach the 2.75rem min touch height with adequate padding.

findings.t: No client-side attachment size check — oversized files upload fully before the server rejects them
findings.r: In the file onChange, check file.size > 5*1024*1024 and set an inline error (with a dedicated i18n key) instead of accepting the file, so the user learns the limit before uploading.

findings.t: Success email is sent to the user even if the support email to the team silently failed
findings.r: Check the support-send response (and the missing-key case); if delivery to the team fails, return an error (or persist the ticket to a DB table) instead of returning ok and emailing the user a false confirmation.

findings.t: Tutorial dialog has no focus trap, focus-on-open, or Escape-to-close
findings.r: On open, focus the primary button; add a keydown handler for Escape to call onClose; and trap focus between Skip and Next/Done to satisfy the aria-modal contract it advertises.

findings.t: Help page does no responsive-hook branching — relies solely on clamp/maxWidth
findings.r: Add a useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() check to shrink or hide the wordmark text on very narrow viewports and to reduce success-panel padding, matching inline-hook responsiveness used elsewhere.

findings.t: FAQ accordion toggle exposes no expanded/controls semantics
findings.r: Add aria-expanded={openFaq === i} and aria-controls pointing to an id on the answer div (give the answer role region/labelledby) so the disclosure state is announced.

findings.t: /help error text and success color lean on non-canon token names
findings.r: Confirm SAGE #56683C is the intended success hue and align C.sage to it, or restyle the success panel with HAIRLINE border + EMBER checkmark to stay inside the canon palette.

findings.t: /help nav back-button and select borders use ad-hoc alpha suffixes rather than a token step
findings.r: Consolidate to one or two canonical hairline treatments (full HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for active, a single softened step for rest) so borders read uniformly across Help and sibling settings pages.

findings.t: useSettingsTutorial is invoked in two mounted shells; ?tour=1 reset logic runs twice
findings.r: Centralize the ?tour=1 bootstrap (run once in a single settings root) and let secondary shells only read useSettingsTourStore(open) without re-running the reset, to avoid duplicate portals.

findings.t: STORAGE_KEY (mp_settings_tour_seen_v2) is written but never read to gate auto-open — dead persistence
findings.r: Either remove the unused STORAGE_KEY read/write and correct the 'auto first visit' comments, or restore an actual first-visit auto-open that reads the flag — pick one so code and comments agree.

findings.t: Tutorial tooltip width reads window.innerWidth outside a reactive path
findings.r: Derive tooltip width/position from the same resize-tracked state that updates targetBox so re-layout is guaranteed on rotation even if the target rect is unchanged.

findings.t: Analytics OFF toggle does not disable analytics (removes key instead of setting "0")
findings.r: For the analytics category, write '0' instead of removing on OFF (localStorage.setItem(storageKey,'0')), mirroring the banner's contract exactly — ideally via an explicit per-category off-value or a special-case for mp-cookie-analytics.

findings.t: Cookie toggles never take effect in the live session (no init/opt-out call)
findings.r: In handleCookieToggle, after persisting, import { initAnalytics, optOutAnalytics } and for the analytics key call newValue ? initAnalytics() : optOutAnalytics().

findings.t: Preferences cookie toggle is a fully dead control
findings.r: Either wire mp-cookie-consent to actual preference behavior (and read it where preferences apply) or remove the Preferences category from COOKIE_CATEGORIES so the UI doesn't imply a control with no effect.

findings.t: Security section-overline i18n keys missing in ALL 5 locales
findings.r: Add sectionSignInAccess/sectionPrivacyData/sectionDangerZone to securityPage in all 5 files (translated) so the tf() fallback becomes a dead safety net.

findings.t: Cookie-consent toggle is a 1.625rem-tall touch target
findings.r: Grow the toggle to >=2.75rem tall, or wrap it in a >=2.75rem tap target (padding on a label/button whose visual thumb stays small) so the whole row toggles consent.

findings.t: Security tokens re-declared locally instead of imported (renamed EMBER_GLYPH)
findings.r: Import INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/SAGE/HAIRLINE/CREAM from libraryTokens; rename local TERRA to EMBER_GLYPH.

findings.t: Undocumented off-canon 'danger' color ramp (8 hexes) not in tokens
findings.r: Add a DANGER ramp to libraryTokens and reference it so the danger register is canon-backed.

findings.t: Security input fontSize 0.9375rem below the iOS-zoom-safe 1rem
findings.r: Bump inputStyle.fontSize to 1rem (at minimum on the destructive delete-confirm input).

findings.t: Analytics toggle checked state can display out of sync with runtime
findings.r: Derive the toggle's checked state from hasAnalyticsConsent() rather than a raw '1' string check.

findings.t: Security page never adapts card padding for phone/iPad portrait
findings.r: Derive padding from useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() (reduce to ~1rem on mobile).

findings.t: useIsMobile only gates the header — cards keep desktop padding on mobile
findings.r: Derive card horizontal padding from isMobile (e.g. 1.25rem vs 1.75rem).

findings.t: Error toast red #C05050 off-canon while success correctly uses SAGE
findings.r: Replace #C05050 with a DANGER token once the ramp is added.

findings.t: Commitment 'keystone' panel uses off-canon second ink #2E2A26
findings.r: Add an INK_DEEP token (#2E2A26) or reuse an existing shadow-ink value.

findings.t: deleteConfirmDescription bold-split silently drops text if placeholders missing
findings.r: Fall back to the raw string when parts.length<3 and add a test asserting {boldStart}/{boldEnd} exist per locale.

findings.t: Password reset success shows generic toast even with no email on file
findings.r: Surface a distinct message for social-login-only accounts and avoid the optimistic success in the unconfigured-env branch.

findings.t: ExportPanel hardcodes 1px borders and raw px sizes instead of rem
findings.r: Convert non-hairline px sizing to rem; keep 1px only for true hairlines.

findings.t: Danger-zone destructive nature isn't announced to AT
findings.r: Wrap in <section role='region' aria-labelledby='danger-zone-heading'> with an id on the heading.

findings.t: Notifications loading state is unstyled bare text, breaking the card canon
findings.r: Render skeleton card placeholders (SectionOverline + hairline cards with shimmer rows at TRAY #F6EBE3) matching the real layout, or at minimum wrap loading in the same SettingsPageHeader + card shell.

findings.t: Category toggle treats HTTP error responses (500/401/429) as success — silent data loss
findings.r: Capture the response: const res = await fetch(...); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(String(res.status)); so the existing catch rolls back and shows saveFailed. Surface the 429 case distinctly.

findings.t: Push-category PATCH updates zero rows when no push_subscriptions row exists
findings.r: After the update, verify affected-row count (use .select('id') and check length) or upsert keyed on user_id; on 0 rows return 409/400 so the client can prompt re-enable. Also re-hydrate push categories from push_subscriptions on mount, as email prefs already are.

findings.t: Notification toggle switches have no accessible name
findings.r: Add a label prop to ToggleSwitch and pass aria-label={t(cat.titleKey)}, or give each <h4> an id and set aria-labelledby. For the main push toggle pass t('pushNotifications').

findings.t: Notification toggle height 1.75rem (28px) is far below the 2.75rem touch minimum
findings.r: Keep the 1.75rem visual pill but expand the tap area to >=2.75rem via a min-height flex wrapper or vertical padding (padding:'0.5rem 0') with a fixed visual knob.

findings.t: Push-notification section is hidden on desktop web entirely (isMobile gate)
findings.r: Gate on capability, not viewport: show whenever !nativeApp && ('Notification' in window). Reserve isMobile for layout tweaks only, not feature hiding.

findings.t: Notifications: raw hex literals inlined instead of importing named tokens
findings.r: Import INK/MUTED/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE/TRAY and pass EMBER_GLYPH as a color prop into the 13 icon SVGs.

findings.t: Icon-tile OFF background #F6EBE3 hardcoded instead of TRAY token
findings.r: Replace #F6EBE3 literals with the TRAY token.

findings.t: Master push toggle can leave server subscribed while local pushEnabled stays false on failure
findings.r: Wrap the enable body in try/finally and reset subscribingRef/setSubscribing in finally, or reset on every early return.

findings.t: iPad portrait (768-1024px) falls through the isMobile gate and loses the push section
findings.r: Use useIsCompact() (max-width:1024px) or capability-based gating so iPad portrait is included.

findings.t: Push-toggle title serif vs Source-Sans sub-item titles — abrupt type-hierarchy split
findings.r: Confirm the split is intended; if softening, keep the serif header and render sub-titles at RT.body or bump to titleS serif for a two-tier hierarchy.

findings.t: Inconsistent divider strategy between PUSH and EMAIL maps (unused index i)
findings.r: Share one divider rule; drop the unused i param.

findings.t: Push store not persisted per-user — prefs leak across accounts on shared device
findings.r: Scope the storage key by user id or hydrate push-category prefs from push_subscriptions on mount.

findings.t: Duplicate <style> block injected once per ToggleSwitch (~11 copies)
findings.r: Hoist the <style> block to the page component or a global stylesheet.

findings.t: Notifications loading state uses a hardcoded English fallback
findings.r: Rely on t('loading') (present in all locales) or a neutral non-text spinner.

findings.t: LegacyPanel.tsx runs on the legacy warm-stone palette, out of sync with the reskinned page
findings.r: Reskin LegacyPanel to match page.tsx: CREAM/#FCFAF5 surfaces, EFF2E8/sage or terracotta medallion pills instead of sandstone alpha, and the same card/shadow grammar.

findings.t: LegacyPanel scrim uses off-canon dark umber
findings.r: Change the scrim to rgba(64,59,54,0.35) to match the ConfirmModal / Atrium warm-ink scrim.

findings.t: Adding a legacy contact with an existing email appends a duplicate card
findings.r: Dedupe by id when merging (replace if result.contact.id already in state, else append), or have createLegacyContact report inserted-vs-updated and toast accordingly.

findings.t: Two divergent legacy contact data models coexist (LegacyPanel vs settings page)
findings.r: Consolidate both surfaces onto one action module and one field/enum vocabulary, or retire LegacyPanel now the full settings page exists. At minimum map selected_wings<->wings_only and accessible_wings<->wing_access.

findings.t: updateLegacyContact lacks the migration-012 fallback createLegacyContact has
findings.r: Mirror the create-path fallback: on a wing_access/room_access column error, strip those keys from payload and retry the update.

findings.t: Legacy text inputs, textarea and date picker use fontSize 0.9375rem — iOS focus zoom
findings.r: Set inputStyle.fontSize to '1rem' and remove the textarea's 0.9375rem override so all controls render >=16px.

findings.t: LegacyPanel primary CTA is a terracotta gradient; page.tsx uses flat EMBER
findings.r: Replace the gradient with flat EMBER #B85C38 so both Legacy surfaces share one primary-button look.

findings.t: LegacyPanel inputs and buttons have no visible focus ring
findings.r: Add the GOLD :focus-visible ring (0.1875rem solid #D4AF37, offset 0.1875rem) via a shared class.

findings.t: Legacy page.tsx ships responsive @media in <style>, violating inline-styles-only canon
findings.r: Drive the full/short tab-label swap from useIsCompact()/useIsMobile() and render inline, removing the @media (reduced-motion may remain).

findings.t: Empty-body warning toast is immediately overwritten by the save-success toast
findings.r: Gate save behind a confirm modal when body is empty, or drop the warning.

findings.t: Retry-delivery does a full window.location.reload(), discarding unsaved state
findings.r: Replace reload with a state refresh (re-run loadData) so in-flight edits are preserved.

findings.t: LegacyPanel toggle buttons lack aria-pressed
findings.r: Add aria-pressed and wrap each group in role=group with aria-labelledby, mirroring page.tsx.

findings.t: LegacyPanel remove button deletes a contact with no confirmation
findings.r: Gate removal behind a ConfirmModal, as the settings page does.

findings.t: LegacyPanel Roman-temple icon mixes EMBER center column among glyph columns
findings.r: Stroke all five columns in EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A at uniform 1.5 weight.

findings.t: Delivery-body preview uses full-strength MUTED, losing secondary hierarchy
findings.r: Give the preview a distinct treatment (italic or a HAIRLINE left-rule) so it reads as an excerpt.

findings.t: Two disabled-button token values coexist for the same state
findings.r: Promote the disabled fill (#EEE9DF) and text (#716A5E) into a named DISABLED token.

findings.t: Progress bar treats settings===null and default settings as identical
findings.r: Distinguish not-yet-configured (null) from an active record in the status copy.

findings.t: handleTabSwitch dep array omits handlers; Arrow nav may act on stale activeSection
findings.r: Move focus only after the switch commits, or in an effect keyed on activeSection.

findings.t: Dead focus-visible CSS (.mp-settings-input) injected but never applied
findings.r: Apply the class to inputs or delete the settingsFocusStyle block.

findings.t: LegacyPanel uses no responsive hooks; padding/typography don't adapt
findings.r: Adopt useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() to tune header padding and body font.

findings.t: Corridor picker stale-closure race silently drops a just-assigned painting
findings.r: Use the functional-updater form of setPaintings(prev => ...) inside handleAssign/handleUpload/handleClear and persist from the computed `next`, removing `paintings` from the dependency arrays. This eliminates the stale-snapshot race entirely.

findings.t: currentPaintings prop only seeds initial state — external changes never propagate into the open panel
findings.r: Add useEffect(() => setPaintings(currentPaintings), [currentPaintings]) (or key the panel on wing.id) so external updates flow in, and remove the unused import if truly not needed.

findings.t: Corridor picker modal has no focus trap, no aria-modal, no Escape handler
findings.r: Give the inner picker container role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label={t('title')}, wire a second useFocusTrap, and add onKeyDown to close on Escape. Move initial focus to the modal and restore focus to the originating slot button on close.

findings.t: Bust name inputs use sub-1rem fontSize → iOS auto-zoom on focus
findings.r: Set fontSize:'1rem' on both <input> elements (bust-name-plaque line 305 and bust-name-ready line 526). Reduce visual size via padding/height if a smaller footprint is needed, but keep the font at 1rem.

findings.t: Bust builder status pills use fully off-canon green/orange Material palette
findings.r: Replace both constants with warm-canon tokens: success from SAGE (#56683C on a rustTint/sage-tint bg), warning from EMBER (#B85C38 on creamGlow/rustTint), with warm-ink hairline borders. Derive from T.color/libraryTokens rather than free hex.

findings.t: Leftover dark bronze gradient in the renaissance bust silhouette
findings.r: Re-tone the renaissance silhouette to a warm patinated bronze in the palette (e.g. T.color.walnut → a lighter sandstone, or a rustDeep-derived warm ramp) so the loading illustration stays inside the cream/terracotta family.

findings.t: Primary bust CTAs use terracotta→walnut gradient instead of canon EMBER interactive color
findings.r: Swap the CTA fill to flat EMBER #B85C38 or the landing ctaGrad (linear-gradient(135deg,#9A4F2A,#6B3318)) so bust builder buttons match the ember CTA convention.

findings.t: Off-canon near-black text + pure-black overlays instead of warm ink in bust builder
findings.r: Route text to INK #403B36 (T.color.inkSoft), secondary to MUTED #716A5E; recolor every scrim/shadow to warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x). Replace rgba(0,0,0,*) with warm equivalents.

findings.t: Hairline borders use CREAM instead of canon HAIRLINE in corridor gallery
findings.r: Standardize hairline borders on canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC across both panels so slot tiles and modal edges are visible; reserve cream for fills only.

findings.t: Emoji camera glyph as the upload illustration breaks the icon system
findings.r: Replace the camera emoji and inline check/warning glyphs with stroked SVG icons (camera/upload in EMBER/accent, check/warning in SAGE/EMBER) matching the app's icon system.

findings.t: Corridor gallery lists source memories by raw mem.title, ignoring titleKey — seeded memories show untranslated English
findings.r: Resolve the display title via titleKey when present (mirror the room-name pattern: `(mem.titleKey && t(mem.titleKey)) || mem.title`).

findings.t: Bust preview WebGL renderer not disposed if the panel unmounts before/during the 'done' transition
findings.r: Call el.__cleanup() at the START of renderBustPreview before creating a new renderer, and force GL context loss (renderer.forceContextLoss()) in cleanup; hold the renderer in a ref disposed in a stage-scoped effect.

findings.t: handleCreate has no guard on croppedFace failure — silently builds a bust from an un-cropped preview; objectURL leak
findings.r: Revoke the previous objectURL when replacing preview and on unmount (track in a ref, URL.revokeObjectURL on cleanup/next upload); add a guard on croppedFace failure.

findings.t: Reset-all clears overrides but does not restore DEFAULT_CORRIDOR_PAINTINGS, contradicting the 'Reset to defaults' label
findings.r: Reset to defaults: use `const def = DEFAULT_CORRIDOR_PAINTINGS[wing.id] ? {...DEFAULT_CORRIDOR_PAINTINGS[wing.id]} : {}` and save/emit that; or remove the localStorage key so loadCorridorPaintings re-applies defaults.

findings.t: Remove-painting control is a role=button span nested inside a button and below 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Render the slot as a non-button container with two sibling <button>s (choose + remove), or move remove into the picker modal; make remove a real <button> with hit-slop >=2.75rem.

findings.t: Source filter (all/wing) buttons lack radiogroup/aria-pressed semantics; no-op ternary in grid columns
findings.r: Wrap filter buttons in role='radiogroup' with each role='radio' aria-checked (or add aria-pressed). Also gridTemplateColumns repeat(${isMobile?2:2},1fr) is a no-op ternary — simplify or make mobile 1 column.

findings.t: Corridor animations run without prefers-reduced-motion guards
findings.r: Gate animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check so entrance slides and infinite pulses are disabled when the OS requests reduced motion.

findings.t: Picker upload/filter buttons use minHeight 2.5rem, below 2.75rem touch minimum
findings.r: Raise minHeight to 2.75rem for the upload and filter buttons.

findings.t: Bust profile persistence best-effort .catch(()=>{}) swallows all server failures with no user feedback
findings.r: Capture the rejection and surface a non-blocking warning ('Saved locally — will sync when online') or set stage='error' on hard failure.

findings.t: Calibration status messages from detectAndCropFace are hardcoded English, shown verbatim in Ready stage
findings.r: Return a message key/enum from detectAndCropFace and translate in the component via t(), rather than returning localized prose from the 3D util.

findings.t: 3D bust preview renders at fixed pixels, ignoring the rem/responsive canon
findings.r: Derive renderer size from the container's measured clientWidth/clientHeight (or root font-size) so the WebGL preview scales with rem/accessibility zoom.

findings.t: No visible focus ring on corridor slot tiles / picker rows / chips
findings.r: Add the canon gold :focus-visible ring (libraryTokens focusRing) to tile buttons, picker rows, filter chips, close buttons and CTAs in both panels.

findings.t: No useIsPortrait/orientation handling in either corridor panel despite canon toolkit
findings.r: Use useIsPortrait() to switch the ready-stage crop preview to a vertical stack in portrait and tighten vertical padding in landscape, reducing scroll on short viewports.

findings.t: Routing silently drops captures when the server routes nothing (data desync)
findings.r: Have routeCaptures parse the JSON `results` and only remove the ids the server actually reports as routed (and surface a message for the rest). On the API side, distinguish a partial/empty result from full success (e.g. return the skipped ids) rather than always returning 200.

findings.t: Pending page's AI-suggestion box uses off-canon cold blue hex
findings.r: Replace with a warm token treatment: background `${T.color.gold}0D` or `${T.color.sage}12`, border `1px solid ${T.color.gold}35` (mirroring the gold phone-pill pattern already used on keps/page.tsx), so the AI hint feels native to the palace.

findings.t: Pending page headings render in default sans, not Fraunces
findings.r: Add fontFamily: T.font.display to the h1/h2 headings and T.font.body to paragraphs/labels/buttons, matching the stepTitle/stepDesc style objects on keps/page.tsx.

findings.t: Pending page uses px for input fontSize instead of rem 1rem
findings.r: Change to fontSize: "1rem" to satisfy both the rem-sizing rule and the no-iOS-zoom requirement in one canonical value.

findings.t: Pending page has raw white hex and inconsistent button styling vs canon CTAs
findings.r: Use T.color.cream instead of "#fff", raise radius to 0.5rem, and route the primary action through an EMBER/terracotta CTA style consistent with btnPrimary on keps/page.tsx; reserve red only for the destructive reject action.

findings.t: Store errors are never surfaced on the pending page
findings.r: Destructure `error` from useKepStore and render an error banner (with a retry that calls fetchPendingCaptures) distinct from the empty state; also surface route/reject failures via a toast or inline message.

findings.t: GOLD spent on a generic phone-number pill (ceremonial-color misuse)
findings.r: Recolor the pill with EMBER/terracotta or walnut ink and keep gold reserved for genuinely ceremonial framing.

findings.t: Emoji glyphs used for empty/loading state and media icons instead of canon SVG iconography
findings.r: Replace the empty-state emoji with a small warm SVG (stroke C.sage/C.walnut) and swap media/AI emoji for the app's SVG icon set.

findings.t: Loading and empty states lack Fraunces heading + warm styling / spacing rhythm
findings.r: Wrap empty/loading in a centered TuscanCard-lite block, give the h2 F.display, use inkSoft/muted per canon, and add the shared fade-slide-up animation.

findings.t: Hardcoded English 'Select all' string bypasses i18n
findings.r: Add a 'selectAll' key to the kep section of all five message files and render {t("selectAll", { count: String(pendingCaptures.length) })}.

findings.t: formatPhone / vCard mishandle short or malformed phone numbers
findings.r: Guard the Save/WhatsApp/copy controls (disable or hide) when !waPhone, and validate digit length before rendering the pill / building the vCard.

findings.t: "Copy" secondary button on keps page is below 2.75rem touch height
findings.r: Add minHeight: "2.75rem" (and adequate horizontal padding) to btnPrimary, btnSecondary, and btnWhatsApp so all tappable CTAs meet the touch minimum on phones.

findings.t: SVG flow-illustration labels are hardcoded English, not translated
findings.r: Add a kepLanding.flowRoomLabel key across the 5 locales and pass t() into the illustration for the 'Your Room' caption.

findings.t: Two surfaces diverge on background + text tokens (linen/charcoal vs canon CREAM/INK)
findings.r: Standardize both palace-kep surfaces on CREAM (#FCFAF5) page background and INK (#403B36) primary text (theme exposes inkSoft = #403B36); set an explicit background on the pending page.

findings.t: NavigationBar highlights 'Atrium' while on the Keps page
findings.r: Either pass no active highlight for this sub-route or add explicit handling so no primary tab reads as active while on the Keps landing.

findings.t: pending page fetch has no dependency-stability guard against duplicate fetches
findings.r: Add a simple in-flight flag (or AbortController) so concurrent fetchPendingCaptures calls are deduped/cancelled.

findings.t: vCard contact name is hardcoded English, downloaded onto every user's phone
findings.r: Source FN/ORG/NOTE from t() (e.g. kepLanding.vcardName / vcardNote) so the saved contact matches the user's locale.

findings.t: Command chips 'ROOM Kitchen / NEW Holidays / ROOMS' hardcoded in JSX array
