findings.r: If the WhatsApp bot accepts localized room names, move the example arguments (Kitchen/Holidays) into i18n; otherwise add a short localized caption clarifying these are English commands.

findings.t: AI-suggestion banner and status colors bypass canon and reduced-motion/contrast norms
findings.r: Recolor the suggestion banner with C.sage/C.gold tokens, and gate the keps-page entrance animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check.

findings.t: InterviewPanel is a full-screen DARK bronze-glass surface — the exact off-canon relic the design system forbids
findings.r: Reskin InterviewPanel onto the cream Atrium canon like its siblings: CREAM/linen surface, INK text, HAIRLINE #E3D6BC borders, EMBER #B85C38 for the record/CTA gradient, SAGE #56683C for AI reflections, warm-ink SHADOW ramp. Delete the DARK/DARK_PALETTE constants entirely so the three interview surfaces read as one cont

findings.t: Interactive/CTA gradients use T.color.terracotta #C66B3D, not canon EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Import EMBER from libraryTokens and use it (with EMBER_GLYPH/walnut for gradient depth) for all interactive surfaces, matching the Library's in-progress ember. Stop routing interactive color through the legacy T.color.terracotta.

findings.t: AI 'sage' accent uses T.color.sage #4A6741, off from canon SAGE #56683C used in siblings
findings.r: Use SAGE #56683C (and SAGE_SOFT #7A8C64) from libraryTokens for all AI-reflection surfaces so the interview's green matches the completed-check / sage medallions in the History and Library panels.

findings.t: Quota respawn line renders an unreplaced {date} token AND a duplicate date
findings.r: Pass the date into t as a param and drop the manual append: t("nextInterviewDate", { date: new Date(quota.nextRespawnDate).toLocaleDateString(locale as string) }). Remove the trailing {...toLocaleDateString()} expression.

findings.t: Missing i18n keys interviewsRemaining / upgradeForUnlimited make the || fallbacks dead and text English-only
findings.r: Add interviewsRemaining and upgradeForUnlimited to the interview section of all 5 message files. The `|| fallback` pattern is not a safety net here because t() never returns empty; the keys must exist.

findings.t: Quota / upsell strings hardcoded in English across ALL 5 locales
findings.r: Add interviewQuotaReached, interviewsRemaining, nextInterviewDate, upgradeForUnlimited to the interview section of all five message files and drop the `|| "..."` English literals. Since the key is missing even in en.json, this is currently broken for every language, not just translations.

findings.t: Emoji fallbacks in History panel break the hand-drawn line-art icon system
findings.r: Replace both emoji with the existing stroke icons (InterviewIcon fallback star for the in-progress row; a line-art microphone/InterviewIcon at wing-accent color for the empty state) so every icon in the feature shares the same warm line-art language.

findings.t: Surface background uses T.color.linen #F2EDE4 instead of canon CREAM #FCFAF5
findings.r: Set the drawer surface to CREAM #FCFAF5 (or TRAY #F6EBE3 for a deliberately recessed sandstone tray) to match the canon board color; reserve linen for genuinely lifted card bands, not the base surface.

findings.t: Progress bar and record ripple mix an ad-hoc peach #D4A07A / #D4926A outside the token set
findings.r: During the canon reskin, collapse these peaches into the EMBER ramp (EMBER #B85C38 -> EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A / walnut) so the whole feature uses one interactive orange rather than terracotta + two peaches.

findings.t: autoSummaryTriggered ref is never reset — a second interview in the same mount silently cannot auto-summarize
findings.r: Reset autoSummaryTriggered.current = false in handleStart (or in a useEffect keyed on currentSession?.id) so each session can auto-summarize.

findings.t: Skipping every question produces a 'completed' interview with an empty/placeholder narrative
findings.r: Guard completion when responses.length === 0: either keep the session in_progress and show an empty-state message, or block Save Story until at least one response exists.

findings.t: processResponse error-branch completion check uses potentially stale isComplete
findings.r: Drop the stale isComplete term and rely solely on the index comparison, matching handleContinue's logic, to avoid confusion/regression.

findings.t: Blocking native confirm() dialog used for leave-confirmation (bypasses the design system)
findings.r: Replace the native confirm/alert with an in-canon confirmation sheet/modal (CREAM surface, INK text, EMBER primary + muted secondary button), focus-managed, consistent with the app's other custom dialogs.

findings.t: Recording waveform / timer / live-transcript region has no aria-live announcement
findings.r: Wrap the recording status/timer and the live transcript preview in role='status' aria-live='polite' so state changes are announced. The apiError already uses role='alert' (good) — apply the same pattern here.

findings.t: Stop-recording button uses raw red #C75040/#A03030 — off-palette alarm color
findings.r: Recolor the stop control to the EMBER ramp (an active pulsing EMBER dot) so 'recording/stop' stays inside the warm system, or at minimum align to canon T.color.error #C05050 rather than a bespoke brighter red.

findings.t: Mobile recording waveform animates only in 250ms steps (Date.now() read in render with no rAF driver)
findings.r: Drive the mobile waveform with its own rAF/short-interval tick (~60ms useState counter) or a pure CSS keyframe animation, instead of relying on the 250ms recordingSeconds re-render.

findings.t: Speech-unsupported users are silently forced to text but the mode toggle can leave inputMode='voice' after an error
findings.r: Optional: keep the apiError visible in text mode and/or leave inputMode unchanged so users who genuinely want voice can retry without re-toggling.

findings.t: Horizontal wing-filter tab strip has no scroll affordance or aria semantics on small screens
findings.r: Add a subtle fade/scroll affordance and consider scroll-snap; optionally add role='tablist' + aria-selected on FilterTab for a11y.

findings.t: Copied share LINK is non-functional — lands on an empty passcode form
findings.r: Embed the code (or slug) in the URL, e.g. `${origin}/passcode?code=${createdShare.passcode}` (or /passcode/${slug}), and in PasscodeEntry read the param on mount (useSearchParams) to pre-fill `code` and optionally auto-validate, making the link self-contained.

findings.t: Primary CTAs painted GOLD, violating the 'gold is palace-only' rule
findings.r: Repaint primary CTAs with EMBER (#B85C38) — solid fill or ember->rustDeep gradient — and reserve gold strictly for focus rings / ceremonial framing.

findings.t: Selection/active state (wing & expiry chips) tinted GOLD instead of EMBER
findings.r: Drive selected/active chip and checkbox accentColor with EMBER (#B85C38) at rest-to-active; keep gold out of toggle states entirely.

findings.t: Multi-wing selection silently drops all but the first wing
findings.r: Either loop createPasscode over every selectedWingIds entry and surface a combined result, or constrain the picker to single-select (radio semantics) so the UI matches one-wing-per-share behavior.

findings.t: Block failure shows raw window.alert with a hardcoded English string
findings.r: Replace with an inline error state (like the report dialog's role='alert' block) or a branded toast, using a translated key such as t('safetyBlockError'); do not surface the raw server error string to users.

findings.t: Cold black overlays/shadows instead of warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
findings.r: Replace overlay/shadow rgba with warm ink: scrims rgba(64,59,54,0.5), shadows via SHADOW/HOVER_SHADOW tokens.

findings.t: BlockedAccountsPanel uses hardcoded #FFF surface and cream (not HAIRLINE) borders
findings.r: Use cream/linen surface and canon hairline #E3D6BC borders.

findings.t: Secondary text uses walnut #8B7355 rather than canon MUTED #716A5E
findings.r: Use T.color.muted for secondary/hint text and ghost-button labels; prefer canon #716A5E.

findings.t: No focus-ring / visible focus styling; gold canon focus ring unused
findings.r: Apply the canon gold focus ring on keyboard focus for chips, copy buttons and modal actions.

findings.t: Report dialog error state not cleared when the dialog is reopened
findings.r: Add setError(false) alongside setDone(false) in the report menu-item onClick.

findings.t: getMyPasscodes failure is swallowed with no user feedback
findings.r: Add a .catch and handle res.ok===false to set a lightweight inline notice.

findings.t: Motion effects have no reduced-motion guard
findings.r: Read a usePrefersReducedMotion()/matchMedia hook and drop transitions (and optionally blur) when reduced motion is requested.

findings.t: Dialogs lack focus trap, initial focus, and focus restoration
findings.r: Focus first control on open, trap Tab, restore focus to opener on close, add Escape-to-close to the SafetyMenu report dialog.

findings.t: Menu popover and dialogs never consult responsive hooks (mobile/portrait)
findings.r: Use useIsMobile()/useIsPortrait() to promote the safety menu and long PasscodeModal to a bottom-sheet on phones.

findings.t: Native emoji glyphs as iconography — inconsistent, unstyled polish
findings.r: Replace literal glyphs with the project's SVG/icon components, sized in rem and canon-colored.

findings.t: Custom passcode length not validated before submit; round-trip failure only
findings.r: Validate customPasscode length (4-20) client-side and disable create / show inline hint when invalid.

findings.t: Radio and checkbox labels give an undersized tap surface
findings.r: Give radio/checkbox label rows minHeight 2.75rem and align-items center.

findings.t: USP shell surface & shadow palette diverge from canon tokens (TRAY, warm-ink shadow)
findings.r: Align to libraryTokens: surface TRAY #F6EBE3, base shadows on the warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) SHADOW ramp.

findings.t: PalaceCard header renders the sub-brand name twice
findings.r: Drop the duplicated palaceName plaque row so there is one name beat per card across the family.

findings.t: Kep header uses U.dark near-black circles that read off-canon against cream
findings.r: Swap the avatar fill from U.dark to canon INK #403B36 (or the warm brown EMBER_GLYPH); keep the gold glyph for the ceremonial porter mark.

findings.t: Kep card body is markedly taller than PalaceCard body — uneven grid rhythm
findings.r: Standardize the body content area to a shared min-height/aspect token in UspCardShell so all USP cards align on a consistent height.

findings.t: PalaceCard pills/stems stay invisible if the perf-gate never fires (JS-disabled / IO-unsupported)
findings.r: Give the pills/stems a visible resting state independent of JS, or a no-JS fallback so labels are shown rather than hidden without the perf gate.

findings.t: PalaceCard uses @container/@media breakpoints instead of the mandated hooks
findings.r: If kept as an intentional container-query exception, document it explicitly so future audits don't revert it; otherwise thread width via ResizeObserver and inline the values.

findings.t: USP shell outer box-shadow uses px, not rem
findings.r: Convert to rem: '0 0.625rem 1.875rem rgba(64,59,54,0.10)'.

findings.t: Kep bubble shadow hardcodes px offsets
findings.r: Use rem offsets '0 0.0625rem 0.125rem rgba(64,59,54,0.06)' and the warm-ink shadow color.

findings.t: AI badge and shell logo hand-copy EMBER_GLYPH rgba literals
findings.r: Derive alpha fills from U.accent/U.gold via a hexAlpha helper so they stay locked to token values.

findings.t: KepCard shell aria-label is just the brand name; vignette meaning not announced
findings.r: Pass a descriptive label mirroring PalaceCard (kepName: kepRole — kepSaved, kepSorted) so the img role conveys the scene.

findings.t: PalaceCard renders palaceName twice (shell header + engraved plaque)
findings.r: Drop the name from the engraved plaque (keep the diamond dividers as pure ornament) so the sub-brand shows once.

findings.t: UspCardShell logo animation lives only in globals.css @media blocks, not co-located
findings.r: Co-locate the logo keyframes with the shell or add a comment pointing to the globals.css dependency and the .usp-live gate.

findings.t: Meaningful photo/frame imagery carries empty alt; the 'photo gets framed' story is invisible to SR
findings.r: Give KepCard a localized descriptive label for the role='img' region instead of reusing m.kepName.

findings.t: StorageBanner Upgrade button renders raw key text 'upgradeNow' in every language
findings.r: Add an `upgradeNow` string to the palace namespace in en/nl/de/es/fr (en "Upgrade", nl "Upgraden", de "Upgrade", es "Mejorar", fr "Améliorer"). Remove the dead, hardcoded-English `|| "Upgrade"` guard and rely solely on the translated key so coverage is enforced, not masked.

findings.t: Storage warning messages ignore used/limit/pct interpolation params — numbers never shown
findings.r: Rewrite the storageWarning50/80/95 and storageFull strings across all 5 locales to use placeholders, e.g. "You've used {pct}% ({used} MB of {limit} MB)", so the passed params render and the shown percentage matches actual usage.

findings.t: StorageBanner Upgrade button touch target is 2.25rem — below 2.75rem minimum
findings.r: Raise minHeight to "2.75rem" and ensure horizontal padding keeps the tappable width >= 2.75rem.

findings.t: TrackDetailPanel close button is 2rem — below 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Enlarge the close button to width/height 2.75rem to match TracksPanel and satisfy the touch-target minimum.

findings.t: StorageBanner is off-canon: uses legacy T.color tokens instead of the Atrium/Library reskin
findings.r: Reskin StorageBanner to the same literal canon hexes as the panels: MUTED #716A5E for info text/border, HAIRLINE #E3D6BC where appropriate, the warm-ink shadow ramp, and Fraunces/Source Sans, so it visibly belongs to the same family.

findings.t: Upgrade CTA uses off-canon ember (#C66B3D) instead of canon EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Use EMBER #B85C38 for the default/warning CTA background (canon interactive), keeping error red only for the genuine full/urgent escalation, with a hover lift to match the panels' hover language.

findings.t: StorageBanner has no Fraunces display type — flat all-body-font block feels unlike sibling panels
findings.r: Introduce a small Fraunces display lead or emphasized figure (e.g. the percentage/used value) to establish hierarchy and tie the banner to the panels' type system.

findings.t: Storage banner Upgrade CTA has a hardcoded English fallback string
findings.r: Remove the `|| "Upgrade"` fallback and ensure the `upgradeNow` key exists in all five message files; rely solely on t("upgradeNow") so translation coverage is enforced rather than masked (pairs with the P0 fix).

findings.t: StorageBanner has zero responsive handling and no reduced-motion / focus token
findings.r: Wrap to a column on very narrow widths via useIsMobile()/useIsSmall(), and add a focus-visible outline (gold #D4AF37) for keyboard users like TracksPanel does.

findings.t: TracksPanel gates layout only on useIsMobile — no iPad-portrait (useIsCompact) handling
findings.r: Use useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() for compact padding on iPad portrait, and add a responsive hook to TrackDetailPanel which currently has none.

findings.t: Hardcoded white #FFF for CTA text instead of canon CREAM #FCFAF5
findings.r: Use T.color.cream / #FCFAF5 for on-color button text to keep the warm cast consistent with the palette.

findings.t: StorageBanner border radius (0.75rem) is smaller than the panels' 1rem card radius
findings.r: Align the banner container to the 1rem card radius (keep 0.5rem for the inner button) to match the card family.

findings.t: Backdrop blur unit inconsistency between the two sibling panels (px vs rem)
findings.r: Change TrackDetailPanel backdrop to blur(0.375rem) to match TracksPanel and the rem-only sizing rule.

findings.t: StorageBanner role=alert with dynamic level changes may over-announce to screen readers
findings.r: Use role="status" (polite) for info/warning and reserve role="alert" for full/urgent, or render aria-live="polite" and switch to assertive only at >=95%.

findings.t: Redundant 50% storage gate duplicated across mount site and component
findings.r: Keep the threshold in one place — either remove the outer >=0.5 guard in MemoryPalace (let the banner self-gate) or export a shared constant used by both.

findings.t: Level-color circle/next-step accents rely on track.color contrast that can dip below canon on light bg
findings.r: For small text uses prefer EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A (or darken track.color for text), reserving raw track.color for fills/icons/borders where contrast isn't text-critical.

findings.t: Recommended-track sort places any track missing from a goal-priority list at the front
findings.r: Normalize -1 to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER before comparing indexOf results so unlisted tracks fall to the end deterministically.

findings.t: daysLeft treats a same-day target as 'past due' due to Math.ceil rounding at midnight boundary
findings.r: Floor both dates to local midnight so daysLeft===0 means 'due today'; render a dedicated 'today' label for the 0 case instead of pastDue.

findings.t: TrackDetailPanel intercepts 'legacy' itself, duplicating the parent's onNavigate branch
findings.r: Drop the special-case and let all navigateTo values flow through onNavigate (which already handles "legacy") for a single source of truth.

findings.t: Panels use 1px hairline in one spot but banner uses raw px border
findings.r: Align borders and backdrop blur to rem for consistency; no functional impact.

findings.t: iPad portrait renders the tiny-touch desktop sidebar (isMobile prop is not iPad-aware)
findings.r: Gate the layout on useIsCompact() (max-width:1024px) or useIsTablet() rather than the phone-only isMobile prop, so iPad portrait gets touch-sized targets. At minimum, bump room-row / tooltip / color-dot / swatch hit boxes to >=2.75rem when useTouchControls() is true.

findings.t: SearchBar input text uses charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36
findings.r: Set the input color to INK #403B36 (import from libraryTokens) to match the sidebar's primary-text ink.

findings.t: Mobile sidebar silently drops room selection, search, drag-drop, shared, add, and Enter-Palace — many wired props are ignored
findings.r: Either document that mobile intentionally delegates room/search/drag to other UI (and stop passing the unused props to avoid implying they work), or add a room drill-down + search to the mobile strip. At minimum ensure onEnter3D and room selection are reachable on mobile.

findings.t: Sidebar search input fontSize 0.75rem triggers iOS zoom-on-focus (on iPad)
findings.r: Set the sidebar search input fontSize to 1rem (at least on touch), matching SearchBar.tsx which already does fontSize:isMobile?"1rem":"0.75rem".

findings.t: searchBar.clearFilter key missing in ALL five locales — aria-label reads the raw key
findings.r: Add a "clearFilter" key (e.g. "Clear search and filters") to searchBar in all five message files, translated per locale.

findings.t: SearchBar uses px for blur/maxWidth/calc instead of rem
findings.r: Convert blur(10px)/blur(8px), maxWidth/calc, and active border to rem; reserve px for hairlines only.

findings.t: Two different 'muted' grays across the two sibling surfaces
findings.r: Standardize on canon MUTED #716A5E from libraryTokens.

findings.t: Storage progress bar uses terracotta gradient while wing progress bars use EMBER
findings.r: Use EMBER #B85C38 for the storage progress fill too, or a single shared token.

findings.t: SearchBar has no styled empty/no-results state
findings.r: When filteredCount===0, render a canon-styled empty hint (Fraunces line + muted subtext + EMBER clear-filters link).

findings.t: SearchBar.tsx is entirely dead code — imported and rendered nowhere
findings.r: Delete SearchBar.tsx (and its unused searchBar i18n namespace) or actually wire it into LibraryView.

findings.t: SearchBar type filter compares raw m.type instead of normalizeDisplayType, unlike the live wall
findings.r: If revived, route filterType through the same normalizeDisplayType mapping; otherwise remove with the component.

findings.t: Wing recolor only tints the dot + chevron; the wing's real accent is never overridden
findings.r: Apply wingColors as the effective accent everywhere or route the choice through roomStore.changeWingAccent so it is authoritative app-wide.

findings.t: Desktop room / control touch targets below 2.75rem
findings.r: When on touch (useTouchControls), enlarge interactive rows/buttons to >=2.75rem hit area, consistent with the mobile pill strip.

findings.t: SearchBar result-count typography is undersized vs the RT ramp
findings.r: Raise the count and pill-label minimum to at least RT.overline (0.6875rem).

findings.t: Mobile pill strip and hardcoded RGBA glass are not sourced from tokens
findings.r: Derive the mobile strip glass and borders from CREAM/TRAY/HAIRLINE tokens.

findings.t: Sidebar search hides wings but header/stats counts still say total wings
findings.r: Use unfiltered wings.length for header/stats counts, or gate stats to reflect filtering consistently for both wings and rooms.

findings.t: 'Enter Palace' vs 'Enter this Wing' label keys off wings[0].id, fragile after reordering/deletion
findings.r: Test against the sentinel the parent uses (selectedWing !== '__all__') rather than positional wings[0]?.id.

findings.t: colorPicker and tooltip open-state never auto-closes on outside click / wing switch
findings.r: Reset colorPickerWing to null in onSelectWing (or add a click-away listener), and make the tooltip click-toggle OR hover, not both.

findings.t: No multimodal capture entry point in the search/facet surface
findings.r: Consider a voice-search mic button (guarded to touch + SpeechRecognition-capable browsers) reusing the app's speech pipeline; optional.

findings.t: Decorative emoji icons not hidden from assistive tech
findings.r: Add aria-hidden='true' to the decorative emoji spans (magnifier and type-pill icons).

findings.t: Primary Import CTA misuses GOLD — canon reserves gold for the palace itself
findings.r: Repaint the Import button in EMBER (#B85C38 / gradient to a warm-rust like #9A4F2A->#6B3318 matching land.ctaGrad) and drop the gold shadow to a warm-ink SHADOW.1 token. Reserve gold strictly for focus rings/seals.

findings.t: Off-canon dark-bronze scrims and pills (rgba(42,34,24,...)) instead of warm-ink register
findings.r: Replace every rgba(42,34,24,x) with the canon warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) (or the #2E2A26 register StoragePlayerPanel uses) so scrims/pills/badges match the Atrium and Library siblings.

findings.t: Uses legacy T.color tokens (charcoal #1F1B1A, muted #857B70, terracotta) instead of libraryTokens canon
findings.r: Import from libraryTokens (INK/MUTED/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE) and swap charcoal->INK #403B36, muted->#716A5E, terracotta fallback->wingAccent()/EMBER_GLYPH so the panel matches its own sibling surfaces.

findings.t: Move-selected button hidden behind onSelect, but move actually depends on room/moveMemory
findings.r: Gate the bulk-move button on the real dependency (room && moveMemory) rather than onSelect, matching the always-available single-card move path.

findings.t: StoragePlayerPanel has zero responsive hooks — fixed desktop sizing on phones/iPad
findings.r: Import useIsMobile()/useIsSmall() and scale video maxHeight (e.g. min(22.5rem, 55vh)), header font, and horizontal padding for phone/landscape; verify the active-player + list fit within the fold on a landscape phone.

findings.t: Shadows use cold rgba(44,44,42,...) and rgba(0,0,0,0.3) instead of canon warm-ink shadow ramp
findings.r: Replace with SHADOW.1/.2 and HOVER_SHADOW constants (rgba(64,59,54,x)) from libraryTokens.

findings.t: Moved-toast uses cold charcoal #1F1B1A background
findings.r: Use warm-ink #403B36 (or #2E2A26) for the toast background and a warm-ink shadow.

findings.t: handleSelect / handleMoveToRoom dependency arrays omit used values
findings.r: Add slotCounts (and drop unused t if not needed) to the dependency array so limit reflects current slot capacities.

findings.t: Select-all checkbox and count operate on filtered list; deleting a superset feels inconsistent
findings.r: On searchQuery/filterType change, prune selectedIds to currently-visible ids (or clear selection).

findings.t: StoragePlayerPanel activeMem can become stale/deleted with no reconciliation
findings.r: Reconcile activeMem against the fresh list; if not found in stored, reset to stored[0] || null and use a guarded seed.

findings.t: Non-exhibition auto-evict removes an arbitrary 'oldest' occupant with no ordering guarantee
findings.r: Sort occupants by createdAt (or a real displayOrder) before evicting so 'oldest' matches the UI promise.

findings.t: Sort and display-unit dropdowns lack menu/listbox roles and aria state
findings.r: Add aria-haspopup='menu' + aria-expanded to triggers, role='menu' to popovers, role='menuitemradio' + aria-checked to options, and arrow-key handling.

findings.t: StoragePlayerPanel autoPlays video/audio with no reduced-motion / autoplay guard
findings.r: Only autoPlay when the user explicitly selects an item (not on initial mount of stored[0]), gate motion behind prefers-reduced-motion, and consider muted-first for video.

findings.t: RoomMediaPanel adapts only via useIsMobile — no iPad-portrait / compact handling
findings.r: Use useIsTablet()/useIsCompact() to keep touch-sized targets (>=2.75rem close button, larger pills) on iPad.

findings.t: Furniture-slot count badges and pills use hardcoded #FFF and sub-ramp fontSizes
findings.r: Raise micro-labels to the RT.overline 0.6875rem floor and swap pure #FFF -> CREAM #FCFAF5.

findings.t: StoragePlayerPanel empty state is text-only, unlike the illustrated Library empty state
findings.r: Give the storage empty state the same overline/title/subtitle rhythm (and a dark-surface engraved SVG variant) as LibraryEmptyState.

findings.t: Gallery furniture-slot glyphs are raw emoji, breaking the custom-SVG icon language
findings.r: Replace furniture-slot emoji with the existing TypeIcon/stroke-SVG set tinted in the wing accent.

findings.t: Cloud import failures are swallowed with no user feedback
findings.r: Surface a toast/error on non-ok or thrown import rather than closing silently.

findings.t: RoomMediaPlayer receives displayedMems (filtered/sorted) so index navigation excludes hidden items
findings.r: Either pass the unfiltered mems (mapping index into it) or document that player navigation is scoped to the active filter.

findings.t: Furniture slot thumbnails use CSS background-image with no alt/label text
findings.r: Prefer an or add an aria-label to the slot button that includes the assigned memory title.

findings.t: Doors card uses pure white (#FFFFFF), off the warm CREAM/TRAY canon
findings.r: Swap to a warm surface: either CREAM with the SHADOW[1]+TOP_HIGHLIGHT lift already applied, or a linen/white-cream like the Atrium tray. If a lifted white is intended, use a warm off-white (e.g. #FFFDFA) so it stays in the warm-ink family; import from libraryTokens rather than hardcoding.

findings.t: Canon colors hardcoded as hex/rgba instead of imported tokens
findings.r: Reference tokens: gradient from ${EMBER},${EMBER_GLYPH}; focus outline from GOLD/focusRing; derive hover tints from EMBER_GLYPH. Import GOLD from libraryTokens for the focus ring.

findings.t: Door/chevron icons sized in raw px rather than rem
findings.r: Express icon box in rem (e.g. 1.125rem) so glyphs scale with the type ramp; keep the internal viewBox at 24 for crisp geometry.

findings.t: 'Visitors' stat counts total visit rows, not unique visitors
findings.r: Count DISTINCT visitor_id (RPC/view like explore_visit_counts, or GROUP BY visitor_id) so 'Visitors' reflects unique people; or relabel to 'Visits' if the total-events number is intended.

findings.t: Stat labels can overflow / force horizontal scroll on narrow phones (long localized words)
findings.r: Add textAlign:'center' and either whiteSpace:'nowrap' with a smaller fontSize via useIsSmall(), or overflowWrap:'anywhere' with a shared min-width per stat. Verify at 320px in de/es.

findings.t: Type sizes hardcoded rather than drawn from the RT ramp
findings.r: Import RT from libraryTokens and reference RT.titleL / RT.overline / RT.meta / RT.body so the ramp stays the single source of truth.

findings.t: Empty/no-avatar fallback initial can render '?'
findings.r: For the truly-empty case, prefer a canon glyph (small keeper/person mark or palace seal) over a literal '?', matching the 'Your palace' name fallback beside it.

findings.t: Sign-out row visually indistinct from settings doors despite a different action class
findings.r: Add a heavier separator or a small gap/TRAY break before the sign-out row, or give it its own grouping, so the terminal action is set apart from navigational doors.

findings.t: Visitors silently degrades to 0 on deploys without the service-role key
findings.r: Fine on production (admin client bypasses RLS). Optionally log when the visitors query errors, and confirm the service-role key is present on prod so the stat is real rather than a masked 0.

findings.t: Public-profile CTA can point at /u/[username] that 404s for public-but-unpublished profiles
findings.r: Confirm /u/[username] renders for any is_public profile with a username; if it also requires published content, tighten hasPublicPage to match (or have the public page render a graceful empty state).

findings.t: Stat values not locale-formatted (thousands separators)
findings.r: Format with new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(s.value) so grouping matches nl/de/es/fr conventions.

findings.t: Identity portrait + name fully hidden from assistive tech
findings.r: Acceptable as decorative given the adjacent h1, but consider a localized alt (t('meAvatarAlt') with display name) and removing aria-hidden on the wrapper.

findings.t: "Copy invite link" generates a link to a route that does not exist (guaranteed 404)
findings.r: Build the /join-family route validating a per-invite token (not a raw group id), or remove the Copy-invite-link button until it exists. If kept, point it at an existing accept flow and include a signed invite token so acceptFamilyInvite can verify the invitee by email.

findings.t: Off-canon sage #56683C used app-wide as a semantic color (family)
findings.r: Replace every #56683C with T.color.sage/success (#4A6741) or a shared SAGE constant; the success toast especially should use T.color.success.

findings.t: Admin role color #8A6410 is a bespoke brown-gold, not a canon token
findings.r: Map admin to an existing canon token (GOLD_SOFT #C99A2E or T.color.goldDark #B8922E) rather than a one-off hex.

findings.t: Family page hardcodes hexes instead of the shared canon constants siblings import
findings.r: Import INK, MUTED, EMBER, EMBER_GLYPH, HAIRLINE, GOLD, CREAM from @/lib/libraryTokens (as _SettingsChrome does) and replace the literals.

findings.t: Family text inputs use fontSize 0.9375rem — triggers iOS focus-zoom
findings.r: Set inputStyle.fontSize to '1rem'.

findings.t: Family invite row and rename row never stack on mobile/portrait
findings.r: Compute isMobile and set flexDirection: isMobile ? 'column' : 'row' with full-width button on mobile for both the invite and rename rows.

findings.t: Family SVGs pass rem strings to width/height presentational attributes
findings.r: Route SVGs through the numeric FamilyIcon size prop (px) or move sizing into CSS style; don't pass rem to raw width/height attrs.

findings.t: Off-token surface hexes: disabled #EEE9DF, tray #F6EBE3, medallion border #E7D9C4
findings.r: Promote to shared tokens (DISABLED/TRAY) or reuse existing canon neutrals.

findings.t: Family loading state is a bare centered line unlike the card-based body
findings.r: Render SettingsPageHeader + a skeleton card (or spinner in a card) during loading.

findings.t: Invite button's enabled color and disabled logic disagree on the '@' check
findings.r: Compute one inviteDisabled and drive both disabled and styling from it.

findings.t: inviteRole is shared global state and never resets between groups
findings.r: Reset setInviteRole('member') after a successful invite and when expandedGroupId changes, or scope role per-group.

findings.t: Resend invite is a non-atomic delete-then-recreate that can lose the invite
findings.r: Make resend an idempotent server action that re-sends for the existing invite row, or wrap both steps so failure restores the cancelled row.

findings.t: Family role selector is aria-pressed toggles, not a radiogroup
findings.r: Wrap in role=radiogroup with role=radio + aria-checked and arrow-key navigation.

findings.t: Fixed family toast can overflow the left edge on narrow phones
findings.r: Add maxWidth and, on isMobile, span left:1rem/right:1rem so long toasts wrap.

findings.t: Family card/section padding fixed regardless of viewport
findings.r: Tighten horizontal padding on isMobile and consider useIsTablet for iPad.

findings.t: Family success toast uses ad-hoc green while gold focus ring is canon
findings.r: Draw pending=ember/active=sage from named canon tokens so the state contrast reads as intentional.

findings.t: Family heading sizes have no clear type scale
findings.r: Anchor headings to the T.fontSize scale so card titles share one Fraunces step.

findings.t: getAllFamilyGroups does per-group N+1 queries and blocking auto-repair inserts on load
findings.r: Batch with .in(...) + Promise.all and move auto-repair inserts off the hot read path.

findings.t: Toast auto-dismiss effect shadows the translation function t
findings.r: Rename the timer variable to avoid shadowing i18n t.

findings.t: First-invite CTA moves focus without ensuring the target is in view
findings.r: Call scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) before focus (respect reduced-motion).

findings.t: Permission toggle silently no-ops on the server (field-name casing mismatch)
findings.r: Map snake_case to the camelCase the action expects at the call site (const camel = {can_add:'canAdd',can_edit:'canEdit',can_delete:'canDelete'}[field]), or change updateSharePermissions to accept snake_case. Add a return-value check so a server {error} triggers the revert.

findings.t: Sharing card background uses pure #FFFFFF instead of canon cream #FCFAF5
findings.r: Replace card-level '#FFFFFF' with #FCFAF5; keep inner tiles at #FCFAF5 and nudge card-vs-tile contrast via the existing hairline+shadow rather than pure white.

findings.t: Sharing loading states are a bare unstyled ellipsis in two of three sections
findings.r: Extract the Published card's spinner (border #E3D6BC / borderTopColor #B85C38 / spin keyframe + reduced-motion guard) into a shared Spinner and use it in PasscodeSection and FamilyWingSharingSection.

findings.t: Save can silently fail to publish rooms in never-published wings
findings.r: Have publishWing upsert (create the wings row if absent) and collect results: if any r.ok===false || r.error, show error; only apply optimistic setWings for ops that succeeded.

findings.t: Passcode creation uses a wing id that may be a slug, not a DB uuid
findings.r: Use a guaranteed-real wing identifier (ensure the wings row exists / resolve slug server-side) and add an error toast in the !result.ok branch.

findings.t: Hardcoded English 'Wing' label in the passcode form — no i18n
findings.r: Wrap with {t('passcodeWing') || 'Wing'} and add the key to all five locale files (reuse the sharingSettings 'wing' key if suitable).

findings.t: Sharing panel off-grid corner radii (0.7/0.85rem) break the radius rhythm
findings.r: Normalize to the canon 0.75rem small-control radius (card stays 1rem).

findings.t: Sharing slide-over scrim uses an off-canon warm-ink color
findings.r: Use rgba(64,59,54,0.4) to match the shadow grammar.

findings.t: Sharing hardcodes literal accent hexes instead of imported tokens
findings.r: Import EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/HAIRLINE/CREAM/INK/MUTED/SAGE and reference the constants.

findings.t: Family-share passes slug where server/DB likely expects a wing id; wingLabel double-guesses
findings.r: Use one canonical identifier end-to-end in shareWing/wing_id/wingLabel; drop the dual slug||id match.

findings.t: Sharing load effects have no error/catch, leaving surfaces stuck on '...' or crashing
findings.r: Wrap loaders in try/catch, setLoading(false) in finally, render an error/retry state.

findings.t: Main-page sharing toast has no ARIA live role
findings.r: Add role='status'/'alert' or aria-live, mirroring the section-local toast.

findings.t: Wing/room card + pill transitions not guarded by reduced-motion
findings.r: Move transitions into the guarded <style> block or add a reduced-motion rule zeroing them.

findings.t: Native checkbox hit area far below 2.75rem on touch
findings.r: Give each row label minHeight 2.75rem so the full-row tap target meets the minimum.

findings.t: Sharing gradient CTA diverges from the settings-shell button grammar
findings.r: Pick one primary-button treatment for the sharing area and apply it to page CTAs and the panel confirm/share buttons.

findings.t: Family-share permission badge shape inconsistent with the badge system
findings.r: Give the permission chip the canon pill radius (2rem) to match adjacent chips and PermissionBadge.

findings.t: Duplicate fixed toast slot: page-level and family-section toasts collide
findings.r: Lift a single toast into the page/shared context, or offset the section toast.

findings.t: SharingSettingsPanel 'received' badges hardcode viewOnly=true, ignoring actual permission
findings.r: Derive the viewOnly badge from the share record rather than a literal true.

findings.t: No compact/portrait (iPad) tuning in sharing — relies solely on flex-wrap
findings.r: Use useIsCompact() to stack the passcode Wing/Duration/Create controls full-width on iPad portrait.

findings.t: Sharing loading '...' and decorative emoji icons not a11y-tuned
findings.r: Replace '...' with ts('loading') and add aria-hidden to decorative emoji spans.

findings.t: Editing a wing then tapping icon/color swatch discards the typed name & subtitle
findings.r: Call saveEdit(wing.id) before setEditingId(null) in the icon and color-swatch onClick handlers, and add onBlur={() => saveEdit(wing.id)} to the name <input> so committing works consistently regardless of how focus leaves the field.

findings.t: iPad portrait renders the desktop panel with sub-2.75rem touch targets (useIsTablet/useIsCompact never imported)
findings.r: Import useIsTablet()/useIsCompact() and treat tablet-touch as mobile for SIZING (e.g. const touch = useIsMobile() || useIsTablet()) so iPad-portrait gets >=2.75rem control sizes and the full-width/wider panel.

findings.t: Reorder arrow buttons are below the 2.75rem touch target even on phones
findings.r: Give each reorder button minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem on touch (expand hit area with padding while keeping the glyph small if compactness is desired), or combine into a single-column 2.75rem control.

findings.t: Off-canon text ink: charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36 in room/wing managers
findings.r: Switch text fills from T.color.charcoal to canon INK #403B36 (import from libraryTokens or add an ink token) so both managers match the Atrium/Library ink tone.

findings.t: Hairlines rendered in CREAM (#FCFAF5) instead of canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC — borders nearly invisible
findings.r: Replace T.color.cream border colors with canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC so cards read as crisp warm-tan hairline cards like the Library/Atrium surfaces.

findings.t: Muted secondary text off-canon (#857B70 vs canon MUTED #716A5E)
findings.r: Map T.color.muted usages here to canon MUTED #716A5E for consistent secondary-text tone across managers.

findings.t: Interactive/CTA color is terracotta #C66B3D, not canon EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Use canon EMBER #B85C38 for interactive/CTA states (Add button, selected-icon rings) instead of T.color.terracotta.

findings.t: GOLD spent on a generic Add-Wing affordance (canon says palace-only)
findings.r: Replace the gold dashed border with EMBER or the wing accent (matching RoomManagerPanel's add-room dashed border) to respect the gold-is-palace-only rule.

findings.t: Hardcoded off-canon hex + non-warm shadows (ERROR_BG #FDF0F0, rgba(0,0,0,.12))
findings.r: Derive the delete strip bg from T.color.error at low alpha (as WingManagerPanel does with `${T.color.error}08`) and switch swatch/card shadows to warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x).

findings.t: 'Max wings reached' state shows no feedback — Add Wing block disappears entirely
findings.r: Add an else branch rendering a 'maximum wings reached' message (mirroring RoomManagerPanel's maxRoomsReached), or keep the counter visible and only disable/hide the input.

findings.t: Emoji-preset picker buttons under-sized for touch (2.25rem mobile / 1.75rem desktop)
findings.r: Raise emoji cell size to >=2.75rem on touch (fewer columns if needed) so each swatch meets the tap-target floor; keep glyph fontSize as-is.

findings.t: Accent color swatch (per-wing) is 1.75rem with no minimum — a primary control under target on all devices
findings.r: Enforce minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem on the swatch button (keep the colored dot smaller via an inner span) so the tap area meets the target.

findings.t: Single-select icon/color pickers lack radiogroup/aria semantics
findings.r: Wrap each picker in role='radiogroup' with an accessible label, give each option role='radio' aria-checked; add aria-expanded to the customEmoji disclosure button.

findings.t: Panel entrance animations have no prefers-reduced-motion guard
findings.r: Wrap the keyframe/animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ animation: none } inside the injected <style>, or gate on a usePrefersReducedMotion() check.

findings.t: rem-unit inconsistency: WingManager add-input uses px font-size while RoomManager uses rem
findings.r: Change the Add-Wing input to fontSize:'1rem' to match RoomManagerPanel inputs and the rem-only canon.

findings.t: Overlay scrim uses off-canon umber rgba(42,34,24,.4) rather than warm-ink
findings.r: Standardize the scrim on the shared warm-ink modal-overlay token, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,.4).

findings.t: Room rename via Enter double-fires saveEdit (form submit + input onBlur)
findings.r: Guard saveEdit against double invocation (early-return if editingId !== id) or drop the onBlur in favor of the form submit plus an explicit blur-commit only when editing is active.

findings.t: Shared showEmoji state means emoji section state leaks across pickers
findings.r: Reset setShowEmoji(false) when a picker opens/closes, or scope the expand state per-picker, so the emoji drawer always opens collapsed.

findings.t: Custom wing rooms use emoji icon id that RoomIcon may not resolve to an SVG
findings.r: Verify RoomIcon renders arbitrary emoji strings as text fallback; if not, seed custom-wing default rooms with a valid ROOM_ICON_MAP key (e.g. 'ro1').

findings.t: Room-list rename target caret glyphs lack scalable hit padding on touch
findings.r: Increase the rename row's vertical padding (or min-height) toward 2.75rem on touch so the rename tap target is comfortable on phones.

findings.t: iapReady is derived from initIAP() return, not waitForProducts() — Upgrade button can enable before prices load
findings.r: Replace initIAP().then(setIapReady) with initIAP() followed by waitForProducts() (or use isIAPReady()) so iapReady is set only once at least one product price has actually loaded, matching the documented contract in iap.ts.

findings.t: iOS purchase-success toast leaks a raw i18n key to the user
findings.r: Add subscriptionActivated to pricing.* in all 5 message files, OR switch to the guard used elsewhere: t("subscriptionActivated") !== "subscriptionActivated" ? ... : "Subscription activated!". Note || cannot work because t() returns the truthy raw key.

findings.t: Interactive color on /pricing is off-canon terracotta #C66B3D, not EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Repoint the interactive accent to canon EMBER #B85C38 (present in libraryTokens as EMBER). Import EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH for interactive states, or correct T.color.terracotta to #B85C38 so /pricing matches the rest of the palace.

findings.t: IAP purchase() attaches new approved/verified/error listeners on every call — listeners accumulate
findings.r: Register approved/verified/error handlers once at init (module scope) and correlate to the in-flight order via a pending map keyed by productId, or use the plugin's per-order promise API, so retries don't accumulate global listeners.

findings.t: Pricing borders use sandstone #D6CCBA at alpha instead of canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC
findings.r: Use canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC at full opacity for 1px borders.

findings.t: Raw px / unitless sizing dominates /pricing, contradicting rem canon
findings.r: Convert numeric/px sizing to rem (42->2.625rem, '8px 20px'->'0.5rem 1.25rem', height 64->4rem), keeping px only for 1px hairlines.

findings.t: Cool-black shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.04) breaks the warm-ink shadow grammar (pricing)
findings.r: Adopt the warm-ink SHADOW ramp: rest '0 0.25rem 1rem rgba(64,59,54,0.07)', highlighted '0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)'.

findings.t: IAP init effect ignores IAP_ENABLED in dep array and can double-init / race the redirect
findings.r: Add IAP_ENABLED to the dependency array and guard setIapReady/setIapError against unmount (isMounted flag) since router.replace('/atrium') may tear down concurrently.

findings.t: Stripe checkout redirect detection may false-positive on a 200 error JSON, and 403 not handled
findings.r: Treat 403/302 as unauthenticated -> /register; align the guard to the actual status the auth middleware returns so genuine auth redirects never fall to the json() error path.

findings.t: Currency selection is not passed to Stripe checkout — user charged in server default
findings.r: Include currency in the checkout body and honor it server-side (Stripe multi-currency), or mark converted prices as 'approximate, billed in EUR'.

findings.t: Nav back-button and language select fall below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum (pricing)
findings.r: Bump the back Link to min 2.75rem x 2.75rem and raise the language select min-height/padding to 2.75rem on touch.

findings.t: Language select uses fontSize 0.75rem — risks iOS focus zoom (pricing)
findings.r: Set both <select> fontSize to 1rem (16px); reduce padding if the control must stay visually small, never below 16px on focusable form controls.

findings.t: Billing interval toggle is not an accessible radiogroup
findings.r: Wrap the two buttons in role='radiogroup' with aria-label, give each role='radio'+aria-checked (or aria-pressed), and add aria-busy to the CTA while loading.

findings.t: Toast/redirect success path uses undefined i18n keys, falling back to raw key in non-English
findings.r: Add subscriptionActivated and preparingStore keys to all 5 message files, or switch to the '!== key' guard.

findings.t: Optional: use useIsPortrait() to tighten hero padding on landscape phones (pricing)
findings.r: Acceptable per canon (no @media). Optionally tighten the 60px top padding on landscape phones via useIsPortrait().

findings.t: Muted secondary text is #857B70, lighter than canon MUTED #716A5E (pricing)
findings.r: Align C.muted to canon MUTED #716A5E (theme land.inkMutedLight already #716A5E) to hold >=4.5:1 on tiny disclosure copy.

findings.t: Chevron/back-button and select dropdown glyph use hardcoded grey #666, off-palette
findings.r: Recolor the SVG chevrons to warm ink/muted (%23716A5E) in both select backgroundImage data-URIs.

findings.t: No canon GOLD focus ring on /pricing; controls rely on default browser focus
findings.r: Apply the canon focusRing (0.1875rem solid #D4AF37, offset 0.1875rem) on :focus-visible for toggle, CTA and select.

findings.t: Restore Purchases returns false pre-init, showing 'No purchases' instead of a not-ready state
findings.r: Distinguish 'store not ready' from a genuine empty restore (check isIAPReady() before restore and show a loading toast otherwise).

findings.t: No reduced-motion guard on scale/transform transitions (pricing)
findings.r: Gate transitions behind a usePrefersReducedMotion() hook (inline, no @media) and drop to transition:'none'/no scale.

findings.t: No empty-state: a zero-memory user sees a fabricated 'night owl, peak at 0:00' personality insight
findings.r: Add an early empty-state branch when stats.totalMems === 0 (a friendly 'no memories yet' message), and/or gate the Personality hero card and heatmap behind stats.totalMems > 0 the same way sections 5/6/8 are already gated.

findings.t: Weekly-digest 'sent' toast is unreachable dead code after the read-only refactor
findings.r: Remove the dead showToast state and its toast JSX block, or re-wire an actual send action + setShowToast(true) if email digests are still intended. If purely read-only, also drop/retitle the weeklyDigestSent i18n string so no orphaned 'sent to your email' copy remains.

findings.t: Statistics header close button is below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum
findings.r: Bump width/height to at least 2.75rem (or keep visual size but expand the hit area with padding / a larger transparent box), and adjust borderRadius accordingly. Consider useIsMobile() to enforce >=2.75rem on touch.

findings.t: Weekly-digest overlay has no dialog semantics or focus management
findings.r: Give the digest overlay role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={t("weeklyDigestTitle")}, run its own useFocusTrap (or move focus to the back button on open), and attach the Escape handler at a reliably-focused element.

findings.t: Data-bearing charts (donut, weekday heatmap, month bars) are invisible to screen readers
findings.r: Add role="img" + an aria-label with a text summary to each chart svg/container (e.g. 'Photo 40%, Text 35%...'), and give each weekday/month row an aria-label with day name + count so the data is announced even when the visual number is hidden.

findings.t: Backdrop scrim uses an off-canon umber rgba, not warm-ink
findings.r: Change the scrim to the warm-ink base, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.45) (or a documented Atrium scrim token), so the panel dims the app in the same warm ink as its own shadows.

findings.t: Primary CTA (Weekly Digest) never spends EMBER for its interactive accent
findings.r: Give the CTA an EMBER (#B85C38) signal (EMBER text or an EMBER left/hover treatment) so the interactive control is visibly distinct from at-rest accent labels, per THE ONE RULE.

findings.t: SAGE value diverges from the theme token (#56683C vs T.color.sage #4A6741)
findings.r: Import SAGE (and INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE/CREAM/EMBER) from src/lib/libraryTokens.ts instead of retyping hex, so the panel and siblings can never drift.

findings.t: Stats close button below 2.75rem and uses an off-token fill
findings.r: Bump the hit area to >=2.75rem (glyph can stay small via padding) and use a canon surface (CREAM card or TRAY) with a HAIRLINE border to match sibling controls.

findings.t: No dedicated empty/zero-memory state — charts render hollow instead of an invitation
findings.r: Add a canon-styled empty state (Fraunces heading + muted body + optional CTA) when stats.totalMems === 0 instead of rendering a hollow donut and orphaned overview zeros.

findings.t: stats useMemo can go stale on wing/room customization (Zustand selector fns are stable refs)
findings.r: Subscribe to underlying state slices (customWings/extraWings/customRooms) rather than the methods so the memo's deps change when wing/room config changes.

findings.t: Weekly-digest CTA button height borderline under 2.75rem
findings.r: Set minHeight:'2.75rem' (and adequate horizontal hit area) on both the digest CTA and back button, or increase vertical padding.

findings.t: No iPad/compact or portrait handling — only a single mobile breakpoint
findings.r: Use useIsCompact() (<=1024px) for grid density (2-col overview on iPad portrait) and useIsTablet() to bump padding/touch-target sizing.

findings.t: EMBER used as a static (non-interactive) timeline bar gradient
findings.r: Use an accent-glyph-only gradient (e.g. #9A4F2A into a lighter terracotta) for passive data bars, keeping EMBER for genuinely interactive elements.

findings.t: 'text' memory-type swatch is pure INK, reading as a gap rather than a data color
findings.r: Give 'text' a distinct warm data hue (walnut/parchment) reserved for charts so no data segment collides with body-ink.

findings.t: Panel base is LINEN while canon names CREAM as the background token
findings.r: No change if linen-recessed is the documented Atrium base; otherwise standardize the shell on CREAM with tray/linen only for recessed sub-surfaces.

findings.t: digestLoading is permanently false — its disabled/loading UI branches are unreachable dead code
findings.r: Remove digestLoading and simplify the button to its always-enabled form, or restore a real loading state if async work returns.

findings.t: expandedSection / setExpandedSection state is declared but never read
findings.r: Delete the unused expandedSection state to avoid confusion and dead code.

findings.t: Two content sections both labelled '7.' in comments (numbering regression)
findings.r: Renumber the trailing Weekly Digest comment (e.g. to 9) so section comments are unique and ordered.

findings.t: Weekday abbreviation via .slice(0,2) on translated day names is fragile
findings.r: Add explicit dayShort_* keys per locale (or use Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale,{weekday:'short'})) instead of .slice(0,2).

findings.t: Layout animations depend on a @media reduced-motion rule rather than a JS guard
findings.r: Optionally gate entrance animations with a shared usePrefersReducedMotion() hook so suppression doesn't rely solely on the injected @media block.

findings.t: Onboarding 'first memory' upload is never persisted — silent data loss
findings.r: Persist the uploaded file before advancing: call the real memory-creation path (the same store/action the in-app ImportHub uses) inside onImportFiles for room 'ro1'/wing 'roots', await it, and only then handleMemoryAdded(). Surface an error toast and stay on the upload phase if the write fails, so the checklist mark re

findings.t: Paywall phase is a leftover dark bronze-glass card, wholly off-canon from the cream setup flow
findings.r: Reskin the paywall to cream canon: CREAM/#FFF card, HAIRLINE border, SHADOW[2]+TOP_HIGHLIGHT, INK/MUTED text, the canon Overline component, EMBER-glyph feature checks, and the shared primaryCtaStyle/T.land.ctaGrad for the trial CTA. Drop the #1a1917 backdrop and T.color.terracotta/walnut tokens entirely.

findings.t: Paywall uses non-canon terracotta/walnut palette tokens instead of EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH
findings.r: Replace all T.color.terracotta references in the paywall with EMBER (interactive) / EMBER_GLYPH (at-rest accent ink), and the CTA gradient with T.land.ctaGrad, matching every other onboarding phase.

findings.t: Video intro phase ignores prefers-reduced-motion
findings.r: Detect prefers-reduced-motion (reuse the same helper as SceneHost). When set, skip the video entirely and start at 'lang_a11y' (or show a static poster frame with the welcome title, no autoplay), mirroring the reduced-motion swaps already used elsewhere.

findings.t: Language/text-size radiogroups lack keyboard arrow navigation (broken ARIA radiogroup pattern)
findings.r: Implement the radiogroup keyboard pattern: give the checked radio tabIndex=0 and others tabIndex=-1, and add an onKeyDown on the group that moves selection+focus with Arrow keys (and Home/End). Applies to both the locale grid and the text-size row.

findings.t: Paywall mixes px letter-spacing and uses Fraunces for an uppercase overline, breaking type-canon
findings.r: Reuse the shared <Overline> component (Source Sans, 0.6875rem/700, 0.12em, EMBER_GLYPH) here too, so all five phases share one overline grammar.

findings.t: beginOutro's 2.6s setPhase timeout is never cleared on unmount
findings.r: Store the timeout id in a ref and clear it in the skip handler and in a useEffect cleanup, or drive the outro→advance via a guarded effect keyed on showWelcome so React owns teardown.

findings.t: celebrationAtrium key label 'Select your plan' contradicts the comment 'CTA always enters (never a paywall)'
findings.r: Reconcile intent: if the paywall step is desired for web, fix the stale comment; if the ceremonial threshold should always enter the palace, use celebrationContinue and drop the paywall branch. Do not ship a label ('Select your plan') that mismatches its own documented contract.

findings.t: Step-progress dots invisible to assistive tech
findings.r: Add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow={current} aria-valuemin={1} aria-valuemax={total} and an aria-label, or include a visually-hidden i18n string like t('stepOf',{current,total}) so progress is announced.

findings.t: Video Skip button below 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Raise the Skip button minHeight to at least 2.75rem (and consider matching horizontal hit area) to meet the touch-target minimum.

findings.t: Paywall 'Continue free' and Terms/Privacy links have no minimum touch target
findings.r: Give the free-continue button minHeight >=2.75rem and padding, and increase the tap area / spacing of the Terms/Privacy links (e.g. inline-block with padding) so they satisfy the touch-target minimum.

findings.t: Video-intro welcome title uses an ad-hoc gold '#E8C766' instead of canon GOLD/steward gradient
findings.r: Align the outro gold to canon: use GOLD (#D4AF37) or the same #E8C255 anchor from NAME_GRAD so the two ceremonial gold beats read as one system.

findings.t: Hairline/border widths use px (3px, 1px) instead of rem in several spots
findings.r: Use rem for non-hairline strokes (e.g. spinner '0.1875rem'); keep 1px only for genuine 1-device-pixel hairline rules for consistency with SceneHost which uses HAIRLINE at 0.125rem.

findings.t: StepDots count (3) excludes the video_intro and upload phases, so the progress reads inconsistently
findings.r: Either keep dots only on the 3 form cards (acceptable) but confirm intentionally, or extend the dot grammar subtly to signal the do-first upload step so the progress cue doesn't vanish mid-flow.

findings.t: Video-intro skip button uses cool neutral glass, not warm-ink canon
findings.r: Warm the intro skip chrome to an ink-tinted rgba(64,59,54,x) fill/border to keep even the video overlay on the warm palette.

findings.t: Two active-state checkmarks are literal '✓' glyphs rather than a canon icon/weight
findings.r: Consider a small stroked check SVG (matching the laurel/divider-tick drawing style) for a more intentional, canon-consistent selected affordance; low priority.

findings.t: Autoplay-fail fallback abandons the graceful outro and the localized welcome beat
findings.r: On autoplay rejection, either render a tap-to-continue affordance so the outro can play on gesture, or route through beginOutro (welcome beat) rather than hard-cutting to lang_a11y, so mobile users get the same transition as desktop.

findings.t: Uploaded memory data URL degrades scene fidelity but is silently mishandled when both file read and preview fail
findings.r: If dataUrl resolves empty after all fallbacks, surface an error toast and do not advance (or retry), rather than persisting/celebrating a memory with no renderable content.

findings.t: Name input uses autoFocus, forcing keyboard/scroll on mobile
findings.r: Consider gating autoFocus to non-mobile (e.g. only when !isMobile) so the keyboard/scroll jump and premature focus move don't disrupt the mobile/AT flow while desktop keeps the convenience.

findings.t: Landscape scroll fix applies only to setup cards, not the full-screen phases
findings.r: Add overflowY:auto and top/flex-start alignment to the paywall/celebration overlay containers when isLandscapePhone (mirroring the setup-card treatment) so tall cards remain fully reachable on short landscape viewports.

findings.t: Pervasive hardcoded hex literals instead of imported canon tokens (connections)
findings.r: Import { INK, MUTED, HAIRLINE, TRAY, SAGE, CREAM, EMBER } from '@/lib/libraryTokens' and replace the literals so the surface stays token-locked.

findings.t: iOS users cannot see or disconnect accounts they connected on web
findings.r: On iOS still render ALREADY-connected accounts (read-only card + working Disconnect) and only suppress Connect CTAs / not-yet-shipped providers. Filter PROVIDERS to connected ones when hideComingSoon is true rather than dropping the whole grid.

findings.t: iOS 'cloud unavailable' note key missing from ALL locales — hardcoded English
findings.r: Add cloudUnavailableNative to the connections namespace of all 5 message files (translated), then drop the !== guard and inline literal so t() resolves normally.

findings.t: Connections card background is pure white #FFFFFF, off CREAM canon
findings.r: Switch the provider card background to CREAM #FCFAF5 so cards and modal share one warm surface.

findings.t: Connections loading/Suspense fallbacks are unstyled bare text
findings.r: Render 2-3 shimmer/skeleton provider cards matching the loaded layout footprint.

findings.t: iOS 'cloud unavailable' empty state is a bare centered paragraph
findings.r: Wrap in a TRAY-backgrounded card with an ember-glyph medallion and hairline border, reusing the Apple Photos note grammar.

findings.t: OAuth error param ignored — all failures show one generic message
findings.r: Map known error codes to specific messages and include the provider name.

findings.t: 'connected' toast can fire twice (fetchAccounts deps + replaceState timing)
findings.r: Use router.replace or a processedRef guard so the branch runs at most once per param value.

findings.t: Provider/Apple icons decorative but not aria-hidden
findings.r: Add aria-hidden='true' to the s prop object, matching the SettingsGlyph pattern.

findings.t: No iPad/compact-portrait layout — desktop leaks to iPad portrait
findings.r: Use useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() to drive card padding + full-width buttons on iPad portrait.

findings.t: Fixed top-right toast can clip off-screen with long translated strings
findings.r: On isMobile anchor to left:1rem/right:1rem or add maxWidth:calc(100% - 2rem).

findings.t: Toast/destructive buttons use one-off red #A63D3D not a canon token
findings.r: Promote danger red to a DANGER token in libraryTokens; use SAGE for success.

findings.t: No portrait/compact stacking control on the connections card
findings.r: Use useIsCompact()/useIsPortrait() for the action-row wrap so it degrades at intermediate widths.

findings.t: Provider brand accent colors sit in a warm-canon field without softening
findings.r: Keep brand colors on the glyph but warm/desaturate the medallion background toward TRAY.

findings.t: Missing t in URL-param effect deps (stale closure on locale change)
findings.r: Add t/locale to deps, or read the toast message lazily at render from a stored code.

findings.t: Dead defensive guard on sourcesOverline (key now exists)
findings.r: Simplify to label={t('sourcesOverline')} and remove the literal.

findings.t: Icon sizes use raw pixel numbers rather than rem
findings.r: Express icon sizes in rem or convert numeric size to a rem string inside ProviderIcon.

findings.t: Logged-out / no-session users are stuck on the subscription loading spinner forever
findings.r: Wrap the body in try/finally and call setLoading(false) in finally, or move it before the early return. Handle the no-user case explicitly (redirect to /login or an error state).

findings.t: iOS IAP can only ever purchase the ANNUAL plan — monthly is unreachable
findings.r: Render a lightweight monthly/annual toggle in the current-plan card path available on iOS (guarded by isApple && iapReady), or pass an explicit interval to the IAP flow so both StoreKit products are reachable.

findings.t: Hardcoded English 'Copy' string on the reward promo-code button
findings.r: Replace with {t('copy')} (or an existing copy label) and add 'copy' to the subscription namespace in all five locale files.

findings.t: Missing i18n keys manageOrCancel and inviteFriends in all 5 locales
findings.r: Add manageOrCancel and inviteFriends (translated) to all five files, then drop the inline English fallbacks.

findings.t: Currency <select> fontSize 0.8125rem triggers iOS Safari zoom-on-focus
findings.r: Set the select fontSize to 1rem (keep visual scale via padding/letter-spacing if needed).

findings.t: Subscription cards use pure #FFFFFF instead of canon cream
findings.r: Replace '#FFFFFF' card backgrounds with CREAM so cards/tiles/base share one warm-white ladder.

findings.t: Subscription raw hex literals everywhere instead of importing tokens
findings.r: Import INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/CREAM/TRAY/SAGE and the ember CTA gradient from libraryTokens.

findings.t: Select-dropdown arrow uses off-canon cold gray #666
findings.r: Change the chevron fill to URL-encoded MUTED %23716A5E.

findings.t: Subscription loading state is bare text, thinner than the cards it replaces
findings.r: Render a lightweight skeleton (cream cards, hairline borders, shimmer bars) using canon tokens.

findings.t: 'activated' success toast + refetch never fires for IAP returns; only Stripe
findings.r: Unify post-purchase reconciliation into one helper with a short poll/backoff shared by Stripe and IAP.

findings.t: detectCurrency() overwrites currency AFTER load, causing a visible price flip
findings.r: Initialize currency lazily from detectCurrency() (useState(() => detectCurrency())) so the first paint is correct.

findings.t: Inconsistent i18n missing-key handling (tf vs raw t!==key vs || fallback)
findings.r: Route all fallbacks through tf(key, fallback) and drop the hardcoded English branches.

findings.t: Billing-interval toggle not exposed as a radiogroup for AT
findings.r: Wrap in role=radiogroup with role=radio + aria-checked, or add aria-pressed.

findings.t: Subscription responsive layout relies almost entirely on isMobile
findings.r: Add flexWrap/gap to the header row and useIsPortrait for narrow landscape; verify the 3-col grid on iPad split-view.

findings.t: Progress-bar radius uses raw px instead of rem
findings.r: Change borderRadius:3 to '0.1875rem'.

findings.t: Subscription error/empty feedback relies solely on transient toasts
findings.r: Add a canon inline notice (hairline card + MUTED + EMBER retry) when core data fails to load.

findings.t: Ember CTA gradient duplicated ~10x inline
findings.r: Extract a shared emberCta style (idle + disabled) and reuse for all primary buttons.

findings.t: Status pill and progress colors use ad-hoc hex not in the token set
findings.r: Reference SAGE and T.color.error/success instead of #56683C / #C05050.

findings.t: Storage progressbar aria-valuemax/valuenow inconsistent when unlimited
findings.r: When unlimited, omit role=progressbar (plain text meter) or set aria-valuenow undefined.

findings.t: manageSubscriptions() failures on iOS are entirely silent
findings.r: Await it and show a toast pointing to iOS Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on reject.

findings.t: Referral 'Copy link' button label reuses referralCopied string
findings.r: Use a dedicated t('copyLink') for the button; keep referralCopied for the post-copy toast.

findings.t: Progressbar uses px border-radius and lacks aria-valuetext for unlimited
findings.r: Add aria-valuetext with the ∞ label and convert borderRadius:3 to rem.

findings.t: Gradient primary CTAs have no hover/active affordance
findings.r: Add a hover filter brightness to the gradient CTAs so all interactive controls respond on pointer devices.

findings.t: Passcode screen uses a completely different visual family from the other two Auth surfaces
findings.r: Align PasscodeEntry to the auth shell: same gradient/card treatment, EMBER primary CTA, Source Sans body. Reserve the TuscanCard/gold look for its non-auth public-share context only, or wrap all three in one shared AuthCard.

findings.t: Passcode CTA uses GOLD as the primary interactive color (canon reserves GOLD for ceremonial/focus)
findings.r: Switch the passcode primary buttons to the EMBER gradient used elsewhere (linear-gradient(135deg, terracotta, walnut)), keeping gold only as the focus-ring / header accent.

findings.t: Wing-only passcode shares 404 at the destination (/public/[slug] assumes a room)
findings.r: Handle wing-only shares in getShareData(): when share.room_id is null, load the wing (and its rooms/gallery) instead of returning null, or have createPasscode/validatePasscode reject wing-only shares if /public only supports rooms. Keep the passcode 'valid' state and the public destination in agreement.

findings.t: Passcode error message is not announced to screen readers (no role=alert / aria-live)
findings.r:
Wrap the error in

, add aria-invalid={!!error} and aria-describedby={error ? "passcode-error" : undefined} to the input, matching the forgot-password pattern.

findings.t: Text-only 'back to sign in' / 'back home' links fall short of the 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Give these links display:inline-block; minHeight:2.75rem; padding:0.5rem 0.75rem (or wrap in a padded tappable area) so the interactive box meets the 2.75rem minimum on touch.

findings.t: CTA/accent color is off-canon terracotta #C66B3D instead of EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Reconcile the legacy T.color.terracotta with libraryTokens EMBER #B85C38 (or map auth CTAs to the EMBER token) so the interactive color matches canon across surfaces.

findings.t: Body ink and muted colors drift from canon INK/MUTED
findings.r: Point auth title/body/muted colors at the canon INK (#403B36 / inkSoft) and MUTED (#716A5E) tokens for warm-ink consistency.

findings.t: Auth container font-family is 'Manrope', not the Fraunces/Source Sans canon
findings.r: Change the container fallback to T.font.body ('Source Sans 3', …) so nothing silently renders in Manrope.

findings.t: Error-alert palette is hardcoded and inconsistent across the two form surfaces
findings.r: Extract one shared error-banner style token set (warm-red on cream) and use it identically on all auth surfaces; at minimum make forgot-password use T.color.error like its sibling.

findings.t: reset-password footer link is labeled 'Request new link' but routes to /login
findings.r: Point this link to /forgot-password to match its label, or change the label to a 'back to sign in' string. Reuse the existing forgotPassword.backToSignIn / resetPassword.requestNewLink keys so the copy matches the destination.

findings.t: Passcode validation is a soft gate — /public/[slug] never re-checks the passcode
findings.r: If the passcode is meant to gate access, have validatePasscode() set a short-lived signed cookie/token for that share id and require it in getShareData(); otherwise drop the passcode framing and treat the slug as the secret. Align the UI promise with the actual enforcement.

findings.t: reset-password relies on getUser() to detect the recovery session, but a normally logged-in user gets the reset form too
findings.r: Distinguish the recovery flow explicitly (e.g. pass a ?type=recovery / one-time flag from the callback, or check the AAL/AMR of the session) rather than treating any authenticated session as a valid password-reset context.

findings.t: Passcode result panel and success state give no live announcement after validation
findings.r: Wrap the validated-share panel and the forgot-password success block in role="status" aria-live="polite" so the outcome is announced when the view swaps in.

findings.t: reset-password spinner/loading state has no accessible label
findings.r: Add role="status" + visually-hidden {t("loading")} text (or aria-label) to the spinner container so the loading state is announced.

findings.t: No responsive hooks; portrait/landscape and small-phone sizing rely purely on fixed maxWidth
findings.r: Introduce useIsCompact()/useIsPortrait() to tighten card padding (e.g. 1.5rem on compact) and heading size in short-landscape, keeping all branching inline per canon.

findings.t: reset-password re-hardcodes the entire auth shell instead of sharing it
findings.r: Extract a shared AuthShell component (card + gradient + blobs) used by both the (auth) layout and reset-password so the surfaces stay pixel-identical.

findings.t: Passcode empty/error state relies on JS-set border color with no reduced-motion or token-consistent focus
findings.r: Use a real CSS :focus-visible ring (gold) and gate the card entrance animation behind a prefers-reduced-motion guard for polish parity with the rest of the app.

findings.t: validatePasscode uses .single() on a non-unique passcode column — collisions surface as 'Invalid passcode'
findings.r: Either enforce global passcode uniqueness among active shares (DB partial unique index) or scope the passcode per-owner/per-slug and require the slug in the URL; at minimum use .maybeSingle()/limit(1) and handle the multi-row case deterministically instead of silently failing valid codes.

findings.t: forgot-password success state is one-way; no way to correct a typo'd email without a full reload
findings.r: Add a secondary 'try a different email' control in the success view that calls setSuccess(false) to return to the form, preserving the entered email if desired.

findings.t: Passcode code field lacks inputMode/enterKeyHint hints for on-screen keyboards
findings.r: Add enterKeyHint="go" (and consider spellCheck={false}) so the mobile keyboard advertises the submit action for this code field.

findings.t: reset-password duplicates the (auth) layout chrome instead of living in the route group
findings.r: Move reset-password under src/app/(auth)/ so it inherits the shared layout, or extract the wrapper into a shared component to keep safe-area/responsive handling in one place.

findings.t: Tile touch targets can fall well below 2.75rem in packed rows on phones
findings.r: On coarse-pointer/mobile, enforce a floor: raise targetRowHeight or clamp per-tile min-height to 2.75rem, and/or reduce tiles-per-row on narrow widths so no packed tile renders under 44px in either dimension.

findings.t: Jump-to-date rail is keyboard-unreachable (tabIndex={-1})
findings.r: Expose the rail as a real navigation control: give the container role="navigation" with an aria-label, make tick buttons focusable (drop tabIndex={-1}), and remove aria-hidden so AT users can jump to sections; keep the pointer-drag as an enhancement.

findings.t: Canon color tokens re-hardcoded as hex literals throughout the wall
findings.r: Import INK, MUTED, HAIRLINE, GOLD_SOFT, EMBER_GLYPH from libraryTokens and replace the literals; use the already-imported CREAM in the sticky-band gradient instead of a fresh #FCFAF5.

findings.t: Focus ring grammar diverges from the shared focusRing token
findings.r: Reference GOLD from the token instead of #D4AF37, and add a second inset contrast ring so the gold focus reads on both light and dark tiles.

findings.t: Empty/fallback glyph tiles render washed-out on the light Il Muro gradient
findings.r: For PhotoWall fallbacks pass a canon ink/ember-glyph iconColor (e.g. EMBER_GLYPH or INK at ~0.7) rather than translucent white.

findings.t: Room-lens 'undated last' sort is dead code — undated tiles are NOT forced to the end
findings.r: Detect the undated bucket by comparing the label against undatedLabel so the existing undated-last sort actually fires.

findings.t: Last/short row can overflow container width for wide (panoramic) tiles
findings.r: For the last row, if summed widths + gaps exceed containerWidth, solve the row height to fit or cap each tile width.

findings.t: Tiles lack list semantics and selection state for screen readers
findings.r: Wrap rows in role=list and set aria-pressed={selected} (or role=checkbox + aria-checked) in selectMode.

findings.t: Selection checkmark badge has no text alternative
findings.r: Pair the visual badge with aria-pressed on the button or a visually-hidden 'Selected' label.

findings.t: Layout seam gap uses raw px instead of rem
findings.r: Express the seam in rem (e.g. 0.1875rem) or thread it through the packer as a rem-derived px value.

findings.t: Scrubber-rail tick spends gold-family color on a generic nav control
findings.r: Use EMBER for the active/hover tick and reserve gold only for the section-band gilt rule.

findings.t: Selected-tile check badge uses fixed rem size regardless of tile scale
findings.r: Scale the badge and its inset from the packed tile height so the selection mark keeps consistent visual weight.

findings.t: Sibling TuscanCard primitive still carries off-canon dark bronze-glass styling
findings.r: Migrate any Il Muro-adjacent TuscanCard usage to warm-ink SHADOW ramp + CREAM/HAIRLINE tokens and 0.0625rem hairlines.

findings.t: TileMedia source-fallback index persists across memory changes due to key reuse
findings.r: Reset idx when the sources array identity/length changes (useEffect on [sources]).

findings.t: Tiles use role=listitem without an enclosing role=list, breaking list semantics
findings.r: Either drop role=listitem or add role=list to the row/section containers.

findings.t: onDragEnd fires without the !selectMode guard used by draggable/onDragStart
findings.r: Match the guard: onDragEnd={draggableTiles && !selectMode ? () => onTileDragEnd?.() : undefined}.

findings.t: countLabel renders a bare number with no unit/pluralization for AT
findings.r: Return a translated, pluralized string (reuse memoryCount key) across en/nl/de/es/fr.

findings.t: Native HTML5 drag-to-room has no keyboard/touch equivalent
findings.r: Provide a non-drag path (context/kebab action or selectMode + move-selected) reachable on touch and keyboard.

findings.t: Section band media use no lang-aware alt; decorative alt='' on real photos
findings.r: Append the media type to the button's accessible name so audio/video/document memories are distinguishable non-visually.

findings.t: Entire TutorialOverlay is commented out / never rendered in production
findings.r: If NudgeTooltip is the intended replacement, delete TutorialOverlay.tsx, tutorialStore.ts, the now-dead useTutorialStore reads (lines 319-321), and the MobileBottomBar launcher to prevent a live-but-invisible tutorial. If the overlay is still wanted, re-enable the render and wire the auto-start/event listener to it.

findings.t: MobileBottomBar 'tour' menu item is a dead control (starts an overlay that never renders)
findings.r: Change the mobile 'tour' action to dispatch window.dispatchEvent(new Event('mp:open-palace-tutorial')) (matching NavigationBar) so mobile users get the actual tour instead of a no-op.

findings.t: Off-canon dark bronze-glass panel in TutorialOverlay (leftover dark theme, not CREAM/INK)
findings.r: Move to the canon scrim grammar: a CREAM/linen glass panel with INK text (as sibling reskinned overlays use), or at minimum derive the tint from a theme token (e.g. T.color.charcoal / T.land.dark) so it is not a floating magic hex. Match the visual era of the light TourButton that launches it.

findings.t: Local off-canon gold hex constants instead of canon GOLD tokens
findings.r: Replace the DOM/text uses with canon tokens: title/label text and progress bar in T.color.gold (#D4AF37) with T.color.goldDark for gradient depth; drop the #FFEEBB/#FFD080 pastels for chrome. Keep bespoke bright hexes only inside TutorialSpirit's additive-blended 3D materials where an emissive glow is intentional.

findings.t: TutorialSpirit (createSpirit) is entirely orphaned dead code
