findings.r: Delete TutorialSpirit.tsx along with the overlay, or if kept, add a dispose() (dispose geometries/materials, remove from scene) and wire it via SpiritHandle.setTarget from the step spiritPos.

findings.t: Cold black/white shadows and tracks instead of warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
findings.r: Swap rgba(0,0,0,x) shadows to warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) per the SHADOW ladder, and replace rgba(255,255,255,0.08)/0.12 track and inactive-dot fills with a warm low-alpha ink or hairline-derived tint.

findings.t: Animations have no reduced-motion guard
findings.r: Gate the typewriter and keyframe animations behind a prefers-reduced-motion check (render full text instantly, drop pulse/blink) via a useReducedMotion hook or media query wrapper, matching guards used elsewhere.

findings.t: TourButton visually inconsistent with the overlay it launches
findings.r: Unify the two: make the overlay light-canon to match the button, or restyle both from the same token set. Use warm-ink shadow and EMBER accent on the button's orb rather than the #FFEEBB/#FFD080 pastel gradient.

findings.t: aria-label i18n key 'stepDot' is missing in all locales, so screen readers announce the literal 'stepDot'
findings.r: Add a 'stepDot' key like 'Step {current} of {total}' to all five message files, and drop role='presentation' (or move the label onto the parent dot container with role='img') so the label is exposed.

findings.t: TourButton is an exported dead component (never mounted)
findings.r: Remove TourButton, or if a re-usable tour launcher is desired, repoint its onClick to the mp:open-palace-tutorial event and mount it where needed.

findings.t: Step dots use role='presentation' together with an aria-label — the label is discarded
findings.r: Remove aria-label from the presentational dots and instead give the progress bar container role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax/aria-valuetext, or add a visually-hidden aria-live='polite' line announcing 'Step X of N' once per step.

findings.t: Bubble layout only branches on useIsMobile — no useIsCompact/useIsTablet path for iPad portrait
findings.r: Introduce useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() to raise the bottom offset (and possibly tighten width) on iPad portrait so the bubble clears the on-canvas controls the same way it does on phones.

findings.t: Highlight label uses tiny pastel text with cold drop-shadow
findings.r: Use T.color.gold (or EMBER) for the label, a warm-ink text shadow, and consider the canon overline treatment (uppercase/letter-spacing) for the small-caps voice at this size.

findings.t: TutorialSpirit orb colors are bespoke pastels (defensible but untokened)
findings.r: Extract the spirit's emissive palette into shared named constants (SPIRIT_CORE/GLOW/HALO) reused by both files, and tie the warm hue to a documented gold-glow so orb and overlay chrome stay in sync if canon gold shifts.

findings.t: Typewriter effect re-runs on 'message' identity, risking restart on locale/re-render
findings.r: Depend on [active, stepIndex] only and read message via a ref, or snapshot message at effect start, so a background messages update doesn't restart the animation.

findings.t: Navigation copy hardcodes both keyboard and touch instructions instead of adapting to the active modality
findings.r: Split into modality-specific message keys and select via useTouchControls() so touch users see joystick/swipe wording and keyboard users see WASD wording.

findings.t: Progress bar conveys progress by color only, with no text alternative
findings.r: Wrap the progress bar in role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow={stepIndex+1}, aria-valuemin={1}, aria-valuemax={TUTORIAL_STEPS.length} and an aria-valuetext localized string; this also makes the missing stepDot label redundant.

findings.t: All profile form inputs use fontSize 0.9375rem — triggers iOS Safari zoom-on-focus
findings.r: Set inputStyle.fontSize to '1rem' (16px) for all editable fields. If the 15px desktop size is desired, gate it behind touch/useIsMobile() and keep >=1rem on touch devices.

findings.t: Custom buttons (switches, pills, avatar, quiz) have no visible focus ring
findings.r: Add a shared :focus-visible rule (e.g. a .mp-settings-btn class or button:focus-visible in the <style> block) applying the same GOLD outline/offset to all custom buttons.

findings.t: Discard button does not reset the WhatsApp phone field
findings.r: Add setWhatsappPhone(profile.whatsapp_phone) to the Discard onClick so all four fields tracked by hasChanges are reverted.

findings.t: Changing language discards unsaved profile edits without warning
findings.r: Guard the language switch when hasChanges is true (confirm dialog) or use the setLocaleNoReload path on the settings surface so pending edits survive the locale change.

findings.t: Profile section-overline + link-row description strings missing from every locale
findings.r: Add these five keys (plus viewPublicProfile confirmation) to en/nl/de/es/fr settings namespaces with proper translations so tf() fallback is never hit for non-English users.

findings.t: Profile inset panels use the same #FCFAF5 as their parent card, so nested rows don't recess
findings.r: Give inset rows a recessed fill (TRAY #F6EBE3) or paint the card white/linen so nested panels sit visibly below the surface.

findings.t: Interactive text color inconsistent between EMBER #B85C38 and EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A
findings.r: Use EMBER #B85C38 consistently for actionable links/buttons; reserve #9A4F2A for at-rest glyphs/medallion ink.

findings.t: Renaissance style-pill selected accent uses off-canon gilt #C8A858
findings.r: Use EMBER #B85C38 (matching the roman pill's active grammar) or GOLD #D4AF37 if ceremonial.

findings.t: Profile loading/error states are bare centered text with no card/skeleton
findings.r: Wrap loading/error in the card grammar (or a skeleton of the profile card) and give error an icon + retry.

findings.t: Persona 'Retake / Take quiz' CTA lands on /atrium with no anchor to the quiz
findings.r: Push /atrium?persona=1 and have HomeView read it to open + scroll to the quiz.

findings.t: Profile can be made public before a username exists
findings.r: Disable the visibility toggle (or prompt for a username) when profile.username is empty, mirroring the URL-row gate.

findings.t: Reduced-motion block strips transitions app-wide and disables hover overlay reveal
findings.r: Scope reduced-motion overrides to the animated elements on this page rather than bare button/input/span.

findings.t: 'Change photo' text button touch target far below 2.75rem
findings.r: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' and horizontal padding, matching the retake-quiz/public-profile controls.

findings.t: Daylight time-of-day range input has a sub-2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Give the range input minHeight (2.75rem) and/or a larger custom thumb via ::-webkit-slider-thumb.

findings.t: Profile canon tokens hardcoded as raw hex instead of imported
findings.r: Import INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE/EMBER/EMBER_GLYPH/TRAY/CREAM from libraryTokens and reference tokens.

findings.t: Toast success color #56683C defined inline rather than via SAGE
findings.r: Reference SAGE and T.color.error tokens for the toast palette.

findings.t: Persona label reads localStorage only — stale after retaking on another device
findings.r: Persist persona to the profiles row and hydrate from it; use localStorage only as an optimistic cache.

findings.t: Username under 3 chars accepted by input but rejected server-side
findings.r: Validate length inline (disable Save or show a field hint below 3 chars) before calling the server action.

findings.t: Avatar upload is image-only with no capture hint
findings.r: Optional: add capture='user' if direct selfie capture is desired; otherwise no change.

findings.t: Language/Palace-Style selectors use aria-pressed buttons instead of radiogroup
findings.r: Wrap in role=radiogroup with role=radio + aria-checked children, mirroring Text-Size.

findings.t: Settings tour spotlight is dead — target [data-mp-settings-tabs] does not exist in the active layout
findings.r: Add data-mp-settings-tabs to the stacked and desktop <nav> in settings/layout.tsx, or change the selector to a nav that exists in the active shell (e.g. nav[aria-label]). Verify targetBox resolves and the spotlight lands on the real route.

findings.t: Mobile anti-zoom / touch-target fix is scoped to brittle selectors and misses styled inputs
findings.r: Broaden to .mp-settings-mobile-content input, select, textarea { font-size:1rem } and enforce min-height on inputs/selects; drop the border-radius[*=] card selectors for a shared card className. Better: set fontSize:1rem at the input component level.

findings.t: Off-canon chevron stroke hex #C9BCA6 not in the palette
findings.r: Use HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC) or MUTED (#716A5E) for the at-rest chevron instead of ad-hoc #C9BCA6.

findings.t: Mobile card polish depends on a brittle inline-style attribute-substring selector
findings.r: Tag cards with a shared class (.mp-settings-card) and target that in the mobile override instead of a fragile border-radius substring.

findings.t: iOS subscription visibility diverges between nav and tutorial after IAP merge
findings.r: Filter the subscription bullet with (isIOS() && !IAP_ENABLED && f.titleKey==='feat_subscription_title') so the tour mirrors the nav on iOS.

findings.t: Sign-out button lacks disabled/aria-busy state during in-flight sign-out
findings.r: Pass disabled={signingOut} aria-busy={signingOut} (and type='button') to both sign-out buttons.

findings.t: Horizontal tab bar has no roving/keyboard affordance and can hide overflow items
findings.r: Add scroll-snap-type:x and scroll-margin, scrollIntoView the active item on mount, and consider an edge fade to signal more tabs.

findings.t: Tutorial spotlight overlay ignores prefers-reduced-motion for pulse/tip animations
findings.r: Wrap pulse/entrance animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), matching SettingsInline.

findings.t: Hardcoded white/cream hex literals instead of tokens (shell)
findings.r: Replace '#FCFAF5' literals with the CREAM token; consider a warm-white token for the sidebar card instead of raw #FFFFFF.

findings.t: Layout max-widths use unitless px rather than rem
findings.r: Express as rem (e.g. maxWidth:'73.75rem') to scale with accessibility font settings.

findings.t: GOLD focus-ring color hardcoded in the <style> block
findings.r: Interpolate GOLD into the template string so the ring can never drift from canon.

findings.t: Redirect page ships no styled loading/transition state
findings.r: Acceptable given it's an instant server redirect; add a minimal CREAM loading shell only if a flash is observed.

findings.t: Stacked tab bar has no active-tab auto-scroll
findings.r: Add a ref+effect calling scrollIntoView({inline:'center'}) on the active tab when pathname changes (guard with reduced-motion).

findings.t: Tutorial uses raw px offsets/radii instead of rem
findings.r: Convert sizing constants to rem (or measure the tooltip after render) so the spotlight tracks text scaling; keep px only for the hairline border.

findings.t: Nav item descriptions single-line truncated, hiding info on narrow sidebar
findings.r: Allow up to 2 lines (-webkit-line-clamp:2) or add title={navDesc(item)}.

findings.t: Not-found error state uses fonts and hex found nowhere else in the app (fully off-canon)
findings.r: Import T from @/lib/theme and use T.font.display / T.font.body, T.color.charcoal for the heading and T.color.muted for the body. Better still, use the canon INK/MUTED tokens. Wrap it in the same linen/cream background used by the tree view so the error state feels part of the palace.

findings.t: Entire shared surface is built on the legacy T palette, not the canon libraryTokens palette
findings.r: Migrate this surface (and the shared PersonCard) onto libraryTokens: CREAM bg, INK text, MUTED secondary, EMBER for interactive, GOLD for the self/ceremonial ring, HAIRLINE for borders. If a full migration is out of scope, at minimum align charcoal→INK, muted→MUTED and terracotta→EMBER so it matches sibling surfaces.

findings.t: Empty-tree state is bare, unstyled, and shows a hardcoded English string
findings.r: Give the empty state the canon treatment: a centered TreeBranchIcon in EMBER_GLYPH, a Fraunces title and a Source Sans supporting line, on the cream field, with rem spacing. (Also move the copy into t() for i18n.)

findings.t: fitToView multi-tree offset diverges from render offset — Fit View mis-frames any forest with >1 tree
findings.r: Compute a per-tree bounding box inside the forEach (reset local treeMinX/treeMaxX each iteration, mirroring renderTree), advance offsetX by the per-tree width, and accumulate the GLOBAL min/max separately from the offset step. The two functions must share identical offset math — ideally factor the offset computation in

findings.t: Auto-fit triggers setState during render (side effect in component body)
findings.r: Move auto-fit into a useEffect keyed on [treeLayouts] (and a mounted flag) so it re-evaluates after the ref is attached and after layout changes, e.g. useEffect(() => { if(treeLayouts.length) requestAnimationFrame(fitToView); }, [treeLayouts]).

findings.t: Not-found page bypasses i18n system, hardcodes wrong fonts, and is off-canon
findings.r: Route these strings through the shared i18n message files (familyTree namespace keys e.g. sharedTreeNotFoundTitle/Desc) and use T.font.display / T.font.body + T.color tokens so the expired-link page matches canon and stays translatable.

findings.t: Hairline borders use px, not the canon HAIRLINE color/rem rule
findings.r: Use 1px solid ${HAIRLINE} (from libraryTokens) for both. Keep px width (canon allows px for hairlines) but drop the alpha-hex suffix so the seam is the warm sand tone.

findings.t: Fit-view button and close button are below the 2.75rem touch target and lack canon button styling
findings.r: Raise both to minHeight/minWidth 2.75rem. Replace the literal 'x' with the existing CloseIcon SVG from PersonCard (color MUTED). Give the fitView button the canon ghost-button treatment (HAIRLINE border, INK label, EMBER on hover).

findings.t: Detail-panel overlay is a cold pure-black scrim instead of a warm-ink veil
findings.r: Use rgba(64,59,54,0.2) for the scrim and the canon SHADOW[2] (0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)) for the panel so the veil is warm-ink consistent.

findings.t: Hardcoded English empty-state string bypasses i18n
findings.r: Replace with {t("sharedTreeEmpty")} (or similar) and add the key to all five locale message files.

findings.t: Dead notes panel block — notes are always null-redacted server-side
findings.r: Remove the notes block from the shared view (or add a code comment noting notes are always redacted here) so intent is explicit and the panel matches the sanitized data contract.

findings.t: Not-found fallback uses wrong fonts/colors and a separate hardcoded string map instead of i18n + design canon
findings.r: Use the existing server translation helper (serverT/getServerLocale, already imported in family-tree-actions) to resolve these strings from the shared messages files, and align fonts/colors to the theme tokens for consistency.

findings.t: onWheel calls e.preventDefault() on a passive React listener
findings.r: Attach a non-passive native wheel listener via useEffect/ref addEventListener('wheel', fn, { passive: false }) instead of the React onWheel prop, or set touch-action/overscroll-behavior on the container.

findings.t: Detail-panel close control is a literal 'x' glyph with sub-target tap size
findings.r: Give the close button minWidth/minHeight 2.75rem, center content, and use the imported-style CloseIcon SVG instead of a literal 'x'.

findings.t: Canvas relies on useIsMobile only; no landscape/iPad-specific tuning and fixed 100vh
findings.r: Use 100dvh (or a --vh var) for the shell, and consider useIsCompact for the sheet-vs-modal switch so iPad portrait also gets the bottom sheet; scale fitToView pad by viewport.

findings.t: fitView / person-card / report controls lack explicit 2.75rem touch sizing
findings.r: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' (and adequate width) to the fitView button; consider a minimum zoom floor or larger hit-padding so cards remain tappable when zoomed out on touch.

findings.t: Relationship rows and notes block use cream as a divider/fill, reducing contrast and rhythm
findings.r: Use HAIRLINE for the row dividers and TRAY (#F6EBE3, the recessed sandstone tray) for the notes fill so both read against the cream panel.

findings.t: Link paths and shadow rects use bare px stroke/offsets and neutral sandstone links
findings.r: Stroke links with HAIRLINE (or EMBER_GLYPH at low opacity) for warmth, and consolidate the card drop-shadow onto a single warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) value matching the SHADOW ramp.

findings.t: Single-finger tap detection (moved flag) computed but never consumed
findings.r: Either remove the moved tracking as dead code, or wire it: in the node tap path, ignore selection when touchRef.current?.moved is true.

findings.t: Close button uses literal 'x' glyph rather than an icon/× entity
findings.r: Replace the 'x' text with a × entity (×) or a small icon component for a cleaner close affordance.

findings.t: No reduced-motion guard on auto-fit animation frame / zoom transitions
findings.r: Gate any animated camera transition behind a prefers-reduced-motion check; the instant setPan/setZoom here is acceptable but document/guard it if a transition is ever added.

findings.t: Clicking any memory painting in the visitor walk does nothing (no memory viewer)
findings.r: Add a read-only memory-detail modal: when mem is an object (not a control string), set a selectedMemory state and render a viewer (title/desc/media). Keep '__upload_painting__' and '__upload__' as no-ops so guest upload stations do nothing gracefully.

findings.t: Primary CTA, Follow, and Passcode buttons all spend GOLD — violating THE ONE RULE (gold is palace-only, EMBER is the interactive color)
findings.r: Repaint the primary CTA, Follow, and Passcode submit with EMBER #B85C38 (or the ember gradient used by sibling surfaces) and reserve gold strictly for the sealed/ceremonial header accent and focus rings.

findings.t: Headings use near-black charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36
findings.r: Switch primary text from T.color.charcoal (#1F1B1A) to canon INK #403B36 (T.color.inkSoft) across headings, stat numbers, and modal titles on both files.

findings.t: Clicking a wing building on the exterior does nothing; only the front door works
findings.r: Handle wing-id clicks from the exterior (navigate to entrance, or directly to that wing's corridor if the id matches a published wing slug) so exterior wing clicks are not silently swallowed.

findings.t: getPublishedRooms / getVisitorWingData return ALL rooms in a published wing, ignoring per-room published_at
findings.r: Confirm the intended contract. If per-room publishing exists, filter rooms by .not('published_at','is',null) and filter memories by displayed !== false. If wing-level publish is authoritative, remove the misleading published_at selection to avoid future confusion.

findings.t: Cold black shadows rgba(0,0,0,x) everywhere instead of canon warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
findings.r: Replace rgba(0,0,0,x) shadows with the canon warm-ink SHADOW ramp rgba(64,59,54,x) (import SHADOW/HOVER_SHADOW from libraryTokens) on both files.

findings.t: Hero CTA hover offsets and avatar shadow use px, not rem
findings.r: Convert transform/shadow offsets to rem (translateY(-0.125rem), 0 0.375rem 1.25rem ...), ideally reusing HOVER_LIFT/HOVER_SHADOW tokens.

findings.t: Passcode input font-size 0.875rem risks iOS zoom and uses raw monospace
findings.r: Raise input to fontSize '1rem' and use a defined monospace token or Source Sans with letter-spacing rather than the raw 'monospace' keyword.

findings.t: Interactive wing cards and passcode input have no visible focus ring
findings.r: Add a canon GOLD focus ring (outline 0.1875rem solid #D4AF37, offset 0.1875rem) on :focus-visible for the wing cards and restore a visible focus style on the passcode input.

findings.t: Overview 'Enter 3D Palace' CTA and Wing cards use owner?.id which can be undefined, producing a broken /visit/undefined/... route
findings.r: Guard on owner before rendering the CTA/wing grid, or derive a required ownerId prop from the server (params userId) instead of owner?.id so routes can never contain 'undefined'.

findings.t: PalaceSubNav management callbacks are all empty no-ops in visitor mode without disabling the controls
findings.r: Pass a visitor/read-only flag to PalaceSubNav so owner-only management buttons are hidden entirely, instead of rendering buttons bound to empty handlers.

findings.t: Hardcoded English user-facing strings in overview stats and section header
findings.r: Route wing/Wing labels and the 'X's Palace' title through useTranslation with proper plural/interpolation keys across all 5 locales.

findings.t: Guestbook error/'Failed' fallback strings are hardcoded English (both fallbacks)
findings.r: Replace with a translated fallback, e.g. t("guestbookSendError") / t("commentFailed"), added across en/nl/de/es/fr.

findings.t: Guestbook close button below 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Bump width/height to 2.75rem (keep the 14px icon centered), or add hit-slop via padding so the tappable area reaches 44px.

findings.t: Mobile guestbook FAB and passcode submit/input are under 2.75rem tall
findings.r: Enforce minHeight: '2.75rem' (and equivalent minWidth for icon-only circles) on the guestbook FAB, passcode input, and passcode submit button.

findings.t: Walk overlay error toast uses off-canon web-red #c0392b and pure #fff
findings.r: Use T.color.error for the toast background and T.color.cream for its text to match the success toast and the warm palette.

findings.t: 'X's Palace' possessive and 'Wing'/'wings' labels are hardcoded English, off-brand vs i18n'd siblings
findings.r: Route the palace-title and wing-count labels through translation keys so the header reads as a single, brand-consistent voice in all locales.

findings.t: No reduced-motion guard on the many entrance animations
findings.r: Gate the animation property behind a reduced-motion check (usePrefersReducedMotion() returning animation: 'none') so motion-sensitive visitors get a static render.

findings.t: Guestbook toggle relies on title tooltip only for its accessible name on mobile
findings.r: Add aria-label={t('guestbook')} to the guestbook toggle button so its purpose is announced when the text label is hidden on mobile.

findings.t: ExportPanel uses the legacy T theme instead of libraryTokens canon
findings.r: Migrate ExportPanel onto libraryTokens: terracotta→EMBER, charcoal→INK, muted→MUTED, cream borders→HAIRLINE (at minimum alias them).

findings.t: ExportPanel borders use cream #FCFAF5 not canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC
findings.r: Replace all 1px solid T.color.cream borders with HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC) from libraryTokens.

findings.t: Export scan failure leaves the panel open with no content, no error, no way out
findings.r: Add an error state (setScanError(true)) in the catch and render an error branch with message + Retry + Cancel that reset exportOpen/tree. Never leave exportOpen=true with tree=null and no controls.

findings.t: Legacy http(s) photos are counted as exportable then always fail, forcing a false 'partial' toast
findings.r: Either resolve legacy URLs through fetch as well, or exclude non-proxy URLs from storageFiles up front so they don't count toward totalSelectedPhotos or trip the partial toast; reserve the error toast for genuine proxy failures.

findings.t: ExportPanel disabled CTA/progress track use off-canon sandstone #D6CCBA
findings.r: Use TRAY (#F6EBE3) for the recessed track and a HAIRLINE/MUTED-derived fill for the disabled button.

findings.t: MetaIcon SVG sizing uses raw px and default stroke = T.color.muted
findings.r: Express the icon box in rem and default the stroke to canon MUTED #716A5E or EMBER_GLYPH.

findings.t: Intentional photo cap (default 50) reported to the user as a failure
findings.r: Distinguish slider-capped photos from genuine download failures; show capped counts as neutral/info, error toast only for failedCount.

findings.t: Scan treats logged-out/expired session as a valid empty tree
findings.r: Have scanExportTree signal the unauthenticated case and short-circuit to an auth error/re-login prompt.

findings.t: Chevron rotation transition has no reduced-motion guard
findings.r: Gate the transition behind a reduced-motion check, setting transition:'none' when reduce is requested.

findings.t: Photo-count range slider has no accessible name or value text
findings.r: Add aria-label={t('exportMaxPhotos')} and aria-valuetext, or an htmlFor label.

findings.t: Select all / Select none links are 0-padding micro-targets
findings.r: Add padding + min touch height on touch devices; add underline/button chrome.

findings.t: Owner-name label at 0.5625rem in sandstone below legible/canon overline size
findings.r: Raise to >=0.6875rem overline and color with MUTED; keep it subordinate via weight not shrinking.

findings.t: Expand caret uses a raw unicode triangle instead of the WingRoomIcons chevron
findings.r: Use a small stroke SVG chevron matching MetaIcon line weight and EMBER_GLYPH color.

findings.t: family_groups meta count uses created_by while family_members is queried by user_id
findings.r: Make the meta count reflect the union actually exported so enable/disable state and payload agree.

findings.t: Photo dedupe counter can loop unbounded on pathological duplicate names
findings.r: If the 500 cap is raised, use a per-basename counter map instead of a rescanning while-loop.

findings.t: Export primary/secondary layout not adapted for narrow portrait
findings.r: On isMobile switch header/action rows to flexDirection:column with full-width buttons.

findings.t: QR code and generic share link point to /palace?shared= which nothing reads — shared context is silently lost
findings.r: Either add a handler in palace/page.tsx that reads ?shared= and resolves/opens the shared room (validating access), or repoint the QR + generic link to the working /public/{slug} URL guarded on publicShare?.is_active. Do not ship a share affordance whose target param is never consumed.

findings.t: PublishModal swallows all publish/unpublish failures; error state is unreachable and success is always shown
findings.r: Capture results: `const results = await Promise.all(ops)` and if results.some(r => r && r.ok === false) call setError(t(...)) and skip the done/close path. Wrap in try/catch for network rejections too.

findings.t: Privacy toggles (Allow download, Show in public palace) start from hardcoded defaults, never seeded from server — mutate wrong baseline
findings.r: Seed both toggles from server state on mount (extend fetchRoomShares or a new fetch to return allow_download + public visibility), and surface success/error from updateShareDownloadPermission/updateRoomPublicVisibility instead of firing them fire-and-forget.

findings.t: Per-collaborator permission edit and privacy toggles are fire-and-forget with no rollback on failure
findings.r: Inspect the returned {error} and revert local state + setError on failure, matching removePerson's rollback pattern.

findings.t: Primary CTA gradient uses GOLD instead of canon EMBER
findings.r: Repaint the primary CTA in EMBER (T-token or #B85C38, or an ember->rustDeep gradient) to match SharingPanel's accent buttons; keep gold only for focus rings and ceremonial marks.

findings.t: Pure-black scrim breaks warm-ink canon and sibling consistency
findings.r: Switch both scrims to the warm umber used by siblings (rgba(42,34,24,.5)) so all four share surfaces dim identically.

findings.t: Off-canon black modal shadow (also px units)
findings.r: Use a warm-ink shadow in rem, e.g. 0 0.5rem 2rem rgba(64,59,54,0.18).

findings.t: Primary text uses cool charcoal #1F1B1A, not canon INK #403B36
findings.r: Point primary text at canon INK (T.color.inkSoft / #403B36) in PublishModal, QRShareModal and ShareCard.

findings.t: PublishModal selection accent is GOLD where EMBER is expected
findings.r: Use EMBER for selected border/tint and checkbox accentColor; reserve gold for the ceremonial 'Published' badge.

findings.t: QRShareModal generate effect omits t from deps, so a locale switch leaves a stale error message
findings.r: Add t to the dependency array (or read the error string lazily at catch time from a ref).

findings.t: ShareCard image OG render is async but download/share can fire before onload completes
findings.r: Track a cardReady state set true after render and disable/soft-block Download/Share until true, mirroring QRShareModal.

findings.t: SharingPanel 'QR' button label is hardcoded, not translated
findings.r: Route the aria-label (and ideally visible label) through t(), e.g. aria-label={t('shareViaQR')}.

findings.t: PublishModal has no focus trap and no reduced-motion guard on its spinner
findings.r: Add useFocusTrap(true) and wrap the spin keyframe in a prefers-reduced-motion guard, as SharingPanel does.

findings.t: QRShareModal lacks a focus trap and its buttons dip below touch minimum
findings.r: Add useFocusTrap(true) and minHeight 2.75rem on Copy/Download/close buttons.

findings.t: QR frame & canvas borders use near-invisible non-canon hairlines
findings.r: Use canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC (1px) for card/canvas frames.

findings.t: QRShareModal action buttons fall below the 2.75rem touch target
findings.r: Add minHeight: T.touch (2.75rem) to Copy/Download/Close buttons.

findings.t: Publish/QR modals skip responsive hooks used elsewhere on the surface
findings.r: Adopt useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() inline adjustments for padding and touch sizing.

findings.t: QRShareModal copy-link fallback comment is a no-op — clipboard failure gives the user nothing
findings.r: Implement the promised fallback (select URL text / execCommand copy) or surface a brief 'copy failed' hint.

findings.t: PublishModal publish diff can no-op silently when server returns already-published rooms filtered out of the tree
findings.r: Ensure getMyPublishableContent returns and renders any currently-published wing/room so users can always unpublish.

findings.t: ShareCard social share links lack per-platform aria-labels; some platform names are English literals
findings.r: Localize the Email label while keeping proper-noun brand names as-is.

findings.t: ShareCard OG canvas hardcodes Georgia/serif — non-Latin locale titles may render poorly
findings.r: Optionally load the brand webfont for canvas rendering or verify wrapText handles longer DE/FR strings.

findings.t: Follow-button CTA painted GOLD instead of canon EMBER interactive color
findings.r: Repaint the active Follow CTA with EMBER (gradient from #B85C38 to a darker ember), reserving GOLD strictly for focus rings/seals. Keep the outline 'Following' state but base its border on HAIRLINE #E3D6BC / EMBER rather than sandstone.

findings.t: Category chip spends GOLD on a generic filter/tag
findings.r: Restyle the category chip with a neutral recessed tray (TRAY #F6EBE3 background, MUTED/INK text) or a subtle EMBER-glyph tint, freeing gold for palace-only usage.

findings.t: Follow button renders and silently no-ops for signed-out visitors
findings.r: Gate the button on authentication: pass an isAuthenticated prop (ProfilePageClient already has it) and for signed-out viewers either hide the button or route to sign-in on click (router.push('/login?next=/u/'+username)). Do not render a live Follow control that server-side no-ops for anonymous users.

findings.t: handleFollow has no error handling — rejected mutation leaves UI silently stale
findings.r: Wrap the await in try/catch; on failure surface a toast/inline error and do not leave the button in a wait state. Consider optimistic update + rollback in catch so a network blip is recoverable rather than silently swallowed.

findings.t: Follow button falls below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum
findings.r: Add minHeight: '2.75rem' (and ideally minWidth: '2.75rem') to the follow button style, matching the SafetyMenu buttons which already set minHeight: '2.75rem'.

findings.t: Cool black shadows and translucent-white card surface instead of warm-ink/cream canon
findings.r: Either move these Explore cards onto a canon surface (CREAM bg, HAIRLINE 1px border, SHADOW ramp rgba(64,59,54,x)) or update the shared TuscanCard glass/elevated variants to warm-ink shadows and a cream base.

findings.t: No visible GOLD focus ring on interactive card elements
findings.r: Add a :focus-visible style using the canon focusRing (outline 0.1875rem solid GOLD, outlineOffset 0.1875rem) to the Follow button and the PalaceCard clickable div. This is the one legitimate use of gold on these surfaces.

findings.t: Bio secondary text uses walnut #8B7355 rather than canon muted
findings.r: Render bio text in canon MUTED #716A5E (or INK for full-strength prose) so bio, username, and stats share one secondary voice.

findings.t: PalaceCard.tsx is dead code — never imported or wired
findings.r: Either delete this unused component or wire it into the Explore rails in place of the ad-hoc local PalaceCard, passing an onClick that router.push()es to the palace (using palace.first_wing_slug). As-is it is a maintenance trap that duplicates a diverged local implementation.

findings.t: Optimistic follower count can desync / go negative on spurious server response
findings.r: Only mutate followerCount when the operation actually changed state. Have toggleFollow return a discriminated result ({ changed: boolean, following: boolean }) or the authoritative new count, and skip the +/-1 when changed is false.

findings.t: Neither card uses responsive hooks; layout is prop-driven only
findings.r: Derive compact/spacing from useIsCompact()/useIsPortrait() so the card self-adapts on small screens instead of depending on the parent to pass compact, and verify the wrapped follow/menu layout in portrait.

findings.t: Follow toggle button lacks aria-pressed for its toggle state
findings.r: Add aria-pressed={isFollowing} to the follow button so assistive tech announces the toggle state.

findings.t: PalaceCard avatar has no image semantics for screen readers
findings.r: Give the avatar div role='img' and aria-label with the display name (as ProfileCard does), or mark it aria-hidden since the name is already announced.

findings.t: Avatar identity gradient/border built entirely from GOLD
findings.r: Consider an EMBER/terracotta-based identity gradient with a HAIRLINE or ember ring, keeping at most a single restrained gold accent per card so gold stays meaningful.

findings.t: No dedicated empty/loading/error styling for absent avatar/data
findings.r: Add a canon-styled skeleton (HAIRLINE/TRAY shimmer with reduced-motion guard) for loading, and ensure the initial/'?' fallback renders on image load error, on a calmer ember-tint circle rather than a gold gradient.

findings.t: Private-profile ProfileCard exposes a Follow button on a zeroed profile
findings.r: For the private-profile limited-info branch, either suppress the Follow affordance (add an is_public/limited flag the card can read) or avoid rendering optimistic stats that are known-zeroed placeholders.

findings.t: Follow button transition ignores prefers-reduced-motion
findings.r: Gate the transition on a reduced-motion check and disable it when reduced motion is requested; also avoid 'all' in favor of specific properties.

findings.t: Counts rendered without locale-aware number formatting
findings.r: Format counts with Intl.NumberFormat(locale) (or a shared formatNumber helper) so grouping matches the active locale.

findings.t: No visible focus ring on the keyboard-focusable PalaceCard
findings.r: Add onFocus/onBlur-driven inline outline (or a focus-visible style via TuscanCard) using GOLD #D4AF37 so keyboard focus is visibly indicated.

findings.t: Entire touch-controls overlay is off-canon dark bronze-glass, not CREAM/INK
findings.r: Reskin to canon: light frosted surface (e.g. rgba(252,250,245,0.9) CREAM glass with blur), border 1px HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, text INK #403B36 / MUTED #716A5E. Drop the umber glass entirely so it matches the Atrium/Library card grammar. Note this cascades: the text tokens, 'Got it' CTA color, diagram tints and shadow must al

findings.t: EntranceHallScene missing joystick guard → double-move-control conflict in bottom-left
findings.r: Add the same guard the other two scenes use: `if (rx < 0.25 && ry > 0.75 && touchMoveId === null && !document.querySelector('[data-mp-joystick]'))` so movement defers to the joystick on entrance exactly as in corridor/room.

findings.t: Room split-screen tutorial diagram is effectively unreachable — single shared LS key set by an earlier view
findings.r: Use per-context keys (mp_touch_tutorial_seen_corridor and mp_touch_tutorial_seen_room), or gate the shared key so the room diagram is guaranteed to show once on first room entry independent of the corridor/entrance hint.

findings.t: 'Got it' dismiss button is far below the 2.75rem touch-target minimum on a touch-only overlay
findings.r: Add minHeight:'2.75rem' (and adequate minWidth) to the button, or increase vertical padding, so the primary touch action meets the >=2.75rem target on the touch-only surface.

findings.t: Touch-tutorial text uses legacy linen token + hardcoded white rgbas, not canon INK/MUTED
findings.r: Replace linen/white rgbas with INK for primary hint text and MUTED for the move/look labels once the surface is light; import from libraryTokens.ts instead of hand-rolling opacities.

findings.t: 'Got it' button is translucent white glass, not the EMBER CTA
findings.r: Make it an EMBER #B85C38 filled pill (CREAM text) or an EMBER-outlined pill on the relit light surface, matching the app's standard confirm button.

findings.t: Touch-tutorial box shadow is a cold grey, not the canon warm-ink shadow
findings.r: Use canon SHADOW.2 = '0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(64,59,54,0.14)' (or HOVER_SHADOW) and express offset/blur in rem not px.

findings.t: Diagram tint colors are off-token approximations of SAGE/EMBER
findings.r: Derive the two halves from canon SAGE #56683C and EMBER #B85C38 (apply opacity to those exact hex) so the movement/camera coding matches the palette.

findings.t: fadeUp entrance animation has no reduced-motion guard
findings.r: Gate the animation behind a prefers-reduced-motion check, consistent with the motion tokens in T.motion.

findings.t: mobileHint copy describes split-screen controls but the room actually ships a joystick
findings.r: Reword to reflect the joystick (e.g. 'Joystick to move · Drag to look · Tap memories to view') across all five locales, or decide on one input model and align copy + diagram to it.

findings.t: Joystick knob math uses hardcoded px radii while the element is sized in rem
findings.r: Derive OUTER_R from the measured element via getBoundingClientRect() (rect.width/2) captured in handleTouchStart, so the math tracks the actual rendered size at any root font-size.

findings.t: Overlay not announced to assistive tech (no role/aria-live); decorative SVGs not hidden
findings.r: Add role='status' aria-live='polite' to the outer overlay div and aria-hidden='true' to both decorative SVGs so only translated text/labels are read.

findings.t: Hint selection keys on view type, not modality — 'desktopHint' shown on touch corridor/entrance
findings.r: Rename keys to reflect the real axis (corridorHint/roomHint) so the touch-vs-view distinction is explicit and edits can't surface desktop-only guidance on the touch-only overlay.

findings.t: Auto-dismiss on a 5s timer with no reduced-motion / cognitive pacing accommodation
findings.r: Persist LS_KEY only on explicit user dismiss (not the timeout), lengthen/remove the auto-timer under prefers-reduced-motion, and/or pause the timer while the overlay has focus.

findings.t: Joystick stays visible during room tour even while blocking panels are open
findings.r: Combine the guards, e.g. visible={(roomTourOpen || !selMem) && !showUpload && !showSharing && !moreMenuOpen} so open panels always hide the joystick.

findings.t: Tutorial i18n key names (desktopHint) shown to touch users are misleading maintenance hazards
findings.r: Rename keys to intent-neutral names (corridorHint/roomHint) since this overlay is always a touch overlay.

findings.t: Sub-canon micro type sizes for the move/look labels
findings.r: Raise the move/look labels to at least the canon overline size 0.6875rem with a small-caps/tracked treatment to match RT.overline.

findings.t: Raw pixel values in SVG diagram + mixed px units
findings.r: Size the icon wrappers in rem and keep only true 1px hairlines in px; align stroke colors to INK/MUTED once the surface is light.

findings.t: Instruction glyph labels ('Move'/'Look') sit at 0.5625rem — near-illegible on small screens
findings.r: Raise the caption toward >=0.75rem and consider higher-opacity text for legibility, since these are functional labels.

findings.t: Headings/labels use near-black charcoal #1F1B1A instead of canon INK #403B36
findings.r: Replace T.color.charcoal with canon INK #403B36 (import INK from @/lib/libraryTokens, as AtriumRelay does) for all title, feature-label and body-heading text in both menus.

findings.t: Primary FAB gradient uses off-canon terracotta #C66B3D, not EMBER #B85C38
findings.r: Default the FAB accent to canon EMBER #B85C38 (e.g. accent || '#B85C38'), keeping walnut as the deepening stop, so the CTA matches the interactive-ember canon.

findings.t: Card/panel borders use cream & sandstone, never the canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC
findings.r: Use canon HAIRLINE #E3D6BC for the panel, feature-tile and ActionMenu borders (rest state), reserving a warmer accent for hover, to match the Atrium/Library hairline grammar.

findings.t: Time Capsule discovery tile is a dead no-op — button dismisses without doing anything
findings.r: Wire onTimeCapsule to the real time-capsule flow (open the room/time-capsule panel like the other handlers), or if not ready, remove the timeCapsules entry from FEATURES so the menu doesn't present a control that does nothing.

findings.t: Secondary text uses off-canon muted #857B70 instead of MUTED #716A5E
findings.r: Use canon MUTED #716A5E for the subtitle and description spans (and any muted text in ActionMenu).

findings.t: Backdrop overlay uses raw rgba(42,34,24,0.55), not warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x)
findings.r: Switch the scrim to the warm-ink base, e.g. rgba(64,59,54,0.55).

findings.t: Panel surface is greyer linen #F2EDE4 rather than canon CREAM #FCFAF5
findings.r: Use CREAM #FCFAF5 (or TRAY #F6EBE3 recessed sandstone) as the panel/tray surface with a HAIRLINE #E3D6BC border.

findings.t: ActionMenu is dead code — no longer imported or rendered anywhere
findings.r: Delete ActionMenu.tsx (and its actionMenu i18n block if unused elsewhere) or add a tracking comment/TODO if it's intended to return.

findings.t: onShare / onCustomize discovery tiles silently do nothing when no active room/wing
findings.r: Provide a fallback when activeRoomId is null (open a room picker or route to the palace/library share entry) so the Share tile always leads somewhere.

findings.t: ActionMenu disclosure lacks menu roles and aria-controls linkage
findings.r: Add id to the popup with role='menu', give each item role='menuitem', set aria-controls={popupId} on the toggle; optionally move focus into the first menuitem when opened.

findings.t: DiscoveryMenu feature grid has no dedicated landscape-phone / narrow layout
findings.r: Use useIsPortrait()/useIsSmall() to pick a 3-column (or auto-fit minmax) grid in landscape-phone, and reduce card padding when the viewport is short.

findings.t: DiscoveryMenu feature buttons expose affordance only via hover, not on touch
findings.r: Add a touch/active feedback path (onPointerDown or WebkitTapHighlight / active-state style) and an explicit focus-visible outline in canon GOLD.

findings.t: 'Explore on my own' dismiss button colored walnut, not INK/MUTED
findings.r: Color the dismiss label with MUTED #716A5E (or INK #403B36) and use a HAIRLINE border, keeping walnut for non-text ink only.

findings.t: Feature-tile hover elevation diverges from canon HOVER_LIFT + SHADOW ramp
findings.r: Adopt the canon hover: translateY(-0.1875rem) lift plus SHADOW[1]/HOVER_SHADOW from libraryTokens.

findings.t: ActionMenu Escape only closes when a menu button holds focus; container has no Escape handler
findings.r: Add a single Escape handler at the wrapping div (or a document keydown effect gated on open) so Escape reliably closes the fan. Low priority since currently unwired.

findings.t: ActionMenu uses array index as React key for secondary items
findings.r: Key on a stable identifier such as item.label instead of the array index.

findings.t: Design-token drift from canon values (cream/muted/interactive)
findings.r: Reconcile theme.ts muted/interactive tokens with libraryTokens (MUTED #716A5E, EMBER #B85C38); verify muted secondary text still meets 4.5:1 on cream.

findings.t: Wizard source cards are click-only divs — no keyboard access, no radiogroup/radio a11y
findings.r: Wrap the two options in a container with role="radiogroup" and aria-label, and make each card role="radio" aria-checked={selected} tabIndex={0} with onKeyDown handling Enter/Space (and ideally arrow-key navigation). Add a visible :focus outline (GOLD #D4AF37) so the selection is reachable and visible via keyboard.

findings.t: TuscanCard elevated/glass variants render off-canon white-glass + cool-black shadows under every Kep step card
findings.r: Either introduce a canon variant (solid cream #FCFAF5 / linen surface, HAIRLINE border, warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) shadows) and switch the Kep step/settings cards to it, or restyle these cards with plain inline warm-ink styles matching the panel shell instead of the legacy glass variants.

findings.t: Settings card carries a permanent GOLD top border on a generic control — direct canon violation
findings.r: Do not use the gold-topped glass variant here. Switch to a canon solid/cream card with a HAIRLINE (#E3D6BC) border and no gold. Reserve gold strictly for palace-seal surfaces.

findings.t: KepCreationWizard renders on a bare page with no cream canvas or card shell
findings.r: Wrap the wizard in a canon surface: set the page/canvas to CREAM #FCFAF5, put the steps in a TuscanCard-equivalent cream panel with HAIRLINE border and a warm-ink shadow, so it visually matches the capture panel and Atrium siblings.

findings.t: Wizard silently swallows create failures — no error surfaced to the user
findings.r: Also pull error from useKepStore and render it near the Create button (e.g. an inline error row when handleCreate returns null / when error is set). Clear it on retry via clearError().

findings.t: Routing step promises room selection but only exposes an auto-route toggle
findings.r: Either add a wing/room selector to StepRouting (shown when auto_route_enabled is false) that writes default_wing_id/default_room_id, or change the step copy to reflect that it only controls AI auto-routing so the UI matches its stated purpose.

findings.t: Wizard body typography drops to browser default sans on labels, source titles, and toggle labels
findings.r: Add fontFamily: T.font.body to all wizard body text (labels, source titles/descriptions, toggle label/desc, review rows, inputStyle) so it renders in Source Sans, matching the rest of the canon.

findings.t: StepReview uses emoji check/cross and emoji source glyphs instead of canon iconography
findings.r: Replace emoji with canon SVG marks (e.g. a SAGE #56683C check, MUTED cross) and a small source glyph consistent with the panel's WhatsApp SVG.

findings.t: KepFlowIllustration bakes literal English labels and a raw brand-green into the SVG
findings.r: Dial the WhatsApp green to a smaller accent (icon only) rather than a full tinted panel, and drive the three captions from tokens/i18n rather than baked SVG <text>.

findings.t: Photos-source Kep can be created with no Google account connected
findings.r: When source_type === 'photos', check connected-accounts state; if Google Photos isn't linked, block Next / show a 'Connect Google Photos' CTA (link to /settings/connections).

findings.t: Escape-to-close on the capture dialog is unreliable — dialog is not focusable
findings.r: Add a document-level keydown listener in a useEffect for Escape, or give the dialog tabIndex={-1} and focus it on mount via a ref. Also move initial focus into the dialog.

findings.t: formatPhone assumes exactly 9 national digits after the country code
findings.r: Use a real phone-formatting lib (libphonenumber-js) or format loosely (group in 3s/4s) rather than hard-coding a 9-digit national length.

findings.t: Review step shows hardcoded 'WhatsApp' / 'Google Photos' value strings
findings.r: Reuse t('sourceWhatsapp')/t('sourcePhotos') (already localized in all 5 locales) so the review summary matches the localized choice, with the emoji marked aria-hidden.

findings.t: Panel and cards use theme.ts linen/warmStone/sandstone rather than canon CREAM/TRAY tokens
findings.r: Where practical, source neutrals from libraryTokens (CREAM/TRAY/HAIRLINE/SAGE) instead of theme.ts linen/warmStone/sandstone so the Kep surface shares one source of truth with its siblings.

findings.t: Disabled Next button uses sandstone fill with cream text — low-contrast, non-canon disabled state
findings.r: Give disabled a clearer canon treatment (e.g. TRAY fill with MUTED #716A5E text, or reduced-opacity ember).

findings.t: Photos date-range end defaults to a full ISO timestamp instead of a date
findings.r: Use a date-only string for the fallback (e.g. new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)) so startDate and endDate share the same YYYY-MM-DD format the scanner expects.

findings.t: Wizard step transitions are not announced / no focus move on step change
findings.r: On step change, move focus to the step's <h2> (add tabIndex={-1} + ref.focus()) or wrap step content in an aria-live="polite" region.

findings.t: KepCapturePanel command chips are English-only literals
findings.r: Keep the command keyword literal but source the example argument ('Kitchen'/'Holidays') from a translation key, or add a translated caption clarifying these are commands.

findings.t: Add Memory / Write Story actions are dead (silent no-op) in Atrium & Library modes and in 3D exterior/entrance
findings.r: Either add a mode/room-agnostic UploadPanel to sharedPanelOverlays with a sensible default room target, or in onAddMemory/onWriteStory navigate to a room first (setNavMode('3d') + enterWingRoom(activeWing||'roots', default room)) before setShowUpload(true), mirroring the TrackDetailPanel 'upload' case. At minimum guard

findings.t: Opening Upload in 3D exterior/entrance soft-locks the UI (nav hidden, no panel)
findings.r: Only hide the nav/sub-nav when the panel actually mounts: hidden={!!selMem || (showUpload && !!activeRoomId) || (showSharing && !!activeRoomId) || walkthroughActive}. The identical activeRoomId-guarded render for Share (line 1306) needs the same fix.

findings.t: Share Room action is a silent no-op outside a live 3D room
findings.r: Route Share Room to a room first when none is active (as the TrackDetailPanel 'share' case already does: enter a default room then setShowSharing after a delay), or disable/hide the Share Room action when activeRoomId is null so it never presents as a dead control.

findings.t: Surface styles from legacy T.color palette, not canon libraryTokens — MUTED, EMBER and INK all drift off-canon
findings.r: Reconcile the two token systems: realign T.color.muted→#716A5E, add a canon EMBER (#B85C38) for interactive accents, and soften charcoal→INK #403B36; or migrate the surface's user-facing chrome (toasts, era picker, storage prompt) to import from libraryTokens directly.

findings.t: Modal/overlay scrims use cold black/neutral rgba instead of the warm-ink rgba(64,59,54,x) grammar
findings.r: Standardize all scrims to rgba(64,59,54,0.5-0.6) and recolor the DelayedFallback spinner to a warm-ink/ember ring on a warm-ink scrim so lazy-load flashes stay on-brand.

findings.t: GOLD spent on generic media buttons — violates the palace-only gold rule
findings.r: Recolor these utility icons to the wing accent (wingData.accent) or terracotta/ember interactive ink, matching the room media pill's accent-first pattern. Reserve gold for seals/focus/frames only.

findings.t: Hairline and accent borders declared in px, not rem
findings.r: Convert to rem: 1.5px→0.09375rem, 2px→0.125rem, to match the media pills' 0.0625rem hairlines and the rem discipline used everywhere else.

findings.t: Storage-full CTA gradient uses terracotta→walnut with white text, off canon EMBER CTA
findings.r: Use a solid EMBER (#B85C38) or ember→rustDeep (#9A4F2A) gradient with CREAM (#FCFAF5) text, aligning with the canon interactive color.

findings.t: Toast/celebration box-shadows use bespoke tinted rgba instead of canon warm-ink SHADOW ramp
findings.r: Replace bespoke shadow tints with SHADOW[2]/HOVER_SHADOW from libraryTokens (rgba(64,59,54,x)) so all elevation shares one warm-ink shadow language.

findings.t: Track 'Explore Wings' navigation lands in the Entrance Hall, not the wing corridor
findings.r: If the intent is the wing corridor, change the track 'wings' case to enterCorridor(wing); if the intent is the wing-picker hub, use enterEntrance() and drop the misleading activeWing set. Consider removing/renaming enterWing.

findings.t: Onboarding-finish error toast and generic error message are hardcoded English strings
findings.r: Replace the literal with a translated string, e.g. tPalace('onboardingFinishError') added to en/nl/de/es/fr.

findings.t: No reduced-motion guard on the palace's continuous/flash animations
findings.r: Wrap transition/pulse/flash animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) or read a useReducedMotion() hook to drop animation on the portalAnim flash and toast entrances.

findings.t: MobileJoystick control geometry is hardcoded in px, not rem
findings.r: Drive the SVG/knob from the same rem base as the container, or keep touch math in the element's measured getBoundingClientRect so it scales with the container.

findings.t: Portal-flash and media-pill glass tints predate the canon and read as leftover warm-glass chrome
findings.r: Acceptable over a live 3D canvas where glass aids legibility, but tie the amber portal flash to GOLD (#D4AF37) and the glass border to HAIRLINE-derived alpha so HUD tokens trace back to canon.

findings.t: moreMenuOpen gate is permanently false — dead state
findings.r: Remove the unused moreMenuOpen state and the !moreMenuOpen term from the joystick visible expression, or wire setMoreMenuOpen to whatever menu was supposed to gate the joystick.

findings.t: MemoryMap onNavigate wing inference silently defaults custom rooms to 'roots'
findings.r: Resolve the wing from the actual room store (find the wing owning roomId via getWingRooms/customRooms) instead of a fixed prefix table, and factor the duplicated inference into one helper.

findings.t: Era-picker style choice lacks radiogroup semantics and uses a px border
findings.r: Wrap the two era buttons in role='radiogroup', give each role='radio' with aria-checked reflecting styleEra, and convert the 2px border to 0.125rem.

findings.t: Fallback English literals inline in storage-full copy
findings.r: Drop the `|| '...'` English fallbacks now that the keys are complete, so a future missing key surfaces during QA instead of masquerading as English copy.

findings.t: Interactive CTAs use off-canon terracotta, not EMBER
findings.r: Introduce/reference an EMBER token (#B85C38) and swap C.terracotta -> EMBER for btnPrimary, StepBadge gradient, settings link color, and the terracotta swatches in the illustrations, so CTAs match canon and sibling surfaces.

findings.t: Headings use near-black charcoal instead of warm INK
findings.r: Use C.inkSoft (#403B36 = canon INK) for all heading/body text; reserve charcoal only for the illustration's intentional dark silhouette fills.

findings.t: Cold rgba(0,0,0) shadows instead of warm-ink shadows
findings.r: Replace rgba(0,0,0,x) with rgba(64,59,54,x) across TuscanCard variant shadows (and the StepBadge boxShadow which correctly uses terracotta tint) to match canon warm-ink shadows.

findings.t: Off-canon hairline/border colors and hardcoded hex fallbacks
findings.r: Add a HAIRLINE token (#E3D6BC) and use it for all 1px borders; remove the hardcoded '#e5e2dc' fallbacks.

findings.t: Empty WhatsApp env var produces a dead CTA and a broken vCard download with no guard
findings.r: When !waPhone, hide or disable the WhatsApp <a> and the Save/Copy buttons (or render an inline 'Kep is temporarily unavailable' i18n message). At minimum, guard downloadVCard with `if (!phone) return;` and render href={waLink} only when waPhone is truthy so the CTA never opens a blank tab.

findings.t: No prefers-reduced-motion guard on six staggered entrance animations
findings.r: Add a global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important} } inside TuscanStyles, or guard the page animations behind a usePrefersReducedMotion hook.

findings.t: Muted secondary text uses off-canon muted grey
findings.r: Point secondary text at a MUTED token equal to #716A5E (or update C.muted) for caption/label consistency with canon.

findings.t: Phone-number pill and code chips use GOLD/monospace as body accent
findings.r: Keep gold as a subtle graphic tint but render the phone number in INK (or EMBER) via Source Sans with tabular-nums; if a mono look is desired for commands, define a canon mono token rather than the raw 'monospace' keyword.

findings.t: vCard download is not wired to any anchor cleanup / can fail silently on some mobile browsers
findings.r: Append the anchor to document.body before click() and remove it after, and/or detect the native app (Capacitor) to fall back to the wa.me deep-link. Consider wrapping in try/catch to at least log/telemetry a failed save so a silent no-op is detectable.

findings.t: Page background is linen, not canon CREAM base
findings.r: Consider CREAM (#FCFAF5) as the page base with linen reserved for lifted bands/cards, per canon, once the surface is migrated off the legacy Tuscan tokens.

findings.t: NavigationBar shows Atrium as the active mode while on the Kep page
findings.r: Either pass a neutral/no-active state (if NavigationBar supports it) or accept the Atrium highlight deliberately; if kept, add a code comment noting the intentional 'Kep is reached from Atrium' active-state choice.

findings.t: WhatsApp prefilled message and vCard NOTE/FN are hardcoded English (not i18n)
findings.r: Pull the prefill text and vCard FN/NOTE from the kepLanding i18n namespace (add keys like waPrefill, vcardName, vcardNote) so the initiated conversation and saved contact match the user's language.

findings.t: Kep landing surface is now a server-side redirect with no renderable UI to audit
findings.r: Re-scope the audit to the actual destination surface at src/app/(app)/palace/keps/page.tsx. Optionally add a next.config redirect (or middleware) instead of a component so the /kep path never ships a client bundle at all.

findings.t: Wing shares are unclickable dead rows in Shared-with-me panel
findings.r: Branch on share.type. For type==='wing', render the wing name/icon and expand its `rooms` list (each with its own roomId) as navigable sub-rows, or at minimum navigate to the wing. Add rooms/type/wingId to the AcceptedShare interface and stop assuming every share is a room.

findings.t: Navigation to a shared room guesses the wing from an ID prefix and silently lands in the wrong wing
findings.r: Change onNavigateToRoom to accept the wing explicitly (like OnThisDay/TimeCapsuleReveal which pass (wingId, roomId)). Pass share.placedInWingId (or the resolved wing) from the panel instead of prefix-guessing.

findings.t: Failed fetch leaves both panels stuck on the loading state forever
findings.r: Add a .catch(() => { setLoading(false); setError(...) }) (or try/finally in an async effect) so loading always clears, and surface a retry/empty state. Apply the same fix to InviteNotificationsPanel's getPendingInvites effect.

findings.t: getPendingInvites builds an unescaped .or() filter from user email — invites can silently fail to load
findings.r: Quote the value per PostgREST rules (e.g. shared_with_email.eq."${userEmail}") or run two separate .eq() queries and merge in JS, so emails with reserved characters resolve reliably.

findings.t: ReactionBar spends GOLD on a generic interactive state, violating the palace-only rule
findings.r: Swap the reacted state to EMBER: border/text #B85C38 (or EMBER_GLYPH #9A4F2A for text on light) with a `${EMBER}15` tint background, mirroring the InviteNotificationsPanel accept-CTA palette.

findings.t: ReactionBar uses off-canon walnut/sandstone/black instead of INK/MUTED/HAIRLINE and warm-ink shadow
findings.r: Retoken ReactionBar to canon: text INK #403B36, secondary MUTED #716A5E, borders HAIRLINE #E3D6BC, and shadow SHADOW[1] = 0 0.25rem 1rem rgba(64,59,54,0.07) from libraryTokens.

findings.t: ReactionBar mixes raw px into border sizing, breaking rem discipline
findings.r: Express as 0.0625rem solid/dashed #E3D6BC to match sibling hairline convention.

findings.t: Panel surfaces use linen (#F2EDE4) not canon CREAM (#FCFAF5) as the base
findings.r: Lift the panel base toward CREAM (`${T.color.cream}f8`) or document linen-as-frosted-glass as deliberate.

findings.t: Focus-ring styling is inconsistent between the two sibling panels
findings.r: Add the same .swm-panel button:focus-visible gold focus ring block so both panels share the canon ring.

findings.t: Reaction counts never reconcile with the server (stale multi-user counts)
findings.r: After toggleReaction resolves, re-fetch getReactionSummary or have toggleReaction return the fresh summary.

findings.t: SharedWithMePanel lacks the visible focus outline InviteNotificationsPanel provides
findings.r: Add a .swm-panel button:focus-visible gold outline rule mirroring InviteNotificationsPanel.

findings.t: SharedWithMe room-card buttons have no explicit min-height (borderline touch target)
findings.r: Add minHeight 2.75rem to the room-card button.

findings.t: ReactionBar picker is not viewport-aware and animates without a reduced-motion guard
findings.r: Flip the picker to a bottom sheet on useIsMobile() and drop transition:'all' or wrap motion in a prefers-reduced-motion guard.

findings.t: Room cards and header/meta rows collapse the type ramp to a single 0.8125rem size, flattening hierarchy
findings.r: Bump the room-name line to RT.body 0.9375rem (or titleS) and keep metadata at 0.8125rem.

findings.t: ReactionBar '+' add-reaction affordance is a bare typographic plus, off the icon language
findings.r: Replace '+' with a small canon plus/smiley-add SVG stroked in currentColor; align hover to the picker's warmStone background.

findings.t: memoryCount renders 'undefined' when the count is missing
findings.r: Coalesce to 0: String(share.memoryCount ?? 0), and skip the memories chip for wing rows once the wing-share fix lands.

findings.t: Reaction SVG icons injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML have no accessible label on the count chip
findings.r: Add aria-label={t(`reaction_${r.emoji}`)} and aria-pressed={r.reacted} to the chip buttons.

findings.t: Inline SVG reaction icons are not marked decorative for assistive tech
findings.r: Add aria-hidden='true' to icon spans and ensure each reaction button exposes an accessible name.

findings.t: @media queries in the injected <style> block violate the 'inline styles only, no @media' canon
findings.r: Migrate the layout-driving breakpoints (nav-links vs burger, steps-grid columns, chapter-rail visibility) to useIsMobile()/useIsCompact() with inline styles, matching canon. Reduced-motion @media guards are defensible to keep; the layout @media rules should move to the hook pattern used elsewhere.

findings.t: Focus rings use terracotta (#C66B3D), not canon GOLD
findings.r: Change the focus-visible outline color from T.color.terracotta to GOLD #D4AF37 (T.color.gold / L.accentDark); on-light focus should be gold, dark-hero cream outlines are fine.

findings.t: Primary CTA gradient uses EMBER_GLYPH (#9A4F2A), not interactive EMBER (#B85C38)
findings.r: Rebuild the CTA gradient around EMBER #B85C38 as the interactive base, keeping #9A4F2A reserved for at-rest accent text.

findings.t: Language <select> desyncs when locale is restored client-side from localStorage
findings.r: In the restore effect, after a successful load also write document.cookie mp_locale so downstream server-rendered routes inherit the resolved locale.

findings.t: switchLocale does a full page reload for every language change, discarding in-page state
findings.r: Replace the reload with an in-place dynamic import of the chosen locale's slices (including the iOS seal branch); keep the cookie write, drop the reload.

findings.t: Hardcoded English aria-labels never localize
findings.r: Add landingV2.a11y.menu/.mainNav/.language keys across all 5 locales; brand name may stay literal, the rest must localize.

findings.t: Language <select> is a 2.25rem-tall touch control on iPad web (below 2.75rem minimum)
findings.r: Raise the select minHeight to T.touch (2.75rem).

findings.t: Hero/scrim/shadow colors hardcoded as raw rgba umber instead of tokens
findings.r: Introduce L.scrim/shadow tokens and reuse the warm-ink SHADOW ramp so the umber wash and CTA shadows derive from tokens.

findings.t: Comparison-table concession row mixes charcoal weights and a stray success check
findings.r: Give the table's checks a consistent accent (sage T.color.success or ember) matching the USP-rail checkmarks.

findings.t: USP scroll-active state relies on findIndex by title string, brittle on title collision
findings.r: Key off a stable numeric id per item computed when building USP_FLAT instead of matching translated title text.

findings.t: Hero autoplay treats every mobile viewport without Network Information API as constrained
findings.r: Offer a tap-to-play affordance on mobile or gate on saveData only; at minimum confirm poster-only default is the intended product decision.

findings.t: Mobile menu does not lock body scroll or trap focus while open
findings.r: On menuOpen set body overflow hidden (restored on close), move focus into the menu, add Escape-to-close, and have Link items call setMenuOpen(false).

findings.t: USP chapter-rail active step exposes no aria state
findings.r: Add aria-current={isActive ? 'true' : undefined} to the rail buttons.

findings.t: Hero secondary CTA prefixes a literal play glyph with no text alternative
findings.r: Wrap the glyph in <span aria-hidden='true'> so the accessible name is just the localized label.

findings.t: Trust chip links may compress below the touch minimum
findings.r: Give the trust chips minHeight: T.touch and verify computed height on touch.

findings.t: IntersectionObserver snapshots refs once at mount with empty deps
findings.r: Observe elements in the ref callback (observe on set, unobserve on null) so the gate is robust to dynamic card lists.

findings.t: AchievementsPanel is lazy() but rendered without a Suspense boundary — first open can crash/blank
findings.r: Wrap both render sites in the peers' boundary: {showAchievements&&<Suspense fallback={lazyFallback}><AchievementsPanel onClose={()=>setShowAchievements(false)} highlightId={achHighlightId}/></Suspense>} at lines 1121 and 1536.

findings.t: Per-card Share button is a 28px touch target — below the 2.75rem minimum
findings.r: Grow the button to >=2.75rem square (or keep a 1.75rem visual with a 2.75rem hit area via padding/negative margin, or a ::before overlay). On touch (useTouchControls()) bump the size unconditionally.

findings.t: Toast ('Copied to clipboard') is not announced to screen readers
findings.r: Add role="status" aria-live="polite" to the toast container (or a dedicated persistent live region) so clipboard/share feedback is announced.

findings.t: Panel background gradient ends in warmStone, greyer than canon CREAM and out of step with siblings
findings.r: Re-anchor the gradient on the warm ladder used by siblings — e.g. linear-gradient(160deg, #F2EDE4 0%, #FCFAF5 78%) (linen → cream) so the panel lands on canon CREAM, matching StatisticsPanel.

findings.t: Share-toast detection duplicates share.ts branch logic and misfires on user-cancel
findings.r: Have shareAchievement() return a discriminated result ({ok, method:'native'|'web'|'clipboard'}) and drive the toast off method==='clipboard' instead of re-deriving the branch in the caller.

findings.t: Unlocked date rendered as raw ISO YYYY-MM-DD, not localized
findings.r: Format with new Date(earnedDate).toLocaleDateString(locale, {year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'}) (guarding invalid dates), using the active i18n locale.

findings.t: No iPad / compact handling — only useIsMobile() (max 767px) is consulted
findings.r: Consult useIsCompact()/useIsTablet() to enlarge padding and touch targets on iPad, and consider a single-column grid on compact so 16.25rem min columns don't crowd.

findings.t: Animations lack reduced-motion guards
findings.r: Gate animations/behavior:'smooth' behind a prefers-reduced-motion check (matchMedia or useReducedMotion); fall back to no animation and behavior:'auto'.

findings.t: Close button is a 36px touch target — under the 2.75rem floor
findings.r: Increase to >=2.75rem square, at least when useTouchControls() is true.

findings.t: Locked-icon tint reintroduces alpha (sandstone22) despite the file's own 'pre-mixed opaque surfaces' rule
findings.r: Replace ${T.color.sandstone}22 with a pre-mixed opaque tint (#EBE3D4 / T.color.lineFaint or a resolved hex) so the locked well matches the opaque discipline.

findings.t: Earned-date meta shares the exact size of the description, flattening card hierarchy
findings.r: Drop the date to a smaller overline/micro size (0.6875–0.75rem), optionally letter-spaced, so it reads as quiet metadata.

findings.t: Header trophy medallion and card icon wells use slightly different gold-lane tints/opacities
findings.r: Give the header trophy medallion more presence (stronger tint or SHADOW.1 plus a hairline ring) for a clear focal hierarchy, or document the intentional flatness.

findings.t: scrollIntoView highlight can fire before lazy content/layout is ready
findings.r: Defer the scroll with requestAnimationFrame (or a small timeout tied to the open animation) and honor prefers-reduced-motion with behavior:'auto'.

findings.t: handleShare has no error/failure feedback when clipboard write fails
findings.r: Add an else if (!ok) onShareToast(t('shareFailed')) branch (new i18n key) so a failed share surfaces a message.

findings.t: Category grid uses a role=list/listitem tree but cards are non-interactive containers
findings.r: Wrap category overlines in role="heading" aria-level or an h-tag, and link each role=list to its heading via aria-labelledby.

findings.t: Fullscreen mobile panel uses safe-area-inset but not landscape-specific insets for the toast
findings.r: Use bottom: max(2rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) for the toast to keep it clear of the home indicator in landscape.
